Getting to know that he had gone for hunting, Dharmaraja found the path made due to Bhima’s thighs forcefully bringing down big trees and went in the same direction. He noticed Bhima constricted by the python and asked.

Yudhishthira heard the reason from Nahusha in its entirety. Out of affection for his brother, he answered all the questions asked by him. Immediately, Nahusha rose to Swarga.

units.sanskrit:
दिव्याम्बरे कुण्डलिनि स्वपूर्वे गते विमानेन स धर्मराजः।
भीमश्‍चायात् स्वाश्रमायैव सर्वं युधिष्ठिरः कथयामास तत्र ॥ २२/३७७॥
श्रुत्वा कृष्णा भ्रातरश्‍चास्य सर्वे सर्वे मुनीन्द्रा भीमसेनेऽतिभक्ताः।
व्रीडां ययुर्भीमसेनग्रहेण तथाऽब्रुवन् स्नेहतो भीमसेनम् ॥ २२/३७८॥
नैतादृशं साहसं तेऽनुरूपं शक्तोऽपि यत् स्वात्मनो मोक्षणाय।
नैवाकरो यत्नमतो निजानां महद् दुःखं हृदये प्रार्पयस्त्वम् ॥ २२/३७९॥
मैवं पुनः कार्यमिति ब्रुवन्तः समाश्लिषन् सर्व एवैत्य भीमम्।

ततोऽहोभिः कैश्‍चिदापुः कुरूणां राष्ट्रं पार्था मुनिमुख्यैः समेताः ॥ २२/३८०॥
ततोऽमितौजा भगवानुपागमन्नारायणः सत्यभामासहायः।
सम्पूजितः पाण्डवैस्तैः समेतश्‍चक्रेऽथ सौहार्दनिमित्तसत्कथाः ॥ २२/३८१॥
कृष्णा च सत्या च परस्परं मुदा सम्भाषणं चक्रतुर्योषिदग्र्येे।
परीक्षयन्त्या सत्यया सर्ववेत्त्र्या निर्दोषया चोदिता प्राह कृष्णा ॥ २२/३८२॥
स्त्रीधर्मानखिलांस्तत्र सत्यां निर्दोषसंविदम्।
ज्ञात्वाऽपि कृष्णा प्रोवाच लोकशिक्षार्थमेव तु ॥ २२/३८३॥
क्रीडार्थमेव वचनं ज्ञात्वा सत्यासमीरितम्।
तस्यानुसारिवाक्यानि तत्प्रीत्या एव साऽब्रवीत् ॥ २२/३८४॥
units.english:
As their forefather Nahusha, putting on divine robes and ear-rings, left for Swarga in an aero-plane, Dharmaraja and Bhima returned to their ashrama. There, Dharmaraja narrated all the incidents.

Listening to the narration, all the brothers who had extreme devotion towards Bhima, along with the best of the Rishis and Draupadi, became embarrassed after knowing that Bhima was held by the python. Out of friendship towards him, they told him the same too. Note: The incident caused somewhat of an embarrassment to Draupadi, the Pandavas and the Sages. They told Bhima that they felt so.

“Such a daring act is not appropriate. Even though you were capable, you did not attempt to free yourself and thereby caused lot of pain to your close ones”.

“Don’t not repeat this” – saying thus, all of them came near Bhima and hugged him. After some days, the Pandavas got together with some of the chief Rishis and left for Dvaita forest, that was near the Kuru country.

There, Bhagavan Sri Krishna, the one with unlimited strength, came to meet them along with Satyabhamaa. Worshipped well by the Pandavas, he engaged with them, doing banter on a lot of topics.

Satyabhamaa and Draupadi, the two best amongst women, joyfully engaged in conversation. When Satyabhamaa, the omniscient one who is without any defects, asked Draupadi in order to test her, Draupadi replied.

Draupadi narrated the entire Stree-Dharma to Satyabhamaa, knowing fully well that she was defect-less and omniscient. Teaching the world was the purpose (of that narration).

Draupadi was aware that Satyabhamaa’s words were in jest, and replied to her with affection in the same manner. Note: Satyabhamaa asked Draupadi how she had kept her five husbands under control!

units.sanskrit:
ततः कतिपयाहानि निरुष्यात्र जनार्दनः।
ययौ सभार्यः स्वपुरीं पाण्डवाननुमान्य च ॥ २२/३८५॥
ततः कदाचिन्मृगयां गतेषु पार्थेषु राजा सैन्धव आससाद।
सकोटिकाश्यः सबलश्‍च तेषां वराश्रमं सोऽत्र ददर्श कृष्णाम् ॥ २२/३८६॥
व्रजन् विवाहार्थमसौ निशाम्य कृष्णां कोटिं प्रेषयित्वैव काश्यम्।
आयाहि मामित्यवदत् सुपापस्तया निरस्तो जगृहे करे च ॥ २२/३८७॥
तया धूतो निपपाताशु भूमौ पुनः ससञ्ज्ञोऽभ्यगमद् विलज्जः।
ततोऽसहायत्वत एव कृष्णा धौम्यायोक्त्वा साग्निरन्वेहि मेति ॥ २२/३८८॥
समारुहत् सैन्धवस्यैव यानं सुखं न यासीति तमीरयित्वा।
तदा निमित्तानि निशाम्य पार्थाः समाययुस्त्वरयैवाश्रमाय ॥ २२/३८९॥
श्रुत्वा दासीवचनात् सर्वमेव चक्रुः क्षिप्रं सैन्धवस्यानुयानम्।
आक्रोशमानं भीमसेनेति धौम्यं दृष्ट्वा तस्याग्रे सैन्धवं चातिपापम् ॥ २२/३९०॥
चक्रुर्नादान् सिंहवत् पाण्डुपुत्रा दृष्ट्वा कृष्णा चावतरद् रथात् तदा।
धौम्येन सार्द्धं सा ययौ चाश्रमाय सैन्यं पार्थास्तत्र निजघ्नुरोजसा ॥ २२/३९१॥
अग्रे कृष्णां योऽवदत् सिन्धुराजं याहीति तं कोटिकाश्यं सुपापम्।
छित्वा शिरो मृत्यवे भीमसेनो निवेदयामास तमः स चागात् ॥ २२/३९२॥
units.english:
Later, Sri Krishna, after staying there for a few days, returned to Dwaraka with Satyabhamaa, after being warmly sent off by the Pandavas.

Once, when all the Pandavas were away for hunting, Jayadratha, the King of Sindhu, came to that excellent Ashrama along with Kotikashya and his army. There, he saw Draupadi.

Jayadratha, who was on his way to a wedding, sent Kotikashya when he saw Draupadi with a message saying – “Come to me”. When she refused, that evil sinner came forward to grab her hand.

When Draupadi shook her hand, that sinner fell down unconscious. He got up and, without shame, rushed to kidnap her. Then, as she was helpless, Draupadi asked Sage Dhaumya to follow her, along with the Agni. Note: Draupadi asked Sage Dhaumya to carry the Aupasana Agni with him.

Draupadi climbed his chariot even as she was saying – “You cannot leave in peace now”. The Pandavas noticed several ill omen and immediately returned to the Ashrama.

They heard the whole incident from a maid and immediately chased the King of Sindhu. They saw Sage Dhaumya who was shouting – “Bhimasena!”. In front of him, they saw the evil sinner Jayadratha.

The Pandavas roared like lions. Seeing them, Draupadi got down from the chariot and returned to the Ashrama along with Sage Dhaumya. The Pandavas then started pounding the army of the Saindhava with great valour.

First, Bhimasena beheaded Kotikashya, who had called Draupadi to come to Jayadratha, and sent him to his death. He reached Tamas.

units.sanskrit:
हत्वा सेनामखिलां सैन्धवस्य भीमार्जुनौ सयमं धर्मराजम्।
विसृज्य धावन्तमथानुजग्मतुर्जयद्रथं विरथं फल्गुनोऽकः ॥ २२/३९३॥
पद्भ्यां धावन्तं भीमसेनो निगृह्य दत्त्वा प्रहारांश्‍च भृशं तमार्तम्।
आदायाधाद् द्रौपदीपादयोश्‍च तं मोचयामास च धर्मसूनुः ॥ २२/३९४॥
दासो द्रौपद्या अहमित्येव वाक्ये तेनैवोक्ते भीमसेनोऽप्यमुञ्चत्।
स व्रीडितोऽवाग्वदनो ययौ वनं पार्थाश्‍च तत्रोषुरतिप्रमोदिनः ॥ २२/३९५॥
मार्कण्डेयस्तदाऽऽगत्य तेषामकथयत् कथाः।
बह्व्यश्‍चैव विचित्राश्‍च भाषात्रयसमन्विताः ॥ २२/३९६॥
लोकदर्शनमाश्रित्य देवाश्‍च मुनयस्तथा।
ब्रूयुः कथास्तत्र शिक्षा ग्राह्या नार्थः कथञ्चन ॥ २२/३९७॥
अर्थः समाधिभाषासु ग्राह्यः सर्वोऽप्यसंशयम्।
परदर्शनभाषासु ज्ञेयं तद्दर्शनं तथा ॥ २२/३९८॥
ग्राह्यो नार्थो वैदिकं तु दर्शनं ग्राह्यमेव हि।
अन्यार्थो गुह्यभाषासु ग्राह्य एवं विनिर्णयः ॥ २२/३९९॥
जयद्रथस्तु भीमेन यदा पञ्चशिखीकृतः।
तपसा शिवमाराध्य वव्रे पाण्डवरोधनम्।
ऋतेऽर्जुनादर्जुनस्य तुष्टो हि तपसा शिवः ॥ २२/४००॥
units.english:
Bhima and Arjuna destroyed the entire army of the Saindhava. They sent back Dharmaraja, Nakula and Sahadeva and chased the escaping Jayadratha. Arjuna rendered him chariot-less.

When he started running on his feet, Bhimasena caught him and rendered a few blows. He went into great sorrow, even as Bhima brought him to Draupadi’s feet. The son of Dharma released him.

“I am Draupadi’s servant” – Bhima released him after making him say so. He went away to the forest, fully embarrassed. The Pandavas started living there with great joy.

Then, Sage Markandeya came to the Pandavas and told them numerous stories. Those stories were varied, and were composed of the three types of Bhashas. Note: The three types of Bhashas are Guhya, Darshana and Samadhi.

Relying upon the face value of the incidents, Devatas and Sages narrate stories. Only the essence of those stories are to be grasped. The superficial stories are never to be accepted.

In the ‘Samadhi’ Bhasha, all the meanings are acceptable. There is no doubt. In the ‘Darshana’ Bhasha that corresponds to other philosophies, only the fact that those philosophies are such and such are to be accepted. The interpretations are not to be considered as truth. The Vedic Darshana is of course always acceptable. In the Guhya Bhasha, the main purport is the one that is hidden and is to be interpreted and accepted. This is the key to understanding Bhashas.

Jayadratha, whose hair was cut off by Bhimasena, except for five tufts, performed a penance to please Shiva and asked for a boon to be able to stop the Pandavas. Shiva, being pleased with Arjuna’s penance, granted him a boon that he would be able to stop all of them (for a day) except Arjuna.

units.sanskrit:
वने वसत्स्वेव च पाण्डवेषु चक्रे यज्ञं पौण्डरीकाख्यमेव।
संस्पर्धया राजसूयस्य राजा दुर्योधनो नाप्यसौ तत्कलार्हः ॥ २२/४०१॥
दुर्योधनस्याज्ञया पाण्डवानां दुःशासनः प्रेषयामास दूतम्।
आगच्छतेत्यवमानाय तं तु भीमोऽवादीद् रणयज्ञं स्वगम्यम् ॥ २२/४०२॥
ततो दिनैः कैश्‍चन धार्तराष्ट्राः सकर्णगान्धारनृपाः कुमन्त्रतः।
सभार्यकाः पाण्डवान् द्रौपदीं च महैश्‍वर्यं दर्शयित्वाऽवमन्तुम् ॥ २२/४०३॥
तै स्यन्दनैः काञ्चनरत्नचित्रैर्महागजैस्तुरगैः पत्तिभिश्‍च।
स्वलङ्कृताश्‍चित्रमाल्याम्बराश्‍च विनिर्ययुर्द्वैतवनाय शीघ्रम् ॥ २२/४०४॥
गवां दृष्टिच्छद्मना निर्गतांस्तान् ज्ञात्वा शक्रस्तेजसो भङ्गकामः।
तत्सामर्थ्यं वरमस्मै प्रदाय तद्बन्धनायादिशच्चित्रसेनम् ॥ २२/४०५॥
स षष्टिसाहस्रककोटियूथपैर्गन्धर्वमुख्यैः संवृतोऽगात् सरस्तत्।
यस्मिन् स्नातुं वाञ्छति धार्तराष्ट्रस्तदाज्ञया पुरुषास्तानथोचुः ॥ २२/४०६॥
स्नातुं समायास्यति धार्तराष्ट्रो राजेश्‍वरो निःसरध्वं तदस्मात्।
तीर्थादाज्ञां धारयन्तश्‍च तस्येत्युक्ता गन्धर्वा जहसुस्तानथोच्चैः ॥ २२/४०७॥
ऊचुर्वयं मानयामस्तदाज्ञां त्रिलोकानां यः पतिः शक्रदेवः।
न मानुषाणामपि चक्रवर्तिनां किम्वल्पसारस्य सुयोधनस्य ॥ २२/४०८॥
units.english:
Even as the Pandavas were in the forest, Duryodhana performed a Yajna known as the Paundarika, out of competition with them. That Yajna was not equivalent to even a fraction of the Rajasuya.

As per Duryodhana’s orders, Dushasana sent a messenger to the Pandavas in order to insult them and told them – “Come (to the Yajna)”. Bhimasena sent a reply – “We shall come without fail to the Yajna that is war”.

After a few days, the Kauravas held a ill-intentioned discussion with Karna and Shakuni, and in order to display their great wealth to the Pandavas and Draupadi and insult them, proceeded along with their wives.

Accompanied by chariots decked with gold and precious stones, excellent elephants, horses and foot-soldiers, they put on attractive dresses and garlands and decorated themselves well, and quickly proceeded towards the Dvaita forest.

Getting to know that they have made an excuse of watching cows, and desiring to break their pride, Indra sent Chitrasena after granting him a boon to possess the necessary strength to arrest them. Note: Chitrasena was a Gandharva.

Chitrasena proceeded to the lake where Duryodhana desired to take bath, along with an army of sixty thousand crores, and the best Gandharvas. As per the orders of Duryodhana, his assistants told the Gandharvas thus.

“The King of Kings, Duryodhana, is soon to come here for taking bath. You people need to get out of this Tirtha. Obey his orders” – when they said thus, the Gandharvas laughed loudly.

They replied – “Devendra is the lord of the three worlds. We will obey (only) his orders dutifully. We do not listen to the words of even Emperors amongst humans. What then to say about the orders of this lowly hero Duryodhana”.

units.sanskrit:
इतीरिते कुपितो धार्तराष्ट्रो जघान गन्धर्ववराञ्छरौघैः।
जघ्नुः सकर्णा अपि तस्य सोदरा जघ्नुश्‍च ते धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सेनाम् ॥ २२/४०९॥
मुहूर्तमासीत् सममेव युद्धं तेषां तदा धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चैव।
पुरां भिन्दोर्वरतो मायया च गन्धर्ववीरा ववृधुस्ततः स्म ॥ २२/४१०॥
तेजोभङ्गं तत्र सुयोधनस्य पार्थार्थमत्र प्रविधातुमेव।
बलं ददावब्जजः केशवश्‍च गन्धर्वाणां तेऽभ्ययुर्धार्तराष्ट्रान् ॥ २२/४११॥
स चित्रसेनः प्रथमं कर्णमेव युयोध पार्थस्पर्धया तेन युद्ध्यन्।
कर्णो नाशक्नोद् वचनाद् भार्गवस्य रामस्य नित्यामितषड्गुणस्य ॥ २२/४१२॥
स भग्नयानश्‍च विकर्णयानमास्थाय तस्यैव नियम्य वाजिनः।
पराद्रवत् तेन सहैव शीघ्रं दुर्योधनश्‍चित्रसेनं युयोध ॥ २२/४१३॥
मुहूर्तमेतेन समं स युद्ध्यन्नन्यैर्गन्धर्वैर्बहुभिर्माययैव।
भग्ने रथे भूमितले स्थितः सन् गृहीत आसीच्चित्रसेनेन सङ्ख्ये ॥ २२/४१४॥
महाबलो धार्तराष्ट्रोऽपि शक्रवराद् विष्णोराज्ञया चाभिवृद्धे।
स चित्रसेनेन धृतस्तदाऽसीद् बद्धः पाशैर्वैद्युतैरिन्द्रदत्तैः ॥ २२/४१५॥
तस्यानुजाः शकुनी राजभार्याः सर्वे बद्धाः शक्रदूतैः प्रणीताः।
आदाय तानम्बरे सम्प्रयातेष्वरूरुवन् पाण्डवान् मन्त्रिणोऽस्य ॥ २२/४१६॥
units.english:
When they spoke thus, an angered Duryodhana started attacking those excellent Gandharvas with a shower of arrows. Karna and the Kaurava brothers also started attacking them. In turn, the Gandharvas too hit back at Duryodhana’s army.

For a duration of one muhurtha, the battle between the Gandharvas and Duryodhana went equal. After that, due to the boon of Indra, and due to the maya of the brave Gandharvas, their strength started to increase.

Brahma and Vishnu, for the sake of the Pandavas, had granted strength to those Gandharvas to destroy the pride of Duryodhana. They faced the Kauravas.

At first, Chitrasena fought against Karna. Fighting with a sense of competition against Arjuna in mind, Karna failed to win against him, due to the words of Sri Parashurama, the one with the six auspicious attributes. Note: Sri Parashurama had cursed Karna that he would lose in any battle where he engaged with a sense of one-upmanship or competition against Arjuna.

Karna, who was rendered chariot-less, climbed the chariot of Vikarna and, driving his horses, ran away from there along with Vikarna. Duryodhana engaged in a duel with Chitrasena.

For a muhurtha, Duryodhana fought an equal battle with Chitrasena and the numerous Gandharvas. Due to the maya of the Gandharvas, his chariot was destroyed. Chitrasena then captured him even as he stood on the ground.

Although Duryodhana was extremely powerful, due to the boon of Indra, and due to Sri Vishnu’s orders, Chitrasena had accumulated lot of strength to which Duryodhana fell prisoner. He also got arrested by the electric shackles given (to Chitrasena) by Indra.

His brothers, Shakuni and royal wives were all taken prisoners by Indra’s assistants. When Chitrasena left through the route of the skies along with them, the ministers (of Duryodhana) went to the Pandavas in a desperate condition.

units.sanskrit:
समीपमागत्य पृथासुतानां पराभूतं वः कुलं शक्रभृत्यैः।
धृतः सभार्यः सानुजो धार्तराष्ट्रस्तं मोचयध्वं भ्रातरं भारताग्र्याः ॥ २२/४१७॥
इत्युक्त ऊचे भीमसेनोऽग्रजं स्वं जाने राजन् यादृशोऽयं विमर्दः।
ऐश्‍वर्यं स्वं दर्शयन् नः समागाद् दुर्योधनस्तेजसो भङ्गमिच्छन् ॥ २२/४१८॥
विज्ञाय तेषां मन्त्रितं वज्रबाहुरेतच्चक्रे नात्र नः कार्यहानिः।
दिव्यं ज्ञानं स्वात्मनो दर्शयन् स एतावदुक्त्वा विरराम भीमः ॥ २२/४१९॥
एकाहयज्ञे दीक्षितेनैव राज्ञा सम्प्रेषितो भीमसेनोऽर्जुनश्‍च।
समाद्रेयौ चित्रसेनं रणे तौ विजित्य दुर्योधनमाश्‍वमुञ्चताम् ॥ २२/४२०॥
स चित्रसेनो वासवोक्तं च सर्वं कुमन्त्रितं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य चाह।
पार्थस्य भीमस्य च तन्निशम्य सुव्रीडितो धृतराष्ट्रात्मजोऽभूत् ॥ २२/४२१॥
समाप्य यज्ञं च ततोऽभियान्तं सर्वे प्रापुर्धर्मराजं स चाशु।
सम्पूज्य तूत्सृज्य च चित्रसेनमूचे गान्धारे न पुनः कार्यमीदृक् ॥ २२/४२२॥
स पाण्डवैर्मोचितः सानुजश्‍च सभार्यकः किञ्चिदतोऽपगम्य।
सम्मेलनायोपविष्टश्‍च तत्र सुव्रीडितः सूतपुत्रं ददर्श ॥ २२/४२३॥
स चाह दिष्ट्या जयसि राजन्निति सुयोधनम्।
व्रीडितो नेति तं चोक्त्वा यथावृत्तं सुयोधनः ॥ २२/४२४॥
units.english:
They came to the Pandavas and said – “Your clan has been defeated by Indra’s assistants. Duryodhana has been captured along with his brothers and wives. You, being the best of the Bharatas, should get your brother released”.

When they spoke thus, Bhimasena addressed his older brother – “O King! I know how this confrontation took place. Duryodhana came here to display his wealth to us. In order to harm his glory, Indra, the bearer of the Vajra, has done this, after realizing his evil intentions. There is nothing that has gone wrong for us in this”. Showing his divine ability in this way, Bhima went silent.

Dharmaraja, who was engaged in a Yajna lasting a full day, sent Bhima and Arjuna along with Nakula and Sahadeva. The two of them (Bhima and Arjuna) defeated Chitrasena in battle and quickly released Duryodhana.

Chitrasena then narrated all the evil designs of Duryodhana, as told by Indra, to Bhima and Partha. Hearing the same, Duryodhana felt extremely embarrassed.

All of them reached Dharmaraja, who was approaching them after completing the Yajna. Dharmaraja sent off Chitrasena after according him respect, and told Duryodhana – “Do not repeat this, O Duryodhana!”.

Having been released by the Pandavas, along with his family and wives, Duryodhana went a little further from there and, out of great shame, sat down waiting for everyone to gather. Then, he saw Karna.

He told Duryodhana – “O King! Providence has ensured you won”. Duryodhana felt ashamed and said no. He narrated all that had happened. Later, out of extreme grief, he sat down, intending to give up his life.

units.sanskrit:
उक्त्वा प्रायोपवेशं च चक्रे तत्र सुदुःखितः।
कर्णदुःशासनाभ्यां च सौबलेन च देविना ॥ २२/४२५॥
अन्यैश्‍च याच्यमानोऽपि नैवोत्तस्थौ सुयोधनः।

ततो निशायां प्राप्तायां स्वपक्षे प्रविषीदति ॥ २२/४२६॥
मन्त्रयित्वाऽसुरैः कृत्या निर्मिता होमकर्मणि।
शुक्रेणोत्पादिता कृत्या सा प्रसुप्तेषु मन्त्रिषु ॥ २२/४२७॥
धार्तराष्ट्रं समादाय ययौ पातालमाशु च।
अथ सम्बोधयामासुर्दैत्या दुर्योधनं नृपम् ॥ २२/४२८॥
त्वं दिव्यः पुरुषो वीरः सृष्टोऽस्माभिः प्रतोषितात्।
तपसा शङ्कराद् वज्रकायोऽवध्यश्‍च सर्वदा ॥ २२/४२९॥
अस्माकं पक्षभूतस्त्वं देवानां चैव पाण्डवाः।
इदानीं सर्वदेवानां वरात् त्वं विजितो रणे ॥ २२/४३०॥
वयं तथा करिष्यामो यथा जेष्यसि पाण्डवान्।
कृष्णेन निहतश्‍चैव नरकः कर्ण आस्थितः ॥ २२/४३१॥
स च कृष्णार्जुनाभावं करिष्यति न संशयः।
भीष्मादींश्‍च वयं सर्वानाविशामो जयाय ते ॥ २२/४३२॥
units.english:
Even after Karna, Dushashana, the gambler Shakuni and others requested him repeatedly, Duryodhana refused to give up his resolve and get up.

As night set in, the Asuras held a discussion, noticing that their side had been weakened, and created a Daitya-shakti (evil force) by performing a homa.

That evil being, which was created by Sage Shukracharya, lifted Duryodhana and took him to Patala, even as all of his ministers were asleep.

Later all the Asuras convinced Duryodhana in multiple ways – “You are a divine being. A brave soul. We pleased Shiva through penance and that resulted in you being made. You are on our side, and are invincible always. The Pandavas belong to the Devatas”.

“Due to the boons of all Devatas, you lost in the battle. We will (now) ensure that you win against the Pandavas”.

“Narakasura, who was killed by Krishna, has now entered Karna. He will surely ensure Krishna and Arjuna are no more. There is no doubt about this”.

“All of us shall enter Bhishma and the others, to ensure your victory. We will increase Karna’s and your strength through our tapas”.

units.sanskrit:
तपसा वर्धयिष्यामस्त्वां कर्णादींश्‍च सर्वशः।
तस्माद् गत्वा पालयस्व राज्यं राजन्नपेतभीः ॥ २२/४३३॥
इदं कस्यापि नाख्येयं सुगुप्तं भूतिवर्धनम्।
इत्युक्त्वा कृत्यया भूयः स्वस्थाने स्थापितो नृपः ॥ २२/४३४॥
उमया निर्मितात्मार्धमुत्तरं हरनिर्मितम्।
ज्ञात्वैवावध्यतां चैव राज्ये बुद्धिं चकार सः ॥ २२/४३५॥
नोवाच कस्यचित् तेषु स्वानुभूतं सुयोधनः।

प्रभातायां तु शर्वर्यां पुनः कर्णोऽब्रवीद् वचः ॥ २२/४३६॥
भृत्यैस्तवैव पार्थैर्यन्मोचितोऽसि परन्तप।
तेन मान्योऽधिकं लोके यद् भृत्या एव तादृशाः।
किमु त्वं राजशार्दूल तदुत्तिष्ठ स्थिरो भव ॥ २२/४३७॥
या च तेऽर्जुनमाहात्म्ये शङ्का सा व्येतु मे शृणु।
यावन्नैवार्जुनं हन्यां पादौ प्रक्षालये स्वयम् ॥ २२/४३८॥
इत्युक्तोऽवरजैश्‍चैव सर्वैः शकुनिना तथा।
याचितो रथमारुह्य ययौ नागपुरं द्रुतम् ॥ २२/४३९॥
units.english:
“O King! Therefore go back and rule the Kingdom without fear. This is of utmost secrecy and will increase your fortune. Do not reveal this to anyone”.

Stating thus, they sent back Duryodhana, through that Kshudra Devata, to the place from where he was brought. Believing that his upper torso was made by Shiva, and the lower part by Parvati, Duryodhana convinced himself to be invincible and decided to rule the Kingdom. He did not reveal his experiences to anyone else.

In the morning, Karna spoke again – “Since you have been released through your servants, the Pandavas themselves, your fame has actually increased in the world. Is it necessary to state how great you are when your servants themselves are thus? Therefore, O best amongst Kings! Arise! Be firm in your decision”.

“Give up your concerns with regard to Arjuna. Listening to what I am about to say. Till I kill Arjuna, I shall wash my legs myself”. Note: It was custom for Kings to have their servants wash their feet. Karna undertook a pledge to wash his feet himself till he kills Arjuna (which never happened).

When Karna said thus, and when Shakuni and his brothers requested him similarly, Duryodhana climbed his chariot and speedily went to Hastinapura.

units.sanskrit:
सकुण्डलं सकवचमवध्यं सूर्यनन्दनम्।
ज्ञात्वेन्द्र उभयं तस्मादैच्छदादातुमुत्तमम् ॥ २२/४४०॥
तद् विज्ञाय रविः कर्णं स्वप्न उक्त्वा न्यवारयत्।
सर्वथा दास्य इत्युक्ते प्राहादेयं वरायुधम् ॥ २२/४४१॥
ददौ चोत्कृत्य कवचं कुण्डले च शचीपतेः।
अमोघां शक्तिमादाय ज्ञात्वेन्द्रं द्विजरूपिणम् ॥ २२/४४२॥
ऋतेऽर्जुनादेकमेव वधिष्यस्यनयेति सः।
दत्त्वा शक्तिं ययौ शक्रः सार्द्धं कवचकुण्डलैः ॥ २२/४४३॥
पार्था विमुच्यैव सुयोधनं तं वने वसन्तो मुदिताः सदैव।
सहारणीभाण्डमथो मृगेण हृतं द्विजस्याशु निशम्य चान्वयुः ॥ २२/४४४॥
तस्मिन्नदृश्ये तृषिता एकैकमुदकार्थिनः।
ययुर्युधिष्ठिरमृते सुप्तास्ते धर्ममायया ॥ २२/४४५॥
अदृश्येनैव धर्मेण वारिता वारिपायिनः।
क्षत्रधर्मस्य रक्षार्थं न तत्प्रश्नान् विदां वराः ॥ २२/४४६॥
units.english:
Knowing that Karna could not be killed till he possessed his ear-rings and kavacha, Indra desired to take away those excellent accessories.

Getting to know of this (intention of Indra), Surya revealed the same to Karna in his dream and asked him not to hand them over. When Karna said – “I will definitely give it”, he replied – “In that case, obtain that best weapon from Indra in return”. Note: Surya asked Karna to ask for, and obtain, the amazing Shakti.

Even though Karna knew Indra had come to him in the guise of a Brahmana to obtain Daana, he cut the ear-rings and kavacha from his body and handed them over. In return, he obtained the extra- ordinary Shakti from him. Indra gave him the Shakti weapon, told him that he would be able to kill one person apart from Arjuna using it, and returned with his ear-rings and kavacha.

The Pandavas, after freeing Duryodhana, lived happily in that forest. Getting to know that a deer had taken away the firesticks (arani) and the holding vessel of a Brahmana, they chased it.

When they could not locate the deer, they felt thirsty. Apart from Dharmaraja, the others went to fetch water, one after the other. Due to the maya of Yama, all of them fell into deep sleep.

Yama, being invisible, stopped them. All of them drank water (without answering him). In order to protect the Dharma of Kshatriyas, those great destroyers of enemies did not answer his questions in exchange for water, although they were fully capable.

units.sanskrit:
व्याचक्रुः शक्तिमन्तोऽपि पानीयार्थमरिन्दमाः।
न विप्राणां च धर्मोऽयं विद्याया उपजीवनम् ॥ २२/४४७॥
क्षत्रियाणां तु किमुत प्रसभं तेन ते पपुः।
देवा अपि मनुष्येषु जाताः सुबलिनोऽपि हि ॥ २२/४४८॥
मानुषेणैव भावेन युक्ताः स्युः केशवादृते।
कार्येष्वेषां क्रमेणैव व्यक्तिमायान्ति सद्गुणाः ॥ २२/४४९॥
अतो भीमार्जुनौ धर्मादत्युत्तमबलावपि।
देवमायां समाश्रित्य धर्मेण स्वापितौ क्षणात् ॥ २२/४५०॥
मुहूर्तमेव सा माया तयोराच्छादने क्षमा।
ततः प्रबुद्धयोर्धर्मो नैव शक्तिशतांशभाक् ॥ २२/४५१॥
उक्तं पद्मपुराणे च तदेतत् सर्वमञ्जसा।
तस्मान्नाशक्तिरनयोः सम्भाव्या भीमपार्थयोः ॥ २२/४५२॥
धर्मात्मजोऽथाजगामोदकान्तं दृष्ट्वा भ्रातॄंस्तत्र दुःखाभितप्तः।
इच्छन् पातुं वारि संवारितश्‍च पित्रा बकाकारमितेन नापात् ॥ २२/४५३॥
units.english:
It is not Dharma for even Brahmanas to trade their knowledge for the sake of livelihood. What then to say of Kshatriyas? Therefore they drank water forcing their way through.

Apart from Sri Hari, the other Devatas, when they are born as humans, behave like normal humans, even though they are extremely powerful.

Only when an occasion arises, their auspicious qualities manifest externally. Therefore, Bhima and Arjuna, although more powerful than Yama, were put to sleep in an instant by him, due to the wishes of Paramatma.

That divine maya is capable of taking effect on them for only a muhurtha. Once they wake up, Yama is not equal to even one-hundredth of the strength of Bhima and Arjuna.

All of this has been stated in the Padma Purana in great detail. Therefore, one should not doubt incapability in Bhima or Arjuna.

Later, Dharmaraja came near that body of water. There, seeing his brothers, he suffered in sorrow. When he desired to drink that water, Yama, in the form of a crane, stopped him. He therefore did not drink it.

units.sanskrit:
अर्थे भ्रातॄणामैच्छदसौ तदीयप्रश्नप्रतिव्याहरणं दयालुः।
ततो धर्मो यक्षतनुः स भूत्वा प्रश्नांश्‍चक्रे व्याकरोत् तान् स पार्थः ॥ २२/४५४॥
ततस्तुष्टो वरमस्मै ददौ स एकोत्थानं भ्रातृमध्ये स वव्रे।
यद्येकः स्यान्नकुलोऽस्त्वित्यथाह तुष्टो धर्मः कथमेतत् कृतं ते ॥ २२/४५५॥
अतिप्रीतिर्भीमसेने तवास्ति बली चासौ राज्यहेतुस्तव स्यात्।
इत्युक्त ऊचे माद्रिपुत्रं विहाय कुन्तीपुत्रो न मयोत्थापनीयः ॥ २२/४५६॥
स एवमुक्तो नितरां प्रीयमाण उत्थापयामास च तान् समस्तान्।
यथेष्टरूपप्राप्तिमेषां पुनश्‍च स्वकामतो निजरूपाप्तिमादात् ॥ २२/४५७॥
अज्ञातवासेऽज्ञाततां सर्वदैव ददौ तेषां प्रीत एवानृशंस्यात्।
एवं क्रीडन् पुत्र इत्यात्मनैव यशोधर्मावात्मनो वर्धयन् सः ॥ २२/४५८॥
युधिष्ठिरात्मनः स्वस्य यशोधर्मविवृद्धये।
कृत्वाऽरण्यपहारादि पुनर्दत्त्वा च तत् स्वयम्।
दातुं विप्राय तद्धस्ते ययौ धर्मो दिवं पुनः ॥ २२/४५९॥
ततो राजा भीमसेनार्जुनौ च सार्द्धं यमाभ्यामरणीं प्रदाय।
मुदा युताः कृष्णया सार्धमेव सन्तुष्टुवुः कृष्णमनन्तमच्युतम् ॥ २२/४६०॥
॥ इति श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्यविरचिते श्रीमन्महाभारततात्पर्यनिर्णयेऽरणीप्राप्तिर्नाम द्वाविंशोऽध्यायः॥
units.english:
The compassionate Yudhishthira desired to answer the questions of that crane, for the sake of his brothers. Later, Yama started asking him questions after taking the guise of a Yaksha. Dharmaraja answered them.

Then, Yama became very happy and gave him a boon that he would bring to life one among his brothers. Dharma said – “In case only one would wake up, let it be Nakula”. Yama, out of joy, asked him – “What are you doing?”

“You have great love for Bhimasena. He is strong, and is also the reason for you obtaining the Kingdom” – when Yama said thus, Dharmaraja replied – “It is inappropriate to wake up the son of Kunti leaving out the son of Madri”.

When he replied thus, Yama became very pleased and woke all of them up. He also gave them boons allowing them to take guises as they wish, and to return to their original forms when required.

Being pleased with Dharmaraja’s attribute of compassion, he gave them a boon saying that they would remain incognito during the Ajnatavasa. In this way, Yama sportingly engaged with himself as though he was with his son, and increased his own fame and punya.

Having taken away the firesticks and created the other incidents in order to increase the fame and punya of his own form of Yudhishthira, Yama gave it back so it could be handed over to the Brahmana, and then returned to his loka.

Later Dharmaraja went along with Bhima, Arjuna and the twins and handed over the firesticks to the Brahmana. Joined together by Draupadi, all of them were happy and spent time chanting the glory of Sri Krishna, the one who is eternal and without a trace of any defect. Srimadanandatirtha Bhagavatpada ||

units.sanskrit:
ॐ॥ नारायणानुग्रहतो यथावन्निस्तीर्य तान् द्वादशाब्दान् वने ते।
विसृज्य च ब्राह्मणादीन् सधौम्यानज्ञातवासाय ततो मनो दधुः ॥ २३/१॥
गत्वा विराटस्य पुरीं निधाय हेतीः शम्यां छन्नरूपा बभूवुः।
यतिः सूदः षण्डवेषोऽथ सूतवेषो गोपो गन्धकर्त्री च जाताः ॥ २३/२॥
सर्वे विराटं ययुरत्र देववत् सम्भावितास्तेन शुभोरुलक्षणाः।
युधिष्ठिरस्यैव शुश्रूषणं ते चक्रुर्हृदा वासुदेवस्य नान्यत् ॥ २३/३॥
परपाको गृहस्थस्य क्षत्रियस्य विशेषतः।
न योग्य इति सूदस्य बभ्रे वेषं वृकोदरः ॥ २३/४॥
वैदिकव्यवहारेषु ज्ञानाधिक्यप्रसिद्धितः।
जानीयुर्भीम इत्येव सूदवेषस्ततोऽभवत् ॥ २३/५॥
स्वीयं वेदविदां सर्वं देवेशानां च किं पुनः।
अतस्तेऽन्याश्रयं नैव चक्रुः स्वबलसंश्रयात् ॥ २३/६॥
शापादेवार्जुनः षण्डवेषोऽभून्नकुलस्तथा।
क्षत्रियानन्तरत्वात् तु सूतजातेस्तथाऽभवत् ॥ २३/७॥
सूतस्यानन्तरत्वात् तु वैश्यजातेस्तथाऽभवत्।
सहदेवो वैश्यजातिर्गोपालस्तेषु चोत्तमः ॥ २३/८॥
units.english:
The Pandavas, due to the blessings of Sri Narayana, completed twelve years of their exile in the forest appropriately. Bidding farewell to Sage Dhaumya, the Brahmanas and the others, they made up their mind to undergo the Ajnatavasa.

The Pandavas reached the city of King Virata and, after keeping their weapons in a Shami tree, changed their appearances. They took on the guise of a yati, cook, transgender, horse-keeper, cowherd and a female assistant.

All of them went to King Virata. Being adorned with excellent auspicious traits, they were all accorded great respect by him, just as if they were Devatas. They worshipped Sri Hari residing inside of Dharmaraja mainly, and not anyone else.

Bhimasena took the guise of a cook as it was not appropriate for a Gruhastha, especially for a Kshatriya, to consume the food of others.

Bhima took the guise of a Shudra also because his knowledge would become apparent if he appeared in any Vaidika guise, and people would therefore identify him.

When it is said that those who know the Vedas possess ownership over other’s wealth, what else needs to be said about the Pandavas, who are the best amongst Devatas? Therefore they stayed there on the basis of their own strength, and not by relying upon anyone else.

Due to the curse he had received, Arjuna took on the role of a transgender. Similarly, Nakula took on the guise of a Suta as it was the next jati after Kshatriya.

After the Suta, Vaishyas are the next higher caste. Hence Sahadeva took on the guise of a Vaishya. Amongst Vaishyas, cowherds are the best. Therefore he relied upon the profession of tending to cows. Since a yati is worshipped by all, Dharmaraja took on that guise. He also engaged constantly in gambling to build expertise. His goal was to display his skill in gambling later (at the end of the exile).

units.sanskrit:
ततो गोपालतामाप यतिः पूज्योऽखिलैर्यतः।
यतिरासीद्धर्मजोऽतः सोऽभ्यासार्थं सदैव च ॥ २३/९॥
अक्षासक्तोऽभवत् पश्‍चात् दर्शयिष्यन् स्वशिष्टताम्।
भीमसेनसधर्मार्थं शूद्रा सैरन्ध्रिकाऽभवत् ॥ २३/१०॥
द्रौपदी भर्तृसाधर्म्यं स्त्रीणां धर्मो यतः सदा।

अथाजगाम मल्लकः समस्तभूमिमण्डले ॥ २३/११॥
वरेण योऽजितो जयी शिवस्य सञ्जगर्ज च।
तमीक्ष्य सर्वमल्लका विराटराजसंश्रयाः ॥ २३/१२॥
प्रदुद्रुवुर्भयार्दितास्तदाऽवदद् युधिष्ठिरः।
य एष सूद आशु तं निहत्य मल्लमोजसा ॥ २३/१३॥
यशस्तवाभिवर्धयेत् समाह्वयाद्य तं नृप।
इतीरिते समाहुतो जगाद मारुतिर्वचः ॥ २३/१४॥
प्रसादतो हरेरहं निषूदयेऽद्य मल्लकम्।
समस्तदेववृन्दतो महान् य एव केशवः ॥ २३/१५॥
समस्तदेवनामवांस्तदीयभक्तितो बलम्।
य एव देवनामधा इति श्रुतिर्जगाद हि ॥ २३/१६॥
units.english:
In order to be known as a saha-dharmini to Bhimasena, Draupadi took on the guise of a Sairandhri, belonging to the Shudra varna. Isn’t it the Dharma of a wife to be known as one discharging similar duties as the husband?

Later a wrestler came there. Due to the boon of Shiva, he had become invincible and used to win (wrestling contests) against everyone. He came there and gave out a loud roar. Note: The name of the wrestler was Jeemuta.

Seeing him, all the wrestlers who were under the patronage of King Virata ran away due to fear. Then, Dharmaraja said.

“O King! The cook that you have employed can quickly kill this wrestler and increase your fame. Summon him now”.

When Dharmaraja suggested thus, Virata summoned Bhima. “Due to Sri Hari’s grace I shall immediately slay this wrestler” – said the son of Maruti.

“Sri Hari, the controller of Brahma and Rudra, is bigger than all the Devatas belonging to various groups. He bears those names by which all Devatas are known. Due to my devotion to him, I possess strength”. Note: The names Brahma, Rudra, Indra, Vayu etc are all actually names of Paramatma. The Devatas are actually named after him.

units.sanskrit:
महांश्‍च देव एष तत् स मे जयं विधास्यति।
युधिष्ठिराभिधश्‍च यो युधिष्ठिरे स्थितः सदा ॥ २३/१७॥
त्वयि स्थितस्त्वमित्यसौ सदाऽभिधीयते हरिः।
इति ब्रुवाणो मल्लं तमभियातो वृकोदरः ॥ २३/१८॥
अनयत् मृत्युलोकाय बलाढ्यैरपि दुर्जयम्।

एवं निवसतां तत्र पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम् ॥ २३/१९॥
संवत्सरे द्विमासोने विजित्य दिश आगतः।
कीचको मत्स्यनृपतेः श्यालो बलवतां वरः ॥ २३/२०॥
स द्रौपदीं वीक्ष्य मनोभवार्तः सम्प्रार्थयामास तया निरस्तः।
मासे गते भगिनीं स्वां सुदेष्णां सम्प्रार्थयामास तदर्थमेव ॥ २३/२१॥
तया निषिद्धोऽपि पुनःपुनस्तां यदा ययाचेऽथ सा चाह कृष्णाम्।
समानयाश्‍वेव सुरां मदर्थमितीरिता नेति भीताऽवदत् सा ॥ २३/२२॥
बलात् तया प्रेषिता तद्गृृहाय यदाऽगमत् तेन  हस्ते गृहीता।
विधूय तं प्राद्रवत् सा सभायै स्मृत्वाऽऽदित्यस्थं वासुदेवं परेशम् ॥ २३/२३॥
अनुद्रुत्यैनां पातयित्वा पदा स सन्ताडयामास तदा रविस्थितः।
नारायणो हेतिनामैव रक्षो न्ययोजयत् तददृश्यं समागात् ॥ २३/२४॥
units.english:
“There is a Shruti that goes by ‘ya eva devanamadha’. Therefore, Sri Hari is the biggest Daiva (Mahadeva). Hence he along will grant me victory”. “Sri Hari as residing inside of Yudhisthira is known by the name of Yudhishthira. Similarly, Sri Hari inside you is known as Tvam. In this way, it is Sri Hari who is primarily addressed by all names”.

Stating this way, Bhimasena faced that wrestler. He sent that wrestler, who was invincible by even the strongest, to the loka of Yama.

In this way, when the Pandavas were residing there, when only two months remained in the year, Keechaka, the brother of Virata’s wife, who was known as the best amongst the powerful, returned there after gaining victories in all directions.

Seeing Draupadi, and overcome by lust, he pleaded with her in many ways and was rejected. Even as a month passed by (in his attempts), he requested (his sister) Sudeshna repeatedly seeking Draupadi.

Since Keechaka kept requesting her even after she tried to stop him, Sudeshna told Draupadi – “You bring me Sura (alchohol) from him immediately”. Draupadi was frightened and said – “Not possible”.

Draupadi went to his place after being forced to do so. He tried to grab her by her hands. She shook off his hands, pushed him down, and rushed to the royal gathering. While running that way, she prayed to Sri Hari, the Supreme lord, as residing inside of Surya.

Chasing Draupadi, Keechaka kicked her after pushing her down. Then, Sri Narayana, who was inside of Surya, sent a Rakshasa named Heti. He had come there being invisible all the while.

units.sanskrit:
वायुस्तमाविश्य तु कीचकं तं न्यपातयत् तां समीक्ष्यैव भीमः।
चुकोप वृक्षं च समीक्ष्यमाणं तं वारयामास युधिष्ठिरोऽग्रजः ॥ २३/२५॥
कृष्णा रात्रौ भीमसकाशमेत्य हन्तुं पापं कीचकं प्रैरयत् तम्।
भीमस्य बुद्ध्या निशि सा कीचकं च जगाद गन्तुं शून्यगृहे स चागात् ॥ २३/२६॥
तत्रैनमासाद्य च भीमसेनो विजित्य तं बाहुयुद्धे निहत्य।
शिरो गुदे पाणिपादौ च तस्य प्रवेशयामास विमृद्य वीरः ॥ २३/२७॥
अवध्यं तं निहतं वीक्ष्य तस्य पञ्चोत्तरं शतमेवानुजानाम्।
सर्वं वराच्छङ्करस्य ह्यवध्यं सहैव कृष्णां तेन दग्धुं बबन्ध ॥ २३/२८॥
सा नीयमाना कीचकैः संरुराव श्रुत्वैव तं भीमसेनो महान्तम्।
उद्धृत्य वृक्षं तेन जघान सर्वानादाय कृष्णां पुनरागात् गृहं च ॥ २३/२९॥
एवं यत्नात् तपसा तैरवाप्तो वरः शिवादजयत्वं रणेषु।
अवध्यता चैव षडुत्तरास्ते शतं हता भीमसेनेन सङ्ख्ये ॥ २३/३०॥
गन्धर्व इत्येव निहत्य सर्वान् मुमोद भीमो द्रौपदी चाथ कृष्णाम्।
याहीत्यूचे सा सुदेष्णा भयेन त्रयोदशाहं पालयेत्याह तां सा ॥ २३/३१॥
अस्त्वित्येनामाह भयात् सुदेष्णा तथाऽवसन् पूर्णमब्दं च तेऽत्र।

तदा पार्थान् प्रविचिन्त्याखिलायां पृथ्व्यां छन्नान् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य दूताः ॥ २३/३२॥
units.english:
Sri Vayu entered that Rakshasa, hit Keechaka and made him fall down. Seeing Draupadi in that state, Bhima became furious. Noticing Bhima staring at a nearby tree, his older brother Yudhishthira stopped him.

That night, Draupadi approached Bhima and encouraged him to kill the sinner Keechaka. As instructed by him, she asked Keechaka to go to the empty dancing school the next night. He (Bhima) too went there.

Bhima, having reached there, won against him in a combat and killed him. He then mangled his body, stuffing his head and limbs into his anus.

Getting to know that the invincible Keechaka has been killed, a hundred and five brothers of his, who were also invincible due to Shiva’s boon, tied up Draupadi, wanting to burn her along with their brother’s body. Note: The 105 brothers of Keechaka were known as Upakeechakas.

As she was being dragged by those Keechakas, Draupadi let out a loud shout. Hearing the same, Bhimasena immediately uprooted a huge tree and killed all of them with it. He then left for the city, along with Draupadi.

In this way, the hundred and six of them, who had through great efforts obtained boons from Shiva for remaining invincible and free from death, were killed by Bhima.

Even as he was being thought of as a Gandharva, Bhima enjoyed killing all of them. Draupadi too became happy. Later, Sudheshna, out of fear, asked Draupadi to leave. “Let me be under your care for thirteen more days” – replied Draupadi. Sudeshna, still reeling with fear, said yes to her. In this way, Pandavas completed the one year period of disguise.

units.sanskrit:
अविज्ञाय प्रययुर्धार्तराष्ट्रमूचुर्हतं कीचकं योषिदर्थे।
तेनावदद् द्रौपदीकारणेन दुर्योधनो निहतं कीचकं तम् ॥ २३/३३॥
भीमेनागुस्तत्र दुर्योधनाद्या भीष्मादिभिः सह कर्णेन चैव।

अग्रे ययौ तत्र योद्धुं सुशर्मा स गा विराटस्य समाजहार ॥ २३/३४॥
श्रुत्वा विराटोऽनुययौ ससैन्यस्तं पाण्डवाश्‍चानुययुर्विनाऽर्जुनम्।
विजित्य सङ्ख्ये जगृहे विराटं तदा सुशर्मा तमयाद् वृकोदरः ॥ २३/३५॥
स तस्य सेनां विनिहत्य मात्स्यं विमोच्य जग्राह सुशर्मराजम्।
युधिष्ठिरो मोचयामास तं च ततो रात्रौ न्यवसन् बाह्यतस्ते ॥ २३/३६॥
ततोऽपरदिने सर्वे भीष्मद्रोणपुरःसराः।
रहितं कीचकैर्मात्स्यं शक्यं मत्वाऽभिनिर्ययुः ॥ २३/३७॥
कीचकस्य हिडिम्बस्य बककिर्मीरयोरपि।
जरासन्धस्य नृपतेः कंसादीनां च सर्वशः ॥ २३/३८॥
न बाधनाय भीष्माद्या अपि शेकुः कथञ्चन।
तस्मात् ते कीचकं शान्तं श्रुत्वा मात्स्यं ययुर्युधे ॥ २३/३९॥
units.english:
Around that time, the soldiers of Duryodhana, who had searched the entire world for the in- disguise Pandavas, returned to him without having spotted them. They gave him the news that Keechaka had been killed for a woman.

Then, Duryodhana said – “Keechaka has been killed by Bhima because of Draupadi”. Later, Duryodhana and the others, along with Bhishma and the rest, and with Karna, left for the city of Virata.

At first, Susharma went to the city of Virata to wage a war. There, he captured the cows of Virata. Hearing this, Virata left along with his army. The Pandavas, apart from Arjuna, followed him. Susharma defeated Virata and captured the King. Then, Bhima went against him. He destroyed the army (of Susharma), released Virata and captured Susharma.

Yudhishthira got Susharma released. Later that night, the Pandavas camped outside the city.

The next day, Bhishma, Drona and the others decided it would easy to win against a Virata army that does not have Keechaka, and proceeded.

It had not been possible for even Bhishma and the others to bring under control Keechaka, Hidimba, Baka, Kirmeera, King Jarasandha, Kamsa and the rest. Therefore, knowing Keechaka to be dead, they proceeded for war against Virata.

units.sanskrit:
यतिष्ये रक्षितुं भीमाद्धार्तराष्ट्रानिति स्वकाम्।
सत्यां कर्तुं प्रतिज्ञां तु ययौ द्रोणः सपुत्रकः ॥ २३/४०॥
यदि युद्धाय निर्यान्ति ज्ञाताः स्युः पाण्डवास्तदा।
न चेद् विराटमनतं नमयिष्यामहे वयम्।
इति मत्वा विराटस्य जगृहुर्गाः समन्ततः ॥ २३/४१॥
तदोत्तरः सारथित्वे प्रकल्प्य पार्थं ययौ तान्निशाम्यैव भीतः।
ततोऽर्जुनः सारथिं तं विधाय कृच्छ्रेण संस्थाप्य च तान् ययौ कुरून् ॥ २३/४२॥
आदाय गाण्डीवमथ ध्वजं च हनूमदङ्कं सदरोऽग्रतो गाः।
निवर्त्य युद्धाय ययौ कुरूंस्तान् जिग्ये सर्वान् द्वैरथेनैव सक्तान् ॥ २३/४३॥
एकीभूतान् पुनरेवानुयातान् सम्मोहनास्त्रेण विमोहयित्वा।
जग्राह तेषामुत्तरीयाण्यृते तु भीष्मस्य वेदास्त्रघातं स एव ॥ २३/४४॥
विधाय भीष्मं विरथं जगाम तदा श्रुत्वा मत्स्यपतिर्जितान् कुरून्।
मुमोद पुत्रेण जिता इति स्म तदाऽऽह षण्डेन जितान् युधिष्ठिरः ॥ २३/४५॥
तदा क्रुद्धः प्राहरत् तं विराटः सोऽक्षेण तद् भीमधनञ्जयाभ्याम्।
श्रुतं तदा कुपितौ तौ निशाम्य न्यवारयत् तावपि धर्मसूनुः ॥ २३/४६॥
units.english:
In order to make true his assurance that he would protect the Kauravas against Bhima, Drona proceeded for war with them, taking along his son.

“If the Pandavas come out to help them, they would be identified. Else, we can defeat Virata who has been invincible till date” – thinking thus, they caught Virata’s cows from all directions.

Then, Uttara proceeded towards getting the cows released, appointing Arjuna as his charioteer. Seeing the Kauravas, however, he immediately became scared. Arjuna then stopped him with great difficulty and, after making him his charioteer in turn, proceeded against the Kauravas.

Retrieving the Gandiva, putting on the Hanuman mast and holding the Devadatta conch, Arjuna at first got the cows released. He then started fighting the Kauravas. One by one, they engaged with him in battle from their chariots.

When the Kauravas again came after him together, he rendered everyone apart from Bhishma unconscious by using the Sammohana astra and picked up all of their upper garments. Only Bhishma knew of the counter astra to the Sammohana astra. Note: The Sammohana was a divine weapon that would cause the enemy to fall unconscious.

Arjuna rendered Bhishma chariot-less and returned. Hearing the news of the defeat of all Kauravas, King Virata assumed that it was due to his son and felt elated. Yudhisthira then told him that their defeat was due to the transgender (Brihannala – Arjuna).

King Virata then got angry and assaulted Yudhishthira with the dice used for gambling. Bhima and Arjuna became furious after getting to know of this. Dharmaraja stopped them.

units.sanskrit:
निजस्वरूपेण समास्थितान् नो यदि स्म नासौ प्रणिपातपूर्वकम्।
क्षमापयेद् वध्य इत्यात्मरूपं समास्थितास्तस्थुरथापरे दिने ॥ २३/४७॥
तदा विराटासनमास्थितं नृपं युधिष्ठिरं वीक्ष्य विराट आह।
किमेतदित्यूचिवानुत्तरोऽस्मै तान् पाण्डवान् गोग्रहणे च वृत्तम् ॥ २३/४८॥
ततो विराटो भयकम्पिताङ्गः प्रणम्य पार्थान् शरणं जगाम।
ददौ च कन्यामुत्तरां फल्गुनाय पुत्रार्थमेव प्रतिजग्राह सोऽपि ॥ २३/४९॥
एवं विराटं मोचयित्वैव गाश्‍च तमस्यन्धे कीचकान् पातयित्वा।
प्राप्तो धर्मः सुमहान् वायुजेन तस्यानु पार्थेन च गोविमोक्षणात् ॥ २३/५०॥
अयातयन् केशवायाथ दूतान् सहाभिमन्युः सोऽपि रामेण सार्धम्।
आगादनन्तानन्दचिद् वासुदेवो विवाहयामासुरथाभिमन्युम् ॥ २३/५१॥
आसीन्महानुत्सवस्तत्र तेषां दाशार्हवीरैः सह पाण्डवानाम्।
सपाञ्चालानां वासुदेवेन सार्धमज्ञातवासं समतीत्य मोदताम् ॥ २३/५२॥
दुर्योधनाद्या सूतपुत्रेण सार्धं ससौबलेया युधि पार्थपीडिताः।
भीष्मादिभिः सार्धमुपेत्य नागपुरं मन्त्रं मन्त्रयामासुरत्र ॥ २३/५३॥
units.english:
“If he doesn’t bow to us and apologize when we appear in our original form, then he qualifies to be killed” – said Dharmaraja. The next day, all of them put on their original forms and stood there.

Then, Virata saw Dharmaraja sitting on his throne and asked them – “What is this?”. Prince Uttara told him that they were the Pandavas and narrated all that happened during the go-grahana.

King Virata started shivering with fear and fell at the feet of the Pandavas and took refuge. He gave his daughter Uttaraa to Arjuna. He accepted her for his son (i.e. as his daughter-in-law).

In this way, for having released Virata and the cows, and for having sent the Keechakas to Andhantamas, Bhimasena accumulated a lot of excellent punya. After him, Arjuna gained a lot of punya for having freed the cows.

After that, the Pandavas sent messengers to Sri Krishna. Along with Balarama, Sri Krishna, the personification of knowledge and bliss, came there bringing with him Abhimanyu. Later the wedding of Abhimanyu took place.

That occasion became a great festival for the Pandavas, Panchalas and the brave Yadavas. They finished the Ajnatavasa and felt great joy being accompanied by Sri Krishna.

Having been troubled greatly by Arjuna in the war, Duryodhana and the others got together with Karna, Shakuni, Bhishma and the others at Hastinapura and engaged in a discussion.

units.sanskrit:
अज्ञातवासे फल्गुनो नोऽद्य दृष्टस्तस्मात् पुनर्यान्तु पार्था वनाय।
इति ब्रुवाणानाह भीष्मोऽभ्यतीतमज्ञातवासं द्रोण आहैवमेव ॥ २३/५४॥
तयोर्वाक्यं ते त्वनादृत्य पापा वनं पार्थाः पुनरेव प्रयान्तु।
इति स्म दूतं प्रेषयामासुरत्र जानन्ति विप्रा इति धर्मजोऽवदत् ॥ २३/५५॥
सौरमासानुसारेण धार्तराष्ट्रा अपूर्णताम्।
आहुश्‍चान्द्रेण मासेन पूर्णः कालोऽखिलोऽप्यसौ ॥ २३/५६॥
दिनानामधिपः सूर्यः पक्षमासाब्दपः शशी।
तस्मात् सौम्याब्दमेवात्र मुख्यमाहुर्मनीषिणः ॥ २३/५७॥
सौम्यं कालं ततो यज्ञे गृह्णन्ति नतु सूर्यजम्।
तदेतदविचार्यैव लोभाच्च धृतराष्ट्रजैः ॥ २३/५८॥
राज्यंं न दत्तं पार्थेभ्यः पार्थाः कालस्य पूर्णताम्।
ख्यापयन्तो विप्रवरैरुपप्लाव्यमुपाययुः ॥ २३/५९॥
सवासुदेवा अखिलैश्‍च यादवैः पाञ्चालमात्स्यैश्‍च युताः सभार्याः।
उपप्लाव्ये ते कतिचिद् दिनानि वासं चक्रुः कृष्णसंशिक्षितार्थाः ॥ २३/६०॥
॥ इति श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्यविरचिते श्रीमन्महाभारततात्पर्यनिर्णये विराटपर्वकथानिरूपणं नाम त्रयोविंशोऽध्यायः॥
units.english:
When the Kauravas claimed “We saw Arjuna today during the period of exile. Therefore, the Pandavas must go back to exile once again”, Bhishma replied – “The Ajnatavasa is over”. Drona too said the same thing.

Ignoring the words of those two, the evil Kauravas sent messengers to the Pandavas and said – “You must go back to the forest once again”. Dharmaraja, in reply, said – “The Brahmanas know this”.

The Kauravas made the claim based on the solar calendar, as per which the period (of exile) had not yet completed. However, according to the lunar calendar, the said period had been completed.

Surya is the lord of the day. When it comes to the paksha, masa and varsha, Chandra is the lord. Therefore, the knowledgeable ones say that the lunar year is the important (relevant i.e.) one for calculating years.

Therefore, in Yajnas, it is the lunar calendar that is considered and not the solar one. Without considering all this, the Kauravas, seized by greed, did not hand over the Kingdom to the Pandavas. Getting the Brahmanas to declare that the Ajnatavasa had been completed successfully, the Pandavas left for Upaplavya.

The Pandavas, accompanied by Sri Vasudeva and all the Yadavas, Panchalas and Matsyas, stayed at Upaplavya for a few days, along with their wives, while receiving instructions from Sri Krishna. Nirnaya, composed by Srimadanandatirtha Bhagavatpada ||

units.sanskrit:
ॐ॥ ततः सम्मन्त्र्यानुमते कृष्णस्य स्वपुरोहितम्।
द्रुपदः प्रेषयामास धृतराष्ट्राय शान्तये॥ २४/१॥
स गत्वा धृतराष्ट्रं तं भीष्मद्रोणादिभिर्युतम्।
उवाच न विरोधस्त उत्पाद्यो धर्मसूनुना॥ २४/२॥
यस्य भीमार्जुनौ योधौ नेता यस्य जनार्दनः।
श्रुतास्ते भीमनिहता जरासन्धादयोऽखिलाः॥ २४/३॥
यथा च रुद्रवचनादवध्या राक्षसाधिपाः।
तीर्थविघ्नकराः सर्वे तीर्थान्याच्छाद्य संस्थिताः॥ २४/४॥
तिस्रः कोट्यो महावीर्या भीमेनैव निषूदिताः।
भ्रातॄणां ब्राह्मणानां च लोकानां च हितैषिणा॥ २४/५॥
ततो हि सर्वतीर्थानि गम्यान्यासन् नृणां क्षितौ।
यथा जटासुरः पापः शर्वाणीवरसंश्रयात्॥ २४/६॥
अवध्यो विप्ररूपेण वञ्चयन्नेव पाण्डवान्।
ज्ञात्वाऽपि भीमसेनेन विप्ररूपस्य नो वधः॥ २४/७॥
योग्य इत्यहतो भीमे मृगयार्थं गते क्वचित्।
यमौ युधिष्ठिरं कृष्णां चादायैव पराद्रवत्॥ २४/८॥
दृष्टो भीमेन तांस्त्यक्त्वा संसक्तस्तेन सङ्गरे।
निपात्य भूमौ पादेन सञ्चूर्णितशिरास्तमः॥ २४/९॥
जगाम किमु ते पुत्राः शक्या हन्तुमिति स्म ह।
निवातकवचाश्‍चैव हताः पार्थेन ते श्रुताः॥ २४/१०॥
जानासि च हरेर्वीर्यं यस्येदमखिलं वशे।
सब्रह्मरुद्रशक्राद्यं चेतनाचेतनात्मकम्॥ २४/११॥
तस्मादेतैः पालितस्य धर्मजस्य स्वकं वसु।
दीयतामिति तेनोक्तो धृतराष्ट्रो नचाकरोत्॥ २४/१२॥
units.english:
Later, after discussions and having obtained the permission of Sri Krishna, King Drupada sent his purohita to Dhritharashtra for negotiations.

Drupada’s purohita went to Hastinapura and addressed Dhritharashtra, who was seated along with Bhishma, Drona and the others. He said – “It is not good for you to oppose Dharmaraja”.

“Bhima and Arjuna are the warriors-in-chief for Yudhisthira. Sri Krishna is their leader. You have anyways heard the news of Jarasandha and others being killed by Bhima”.

“Due to the boon of invincibility from Shiva, three crore great Rakshasas had occupied all the Tirthakshetras and were causing obstacles for Tirthayatras. Bhimasena, desiring the welfare of his brothers, the Brahmanas and the entire world, killed all those brave ones. Due to this, all the Tirthakshetras on Earth are now approachable by humans”.

“The sinner Jatasura had become invincible by taking refuge in the boon of Parvati. By putting on the guise of a Brahmana, he stayed with the Pandavas, all the while cheating them”.

“In spite of knowing that he was an Asura, Bhima had not killed him as he was appearing as a Brahmana. Once, when Bhima had gone hunting, he captured Dharmaraja, the twins and Draupadi, and started running. When he saw Bhima, he released them and started battling Bhima. Pulling him down on the ground, Bhima crushed his head with his foot. He departed to Andhantamas. (This being the case,) Should I explicitly say he (Bhima) is capable of slaying your sons? You would have also heard that the Nivachakavachas were killed by Arjuna”.

“On the other hand, you anyways know the capability of Sri Hari. This entire world, including sentient and insentient beings, along with Brahma, Shiva, Indra and the others are all under his control”.

“Therefore you return back the wealth to Dharmaraja, who is looked after by these people”. Even when he spoke thus, Dhritharashtra did not do as requested.

units.sanskrit:
ततः सहैव यदुभिः कृष्णं द्वारवतीं गतम्।
युद्धसाहाय्यमिच्छन्तौ धार्तराष्ट्रधनञ्जयौ॥ २४/१३॥
युगपद् ययतुस्तत्र वेगेनाजयदर्जुनम्।
दुर्योधनः शिरस्थान आसीनोऽभूद्धरेस्तदा॥ २४/१४॥
दर्पान्नाहं राजराज उपास्ये पादयोरिति।
तयोरागमनं पूर्वं ज्ञात्वैव हि हरिः प्रभुः॥ २४/१५॥
असुप्तः सुप्तवच्छिश्ये तत्रातिष्ठद् धनञ्जयः।
प्रणम्य पादयोः प्रह्वो भक्त्युद्रेकात् कृताञ्जलिः॥ २४/१६॥
तमैक्षत् प्रथमं देवो जानन्नपि सुयोधनम्।
स्वागतं फल्गुनेत्युक्ते पूर्वमागामहं त्विति॥ २४/१७॥
आह दुर्योधनस्तं च स्वागतेनाभ्यपूजयत्।
तयोरागमने हेतुं श्रुत्वा प्राह जनार्दनः॥ २४/१८॥
एकः पूर्वागतोऽत्रान्यः पूर्वदृष्टो मया यतः।
समं करिष्ये युवयोरेकत्राहं निरायुधः॥ २४/१९॥
अन्यत्र दशलक्षं मे पुत्राः शूराः पदातयः।
इत्युक्ते फल्गुनः कृष्णं वव्रे तद्भक्तिमान् यतः॥ २४/२०॥
अन्यस्तत्राभक्तिमत्त्वाद् वव्रे गोपान् प्रयुद्ध्यतः।
पार्थानामेव साहाय्यं करिष्यन्नपि केशवः॥ २४/२१॥
तस्याभक्तिं दर्शयितुं चक्रे समवदीश्‍वरः।
ततः पार्थेन सहितः पाण्डवान् केशवो ययौ॥ २४/२२॥
units.english:
Later both Arjuna and Duryodhana left at the same time to meet Sri Krishna, who had left for Dwaravati along with the Yadavas, in order to seek help for the war. Duryodhana outpaced Arjuna.

“I being the King of Kings cannot sit by the feet” – thinking thus Duryodhana sat near the head of Sri Krishna, with great ego.

Sri Krishna, being the omniscient and all-capable one, knew of their impending arrival. Although being the one without sleep, he acted as if he was sleeping. Arjuna bowed to Sri Krishna’s feet and, out of excessive Bhakti, stood near his feet with folded hands.

Lord Sri Krishna, although he knew Duryodhana had arrived first, saw Arjuna and said – “Arjuna! Welcome!”. When he said thus, Duryodhana spoke – “I came here first”. Sri Krishna welcomed him too and offered him hospitality.

Getting to know of the reason for their arrival, Sri Krishna said – “One of you came first. (But) I saw the other one first. Therefore, I shall offer equal help to both of you. On one side it shall be me without any weapons. On the other side will be ten lakh brave sons of mine as soldiers”.

When Sri Krishna said thus, Arjuna selected Sri Krishna himself. This was due to his deep Bhakti in him. Duryodhana, being devotion-less, selected the sons (Gopas) of Sri Krishna who would take part in battle.

Although Sri Krishna would help only the Pandavas, he acted as if he would treat both of them equally in order to show (the world) that Duryodhana had no Bhakti in him. Later, Sri Krishna proceeded towards the Pandavas, along with Arjuna.

units.sanskrit:
दुर्योधनो ययौ रामं स भयात् केशवस्य च।
न साहाय्यं करोमीति प्राह तत्स्नेहवानपि॥ २४/२३॥
उपप्लाव्ये सभायां हि तत्पक्षीयं वचो ब्रुवन्।
निराकृतः सात्यकिना समक्षं केशवस्य च॥ २४/२४॥
ततो दुर्योधनं नायात् ----- ----- -----
units.english:
Duryodhana went to Balarama. Although he possessed friendship towards him, Balarama said “I cannot help you” due to fear of Sri Krishna.

At Upaplavya when Balarama had spoken in support of Duryodhana in the gathering, Satyaki had refuted him in front of Sri Krishna himself.

units.sanskrit:
----- ----- ----- स च हार्दिक्यसंयुतः।
जगाम हस्तिनपुरमक्षौहिण्यो दशाभवन् ॥ २४/२५॥
एका च धार्तराष्ट्रस्य नानादेश्यैर्नृपैर्युताः।
सप्त पाण्डुसुतानां च मात्स्यद्रुपदकैकयैः ॥ २४/२६॥
धृष्टकेतुजरासन्धसुतकाशीनृपैर्युताः।
पुरुजित् कुन्तिभोजश्‍च चेकितानश्‍च सात्यकिः ॥ २४/२७॥
पाण्डवान् सेनया युक्ताः समीयुर्देवपक्षिणः।
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ जयत्सेनोऽन्यकैकयाः ॥ २४/२८॥
क्षेमधूर्तिर्दण्डधरः कलिङ्गोऽम्बष्ठ एव च।
श्रुतायुरच्युतायुश्‍च बृहद्बलसुदक्षिणौ ॥ २४/२९॥
श्रुतायुधः सैन्धवश्‍च राक्षसोऽलम्बुसस्तथा।
अलायुधोऽलम्बलश्‍च दैत्या दुर्योधनं ययुः ॥ २४/३०॥
गत्वा दुर्योधनाहूतो भगदत्तोऽपि तं ययौ।
सपुत्रपौत्रो बाह्लीको भीष्मद्रोणकृपा अपि ॥ २४/३१॥
प्रीत्यर्थं धृतराष्ट्रस्य बभूवुस्तत्सुतानुगाः।
पाण्ड्यश्‍च वीरसेनाख्यः पाण्डवानेव संश्रितः ॥ २४/३२॥
units.english:
Therefore, he did not go with Duryodhana. Along with Krutavarma, Duryodhana left for Hastinapura. Bringing together the Kings of many nations, Duryodhana gathered an army of eleven Akshouhinis.

The army of the Pandavas became seven Akshouhinis in size as Virata, Drupada, Kekaya, Dhrishtaketu, Sahadeva – the son of Jarasandha and the King of Kashi joined them.

Purujit, Kuntibhoja, Chekitana, Satyaki and all the others who were on the side of the Devatas moved towards the Pandavas along with their armies.

Vinda and Anuvinda from the Avanti country, Jayatsena, the other Kekayas, Kshemadhoorti, Dandadhara, Kalinga, Ambashta, Shrutayu, Achyutayu, Bruhadbala, Sudakshina, Shrutayudha, Jayadratha, the Rakshasas Alambusha, Alayudha and Alambala and all the other Daityas took the side of Duryodhana. Since he was personally invited by Duryodhana, Bhagadatta joined him.

Bahlika along with his sons and grandsons, Bhishma, Drona and Kripa joined Duryodhana in order to please Dhritharashtra. Veerasena, the King of Pandya country, took the side of the Pandavas.

units.sanskrit:
शल्यं च पाण्डवानेव यान्तं ज्ञात्वा सुयोधनः।
सुसभाः कारयामास सर्वभोगसमन्विताः ॥ २४/३३॥
ता युधिष्ठिरकॢप्ताः स मत्वा शल्योऽब्रवीदिदम्।
य एताः कारयामास तदभीष्टं करोम्यहम् ॥ २४/३४॥
लीनः श्रुत्वा धार्तराष्ट्रः सत्यं कुर्वित्यभाषत।
देहि मे युद्धसाहाय्यमिति सोऽपि यशोऽर्थयन् ॥ २४/३५॥
रक्षार्थमात्मवाक्यस्य तथेत्येवाभ्यभाषत।
स पाण्डवांस्ततो गत्वा तैरनुज्ञात एव च ॥ २४/३६॥
तेजोवधार्थं कर्णस्य धनञ्जयकृतेऽर्थितः।
तथेत्युक्त्वा ययौ धर्मनन्दनं कौरवान् प्रति ॥ २४/३७॥
सञ्जयं प्रेषयामास धृतराष्ट्रोऽथ शान्तये।
पाण्डवान् प्रत्यधर्मं च युद्धं स प्रत्यपादयत् ॥ २४/३८॥
हठवादेऽवदद् भीमो यं धर्मं द्रौपदी तथा।
तमेवोक्त्वा धर्मजस्तु चकार च निरुत्तरम् ॥ २४/३९॥
कृष्णोऽपि तस्य धर्मस्य प्रामाण्यं प्रत्यपादयत्।
ततो निरुत्तरः कृष्णं पाण्डवांश्‍च प्रणम्य सः ॥ २४/४०॥
units.english:
Learning of Shalya’s march towards the Pandava camp, Duryodhana arranged excellent rest houses throughout the route, all of which were full of material luxuries.

Assuming that Yudhishthira had arranged all of those, Shalya said – “I shall fulfill the desire of the one who has arranged these”.

Listening to those words, the hiding Duryodhana came out and said – “Make your words come true. Help me in the war”. Shalya, in order to increase his fame, and to keep his word, said – “May it be so”.

Later Shalya went to the Pandavas and obtained their consent. When Dharmaraja asked him to denigrate Karna for the sake of Arjuna, he said yes and went to the Kaurava camp.

Later Dhritharashtra sent Sanjaya to the Pandavas in order to negotiate. Sanjaya argued that it was against Dharma to engage in war.

In the intense debate that ensued, Dharmaraja spoke about the Dharma that Bhima and Draupadi had taught him (in the forest) and rendered Sanjaya speechless. Sri Krishna too spoke about the genuineness of war.

Sanjaya, who could not counter the arguments, bowed to Sri Krishna and the Pandavas and returned to Dhritharashtra. Having returned that way, he berated Dhritharashtra and went home.

units.sanskrit:
धृतराष्ट्रं ययौ तं च विनिन्द्य प्रययौ गृहम्।

निन्दितः सञ्जयेनासावाहूय विदुरं निशि ॥ २४/४१॥
पप्रच्छ सोऽवदद् धर्मं पार्थानां राज्यदापनम्।
ऐहिकस्य सुखस्यापि कारणं तदनिन्दितम् ॥ २४/४२॥
अन्यथा सर्वपुत्राणां नाशं धर्मातिलङ्घनम्।

तत्र भावमकृत्वा स ज्ञानादिच्छन्नघक्षयम् ॥ २४/४३॥
विष्णोः स्वरूपं पप्रच्छ सोऽस्मरच्च सनातनम्
स आगत्यावदत् तत्त्वं विष्णोर्मायाविनः शुभा ॥ २४/४४॥
न गतिश्‍चेत्यथ प्रातः सञ्जयः पाण्डवोदितम्।
अवदद् धृतराष्ट्राय सभायां कुरुसन्निधौ ॥ २४/४५॥
तच्छ्रुत्वा स तु भीतोऽपि पुत्रस्नेहानुगो नृपः।

राज्यं नादात् पाण्डवानां ततो धर्मसुतो नृपः ॥ २४/४६॥
यदुक्तवान् सञ्जयाय यदि दित्सति नः पिता।
राज्यं तदा त्वमागच्छ विदुरो वा न चेन्नच ॥ २४/४७॥
तावथानागतौ ज्ञात्वा मन्त्रयामास शौरिणा।
सोऽप्याहाहं गमिष्यामि सभायामृषिसन्निधौ ॥ २४/४८॥
units.english:
Having been insulted that way by Sanjaya, Dhritharashtra called Vidura at night and asked him questions about Dharma. Then, Vidura advised him that it was Dharma to hand over the Kingdom to the Parthas.

“Handing over the Kingdom to the Pandavas will ensure happiness in this world. It will also avoid condemnation. If you do not do so, Dharma will be violated and it will lead to the destruction of all your sons”.

Not inclining towards that, Dhritharashtra, in order to rid himself of the sin of hating Pandavas by obtaining the knowledge of Brahman, asked him the truth about Sri Vishnu. Vidura then remembered Sage Sanatana.

Sage Sanatsujata arrived there and instructed him about the essence of Sri Vishnu. He also told him that a charlatan would never attain Sadgati. The next day, in the morning gathering, Sanjaya conveyed the message of the Pandavas in front of all the Kauravas. Note: Sanatsujata was also known by the name of Sanatana.

Listening to it, Dhritharashtra, although overcome by fear, did not hand over the Kingdom out of attachment towards his son. King Yudhisthira had earlier told Sanjaya – “If our father is ready to hand over the Kingdom, you or Vidura may come here. Otherwise there is no need”.

units.sanskrit:
वक्ष्ये पथ्यानि युक्तानि यदि नासौ ग्रहीष्यति।
वध्यः सर्वस्य लोकस्य स भवेत् सर्वधर्महा ॥ २४/४९॥
इत्युक्तो वैरमात्मोत्थं लोकमध्ये प्रहापयन्।
लोकसङ्ग्रहणार्थाय भीमसेनोऽब्रवीद् वचः ॥ २४/५०॥
नास्मन्निमित्तनाशः स्यात् कुलस्यापि वयं कुलम्।
रक्षितुं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य भवेमाधश्‍चरा इति ॥ २४/५१॥
इच्छताऽप्यखिलान् हन्तुं धार्तराष्ट्रान् दृढात्मना।
भीमेनोक्तो वासुदेवो लोकसङ्ग्रहणेच्छया ॥ २४/५२॥
वधं तेषां धर्ममेव लोके ख्यापयितुं हरिः।
आक्षिपन्निव भीमं तं युद्धाय प्रैरयद् दृढम् ॥ २४/५३॥
अभिप्रायं केशवस्य जानन् भीमो निजं बलम्।
राज्ञां मध्येऽवदत् तच्च कृष्णोऽभ्यधिकमेव हि ॥ २४/५४॥
शशंस सत्यैः सद्वाक्यै राज्ञां मध्ये प्रकाशयन्।
वधं कुरूणां सद्धर्मं गुणान् भीमस्य चामितान् ॥ २४/५५॥
नित्यमेकमनस्कौ तावपि केशवमारुती।
एवं लोकस्य संवादहेतोः संवादमक्रताम् ॥ २४/५६॥
units.english:
Noticing that the two of them did not arrive, he conducted discussions with Sri Krishna. Then, Sri Shouri said – “I shall go. Amidst all Rishis in that gathering, I shall speak appropriately. If he still doesn’t accept them, then Duryodhana would become deserving of being killed in the eyes of all people, for having betrayed Dharma”.

When Sri Krishna spoke thus, Bhimasena, in order to prevent the accusation of having started the enmity, spoke thus in order to teach all others.

“Because of my excuse, let our lineage not get destroyed. In order to protect our clan, we shall walk below Duryodhana”.

Although he had firmly decided to slay all the Kauravas, Bhimasena spoke in this fashion desiring to show the way of the world.

Appearing to object to Bhima, Sri Krishna motivated him for war, in order to show the world that the destruction of the Kauravas was Dharma indeed.

Having understood the mentality of Sri Krishna, Bhima then narrated his real capabilities in front of the Kings. Sri Krishna endorsed it by saying that his strength was much more.

Amidst those Kings, Sri Krishna illuminated the facts, through excellent truth-revealing words, that the killing of Kauravas was excellent Dharma, and that the qualities of Bhima were unlimited.

Sri Krishna and Bhima possessed similar attitude always (on all matters). However, in order to cause everyone to firmly believe this, the two of them engaged in such an artificial debate. Note: Through this staged debate, Sri Krishna and Bhima convinced everyone that the two of them had the same outlook towards all matters regarding Dharma.

units.sanskrit:
ततः कृष्णोऽर्जुनं चैव कृपालुं सन्धिकामुकम्।
हेतुमद्भिः शुभैर्वाक्यैरनुनीय जगत्पतिः ॥ २४/५७॥
उक्तो मानुषया बुद्ध्या नकुलेन सुनीतिवत्।
शौर्यप्रकाशनायैव युद्धं योजयताद् भवान् ॥ २४/५८॥
इत्युक्तः सहदेवेन युयुधानेन चाच्युतः।
दस्यूनां निग्रहो धर्मः क्षत्रियाणां यतः परः ॥ २४/५९॥
अतो न धार्तराष्ट्रैर्नः सन्धिः स्यादिति पार्षती।
जगाद कृष्णं सोऽप्येनामोमित्युक्त्वा विनिर्ययौ ॥ २४/६०॥
ससात्यकिः स्यन्दनवर्यसंस्थितः पृथातनूजैरखिलैः स भूमिपैः।
अन्वागतो दूरतरं गिरा तान् संस्थाप्य विप्रप्रवरैः कुरून् ययौ ॥ २४/६१॥
एकोऽपि विष्णुः स तु भार्गवात्मा व्यासात्मकश्‍चानुगतो मुनीन्द्रैः।
ययौ तदुक्तेर्हि गुणान् प्रवेत्तुं नान्यो हि शक्तस्तमृते यतः प्रभुम् ॥ २४/६२॥
स वन्द्यमानोऽखिलराष्ट्रवासिभिः प्रसूनवर्षैरभिवर्षितः सुरैः।
संस्तूयमानः प्रणतोऽब्जजादिभिर्गजाह्वयं प्राप परोऽप्रमेयः ॥ २४/६३॥
स भीष्ममुख्यैः सरसाभियातः सहैव तैः प्रययौ राजमार्गे।
दिदृक्षवस्तं जगदेकसुन्दरं गुणार्णवं प्राययुरत्र सर्वे ॥ २४/६४॥
units.english:
Later Sri Krishna calmed down Arjuna, who wanted peace, through auspicious words filled with reasoning and logic. Nakula then spoke like a strategist, thinking of him, the lord of the world (Sri Krishna), as a mere mortal.

Sahadeva then asked for the war to be arranged, wanting to show his valour. Satyaki too gave the same suggestion.

Draupadi then said to Sri Krishna – “It is the foremost Dharma of Kshatriyas to bring Dasyus under control. Therefore, there should never be an agreement with the Kauravas”. Sri Krishna too gave her his word saying “May it be so” and left.

Sri Krishna, who sat in an excellent chariot along with Satyaki, was escorted by the Pandavas and other Kings for a very long distance. Sri Krishna then stopped them with his words and went to meet the Kauravas, along with the best of Brahmanas.

Along with the Sages, Sri Hari in the form of Parashurama and Vyasa also accompanied him and proceeded (towards Hastinapura). Although he is the same Vishnu (in all three forms), it isn’t possible for anyone else apart from him to understand the infinite qualities of his words.

Throughout the way, Sri Krishna was worshipped by the citizens of the country. Brahma and the other Devatas showered flowers on him and bowed to him and praised him profusely. Sri Krishna, the one beyond the grasp of knowledge and the supreme one, reached Hastinapura.

Sri Krishna was received with great devotion by Bhishma and the others. He walked along with them on the royal pathway. Desiring to see Sri Krishna, the most beautiful one on Earth and the ocean of auspicious attributes, all the citizens rushed there.

units.sanskrit:
सम्भावितस्तैः परमादरेण विवेश गेहं नृपतेरनन्तः।
स भीष्ममुख्यान् पुरतो निधाय वैचित्रवीर्येण समर्चितोऽजः ॥ २४/६५॥
रौक्मे निषण्णः परमासने प्रभुर्बभौ स्वभासा ककुभोऽवभासयन्।
यथोचितं तेषु विधाय केशवो दौर्योधनं प्राप्य गृहं च पूजितः ॥ २४/६६॥
पूजां तदीयां गुणवद्द्विडित्यसौ जग्राह नो विदुरं चाजगाम।
स भीष्मपूर्वैरभियाचितोऽपि जगाम नैषां गृहमादिदेवः ॥ २४/६७॥
उपेक्षिता द्रौपदीत्यप्रमेयो जगाम गेहं विदुरस्य शीघ्रम्।
स तेन भक्त्याऽभिगतः प्रसन्नः प्रविश्य चान्तर्गृहमीश्‍वरोऽजः।
भक्त्याऽभिपूर्णेन ससम्भ्रमेण सम्पूजितः सर्वसमर्पणेन ॥ २४/६८॥
परे दिनेऽसौ धृतराष्ट्रसूनुना समानीतः संसदि कौरवाणाम्।
विवेश दिव्ये मणिकाञ्चनासने सार्द्धं मुनीन्द्रैः परमार्थवेदिभिः ॥ २४/६९॥
सम्पूजितो भीष्ममुखैः समस्तै रराज राजीवसमाननेत्रः।
यथोचितास्तत्र विधाय वार्ता जगाद काले कलिकल्मषापहः ॥ २४/७०॥
वैचित्रवीर्य स्वकुलस्य वृद्ध्यै प्रदेहि राज्यं तव सत्सुताय।
यशश्‍च धर्मं परमं प्रसादं मम त्वमाप्नोषि तदैव राजन् ॥ २४/७१॥
अतोऽन्यथा यशसो धर्मतश्‍च हीनः प्रतीपत्वमुपैषि मेऽतः।
इतीरितः प्राह ममातिवर्तिनं सुतं स्वयं मे प्रतिबोधयेति ॥ २४/७२॥
units.english:
Being offered great respect filled with devotion by all of them, the eternal one went to Dhritharashtra’s house. Led by Bhishma and others, Dhritharashtra performed special worship of Sri Krishna. Being seated on a golden throne, he was radiant, illuminating all the directions with his shine.

Conducting appropriate interaction with all of them, Sri Krishna went to Duryodhana’s house. He too offered respects to Sri Krishna. But he rejected that worship as Duryodhana was the enemy of the noble Pandavas. He proceeded to Vidura’s house.

In spite of repeated requests from Bhishma and others, Sri Krishna, the primordial lord, did not go to their houses. Their neglect of Draupadi was the reason behind this. The indiscernible one immediately proceeded to Vidura’s house.

Being very pleased with the devotion filled welcome of Vidura, Sri Krishna entered his house. Vidura worshipped him with great excitement and with full devotion, and offered him everything.

The next day, Duryodhana escorted Sri Krishna to the gathering of the Kauravas. Being seated amidst the best of the Sages on a gem-studded golden divine seat, Sri Krishna put forth (his proposal).

Sri Krishna, the reliever of Kali’s influence and the one with lotus-eyes, was worshipped well by Bhishma and the others and appeared radiant. After exchanging appropriate pleasantries with them, he spoke at the appropriate time.

“O Dhritharashtra! For the sake of your family’s welfare, hand over the Kingdom to your son Dharmaraja. Only then will you gather fame, punya and my foremost grace”.

“If you do not do so, you will lose fame and punya. And you will become my opponent” – when Sri Krishna spoke thus, Dhritharashtra replied – “You yourself advise my son as he always violates my words”.

units.sanskrit:
स वासुदेवेन विबोधितोऽपि पापाभिसन्धिर्धृतराष्ट्रसूनुः।
उत्थाय तस्मादनुजैरमात्यैर्नियन्तुमीशं कुमतिर्व्यधान्मतिम् ॥ २४/७३॥
येये तदा केशवसंयमाय न्यमन्त्रयंस्ते विबुधप्रतीपाः।
अतो विकर्णप्रमुखा अपि स्म वध्यत्वमायन्नशुभां गतिं च ॥ २४/७४॥
कर्णः सुरांशोऽपि सुयोधनार्थे न्यमन्त्रयद् भावतो नैव दुष्टः।
अतो गतिश्‍चास्य सुशोभनाऽभूद् येऽत्रानुकूलाः परमस्य ते शुभाः ॥ २४/७५॥
ऋषिभिर्जामदग्न्येन व्यासेनाप्यमितौजसा।
वासुदेवात्मकेनैवं त्रिरूपेणैव विष्णुना ॥ २४/७६॥
मातापितृभ्यां भीष्माद्यैरनुशिष्टोऽपि दुर्मतिः।
दुर्योधनो मन्त्रयते मुकुन्दस्यानुबन्धनम् ॥ २४/७७॥
सात्यकिः कृतवर्मा च तच्छुश्रुवतुरञ्जसा।
संस्थाप्य कृतवर्माणं रहः सात्यकिरत्र च।
अभ्येत्य केशवं प्राह दुर्योधनविनिश्‍चयम् ॥ २४/७८॥
जानन्नप्यखिलं कृष्णस्तच्छ्रुत्वा सात्यकेर्मुखात्।
वैचित्रवीर्यमवदत् पश्य मामिति सर्वगम् ॥ २४/७९॥
अथ तेनाहुते पुत्रे सामात्ये पुरुषोत्तमः।
स्वरूपं दर्शयामास सर्वगं पूर्णषड्गुणम् ॥ २४/८०॥
units.english:
In spite of being advised especially by Sri Vasudeva, the evil-minded Duryodhana got up along with his brothers and ministers and made up his mind to imprison the all-mighty Sri Krishna.

All those who thought about imprisoning Sri Krishna at that moment were the opponents of Devatas. Therefore, all of them, including Vikarna, became fit for being slayed. They voided themselves of an auspicious ending.

Karna, although being the personification of a Devata, possessed the Avesha of an Asura and engaged in that plan for the sake of Duryodhana. By character he was not evil. Therefore, he obtained a noble after-life. All those who acted in accordance with Sri Krishna there were of noble character.

In spite of being advised by Rishis, Sri Parashurama, Sri Vyasa – the one possessing unlimited tejas, Sri Krishna, his parents and Bhishma and the others, the evil-minded Duryodhana went ahead with his plan to arrest Sri Krishna.

Satyaki and Krutavarma heard the plan of arresting Sri Krishna very clearly. Satyaki made Krutavarma stand elsewhere and met Sri Krishna alone and informed him of Duryodhana’s evil thinking.

Sri Krishna, although omniscient, heard that plan from the mouth of Satyaki and told the son of Vichitravirya – “Watch my omnipresent form”.

Then, as Dhritharashtra called Duryodhana along with his ministers over there, Sri Krishna, the best amongst men showed his all-pervading form that was full of the six auspicious attributes. Note: Sri Mahavishnu is shad-guna-poorna – full of six auspicious qualities – dominion, might, glory, splendor, wisdom, and dispassion

units.sanskrit:
तत् कालसूर्यामितदीप्तिसर्वजगद्भरं शाश्‍वतमप्रमेयम्।
दृष्ट्वैव चक्षूंषि सुयोधनाद्या न्यमीलयन् दीधितिवारितानि ॥ २४/८१॥
पिधाय रूपं पुनरेव तद्धरिर्वैचित्रवीर्येण समर्थितः पुनः।
कृत्वाऽन्धमेव प्रययौ सुयोधनं सहानुगं पापतमं प्रकाश्य ॥ २४/८२॥
अनन्तशक्तिः पुरुषोत्तमोऽसौ शक्तोऽपि दुर्योधनचित्तनिग्रहे।
नैव व्यधादेनमथोक्तकारिणं निपातयन्नन्धतमस्यनन्तः ॥ २४/८३॥
पुनश्‍च कुन्तीगृहमेत्य कृष्णस्तथोद्योगं धर्मसुतस्य शिष्टम्।
श्रुत्वा ययौ सूर्यजमात्मयाने निधाय तस्यावददात्मजन्म ॥ २४/८४॥
आयाहि पार्थानिति तद्वचः स नैवाकरोन्मानितो धार्तराष्ट्रैः।
संस्थाप्य तं भगवान् द्रौणये च रहोऽवदन्मित्रभावं पृथाजैः ॥ २४/८५॥
यावत् पितुर्मरणं सोऽपि मैत्रीं वव्रे पार्थैस्तं च विसृज्य कृष्णः।
ययौ कुरून् पूर्वमेवोद्विसृज्य पृथासुतानां स सकाशमीशः ॥ २४/८६॥
सम्प्रार्थितः पृथया चैव कर्णः पार्थैर्योगं याहि सूनुर्ममासि।
तेनाप्युक्ता वासविना विनाऽहं हन्यां सुतांस्ते न कथञ्चनेति ॥ २४/८७॥
ततो ययुः कौरवाः पाण्डवाश्‍च कुरुक्षेत्रं योद्धुकामाः सकृष्णाः।
चक्रुश्‍च ते शिबिराण्यत्र सर्वे शुभे देशे पाण्डवाः कृष्णबुद्ध्या ॥ २४/८८॥
॥ इति श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्यविरचिते श्रीमन्महाभारततात्पर्यनिर्णये युद्धोद्योगो नाम चतुर्विंशोऽध्यायः॥
units.english:
As soon as that amazing form of Sri Krishna, that was bright like the Sun at the time of dissolution, being full of unlimited radiance, bearing the entire Universe, eternal and one that could not be understood fully was seen, Duryodhana and the others closed their eyes, being unable to bear the intensity of the radiance.

Sri Krishna took back his Vishwaroopa. After Dhritharashtra pleaded with him a lot, he made him blind as earlier. After showing the whole world that Duryodhana and his followers were great sinners, he left.

Although Sri Krishna, the one with unlimited strength and the best amongst all sentient beings, was fully capable of inspiring Duryodhana to follow his advice, he did not do so. He caused him to fall into Andhantamas.

Sri Krishna went to Kunti’s house again and listened to her message for Dharmaraja. He got Karna into his chariot and left. Narrating to him the incidents surrounding his birth, he told him – “Come to the side of Pandavas”. Having received great affection from the Kauravas, Karna did not heed his words.

Bhagavan Sri Krishna left Karna there and met Ashwathama in solitude and advised him to be friendly with the Pandavas. Ashwathama replied that he would go soft on them until his father was alive. Sri Krishna bid him farewell and, having taken leave of the Kauravas earlier itself, returned to the Pandavas.

Although Kunti repeatedly requested him saying – “You are my son. Join the Pandavas” Karna did not agree and, in turn, gave her his word saying – “Apart from Arjuna, I shall not kill any other son of yours”.

Desirous of battling (each other), both the Pandavas and the Kauravas left for Kurukshetra, along with Sri Krishna and erected their camps. The Pandavas, as instructed by Sri Krishna, put up their camps at an auspicious place. Srimadanandatirtha Bhagavatpada ||

units.sanskrit:
ॐ॥ ते सेने समरारम्भे समेते सागरोपमे।
भीमभीष्ममुखे वीक्ष्य प्राह वासविरच्युतम् ॥ २५/१॥
“सेनयोरुभयोर्मध्ये रथं स्थापय मेऽच्युत।”
इत्युक्तः स तथा चक्रे पार्थः पश्यंश्‍च बान्धवान् ॥ २५/१॥
विससर्ज धनुः पापाशङ्की तत्राह माधवः।
स्वधर्मो दुष्टनिधनं धर्मज्ञानानुपालनम् ॥ २५/३॥
क्षत्रियस्य तमुत्सृज्य निन्दितो यात्यधो ध्रुवम्।
“यतः प्रवृत्तिर्भूतानां येन सर्वमिदं ततम् ॥ २५/४॥
स्वकर्मणा तमभ्यर्च्य सिद्धिं विन्दति मानवः।”
नच शोकस्त्वया कार्यो बन्धूनां निधनेच्छया ॥ २५/५॥
देहस्य सर्वथा नाशादनाशाच्चेतनस्य च।
सृष्टिस्थित्यप्ययाज्ञानबन्धमोक्षप्रवृत्तयः ॥ २५/६॥
प्रकाशनियमौ चैव ब्रह्मेशादिक्षरस्य च।
अक्षरप्रकृतेश्चैव मत्त एव नचान्यतः ॥ २५/७॥
न मे कुतश्‍चित् सर्गाद्याः स्वातन्त्र्याद् गुणपूर्तितः।
अतः समाधिकाभावात् सर्वं मद्वशमेव च ॥ २५/८॥
units.english:
At the start of the war, looking at the two ocean-like armies assembled there under the leadership of Bhima and Bhishma, Arjuna said to Sri Krishna.

“O Achyuta! Place my chariot in the middle of the two armies” – when Arjuna requested thus, Sri Krishna did the same. Arjuna saw his relatives in both the armies. Out of the fear of sin, he gave up his bow.

Sri Krishna then said – “For Kshatriyas punishing the evil and protecting Dharma and knowledge is Swadharma. If this is forsaken then such a person shall be condemned and he shall definitely obtain the lower worlds”.

“By worshipping well through his Swadharma that Bhagavan, who is responsible for all activities of all beings and who is omnipresent, a human being attains Siddhi“. Note: Siddhi in this shloka means attainment of Moksha.

“You do not have to mourn the killing of relatives. Because the destruction of the body cannot be avoided. At the same time, the eternal Chetana can never undergo destruction”.

“It is through me alone, and not through anyone else, that the creation, maintenance, destruction, knowledge, entrapment, release, activity and restrictions on perishable beings such as Brahma, Rudra and others and the imperishable one that is Mahalakshmi, the personification of nature, takes place”. Note: Souls such as Brahma, Rudra and others come into the cycle of Samsara at the beginning of creation and attain Moksha or other appropriate states in the end during Pralaya. Their states (from bonded to released) are perishable in that sense, although the soul itself is eternal. Hence they are ‘Kshara’. Mahalakshmi is the presiding deity of Nature and she is eternal and never undergoes Samsara or any other form of modification or change. Hence she is ‘Akshara’.

“Since I possess complete independence, and since I am full of auspicious attributes, I am not subject to birth or other states through any other power. In this way, since there is none equal to or greater than me, everything is under my control”.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञात्वैषां निधनाद्यं च जीवादेरस्वतन्त्रताम्।
अस्वातन्त्र्यान्निवृत्तौ च मामनुस्मर युद्ध्य च ॥ २५/९॥
“ये तु सर्वाणि कर्माणि मयि सन्न्यस्य मत्पराः।
अनन्येनैव योगेन मां ध्यायन्त उपासते ॥ २५/१०॥
तेषामहं समुद्धर्ता मृत्युसंसारसागरात्।
भवामि न चिरात् पार्थ मय्यावेशितचेतसाम् ॥” २५/११॥
“मया ततमिदं सर्वं जगदव्यक्तमूर्तिना।
मत्स्थानि सर्वभूतानि नचाहं तेष्ववस्थितः ॥” २५/१२॥
सुपूर्णसत्सर्वगुणदेहोऽहं सर्वदा प्रभुः।
अस्पृष्टाखिलदौषैकनित्यसत्तनुरव्ययः ॥ २५/१३॥
इत्युक्तो वासविः प्राह व्याप्तं ते दर्शयेश मे।
अथ दिव्यदृशं तस्य दत्त्वा व्याप्तं निजं वपुः ॥ २५/१४॥
देशतः कालतश्‍चैव पूर्णं सर्वगुणैः सदा।
दर्शयामास भगवान् यावत्यर्जुनयोग्यता ॥ २५/१५॥
तत्प्रार्थितः पुनः कृष्णस्तद्रूपं लोकमानतः।
पूर्ववद् दर्शयामास पुनश्‍चैनमशिक्षयत् ॥ २५/१६॥
units.english:
“Realizing the (truth about) death and other states of these relatives, and the dependence of sentient and insentient beings (on me), understand that you are not independent even to quit war. Focus your thoughts on me and engage in battle”.

“He who offers all his Karma in me, who realizes that I am the Supreme One, who meditates on me through undistracted Yoga and worships me – very soon I shall surely remove such a person, who focuses his mind on me, from the ocean of death and Samsara”.

“I, being formless, pervade this entire Universe. All beings are dependent upon me, while I am not dependent upon them”.

“All complete auspicious attributes are verily my body. I am the most capable one, without any defects, possess an eternal and excellent body and suffer no destruction” – when Sri Krishna said thus Arjuna requested him – “O Lord! Show me your universal nature”.

After that, Bhagavan Sri Krishna granted Arjuna divine vision and, in accordance with his merit (yogyata), showed him his form that was omnipresent, full of auspicious attributes without the constraints of space or time and divine.

When Arjuna requested, Sri Krishna once again took on his earlier form that was in accordance with the ways of the world. He continued granting him knowledge. He revealed to him (the intricacies of) knowledge, the knowable and Prakruti. Having received such knowledge from him, Arjuna picked up his bow and arrows.

units.sanskrit:
ज्ञानज्ञेयप्रकृत्यादि ज्ञापयन् पुरुषोत्तमः।
तेनानुशिष्टः पार्थस्तु सशरं धनुराददे ॥ २५/१७॥
अथ व्यूढेष्वनीकेषु नदन् वायुसुतोऽभ्ययात्।
समितिं धार्तराष्ट्राणां ते तं सर्वेऽभ्यवारयन् ॥ २५/१८॥
ससृजुः शरवृष्टिं च भीमसेनस्य मूर्धनि।
क्षिप्रं नैव प्रहर्तव्यं ज्ञातिषु प्रहरत्स्वपि ॥ २५/१९॥
इत्येवाप्रहरत्यस्मिन् शत्रुभिः शरविक्षते।
अमुचन् धार्तराष्ट्रेषु शस्त्रवृष्टिं दुरासदाम् ॥ २५/२०॥
सौभद्रप्रमुखा वीराः सर्वे पाण्डुसुतात्मजाः।
अपीडयंस्ताञ्छस्त्रौघैर्धार्तराष्ट्राः समन्ततः ॥ २५/२१॥
ररक्ष तान् वायुसुतो विसृजञ्छरसञ्चयान्।
तत्र भीमशरैर्नुन्ना धार्तराष्ट्राः समन्ततः ॥ २५/२२॥
भग्नास्तानथ गाङ्गेयो दिव्यास्त्रविदधारयत्।

अथ द्वन्द्वानि युद्धानि बभूवुर्विजिगीषताम् ॥ २५/२३॥
द्रोणपार्षतयोश्‍चैव शैनेयकृतवर्मणोः।
दुःशासनेन वीरस्य माद्रेयस्य यवीयसः ॥ २५/२४॥
units.english:
When the war started after the armies had made their formations, Bhimasena attacked the Kaurava forces even as he let out a leonine roar. All of them tried to stop him.

They showered numerous arrows on his head. Since it was inappropriate to immediately respond to the attack of relatives, Bhima accepted those attacks without counter-attacking them. The Upapandavas (sons of Pandavas), Abhimanyu and other heroes showered unbearable number of weapons on the Kauravas.

The Kauravas, in turn, caused them pain by attacking them with weapons from all directions. Casting a shower of arrows (on the enemy), the son of Vayu rescued them.

Then, being tormented by Bhima’s arrows, the Kauravas suffered from all directions and started to flee. Bhishma, knowledgeable in divine weapons, rushed to protect them.

Later, desirous of victory over each other, duels between Drona-Dhrishtadyumna, Satyaki- Krutavarma and other heroes started taking place.

units.sanskrit:
नकुलस्य विकर्णस्य कार्ष्णेयैर्दुर्मुखादिनाम्।
वृत्ते द्वन्द्वमहायुद्धे तत्र धर्मजपक्षगाः ॥ २५/२५॥
जिता विनैव शैनेयं सोऽजयद्धृदिकात्मजम्।

अथ भीष्मद्रोणमुखैर्भगदत्तादिभिस्तथा ॥ २५/२६॥
विद्राव्यमाणं स्वबलं स्थापयामास मारुतिः।
द्रोणं च भगदत्तं च कृपं दुर्योधनं तथा ॥ २५/२७॥
केवलं बाहुवीर्येण व्यजयद् भीमविक्रमः।

हत्वोत्तरं मद्रराजो व्यद्रावयदनीकिनीम् ॥ २५/२८॥
अथ भीष्ममुदीर्णास्त्रं द्रावयन्तं वरूथिनीम्।
ससौमदत्तिं सौभद्रसहायोऽर्जुन आसदत् ॥ २५/२९॥
सौभद्रं तत्र विक्रान्तमतीत्य द्युसरित्सुतः।
द्रावयामास पाञ्चालान् पश्यतः सव्यसाचिनः ॥ २५/३०॥
तस्य विक्रममालक्ष्य पार्थं तद्गौरवानुगम्।
दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरो राजा क्रुद्धः सेनामपाहरत् ॥ २५/३१॥
रात्रौ युधिष्ठिरश्‍चिन्तामाप्य पार्थं व्यगर्हयत्।

स कृष्णाद्यैः सान्त्वितश्‍च पुनर्युद्धाय निर्ययौ ॥ २५/३२॥
units.english:
When duels started taking place between Dushashana and the younger son of Madri (Sahadeva), Nakula and Vikarna and the Upapandavas and Durmukha and the rest, except Satyaki all the others from the Pandava camp suffered defeats. Satyaki defeated Krutavarma.

After that, even as Bhishma, Drona and the others and similarly Bhagadatta and others were chasing away the (Pandava) army, Bhima stopped them.

Relying only on the power of his shoulders, that terrifying warrior Bhima defeated Drona, Bhagadatta, Krupa and Duryodhana. Note: The term ‘power of the shoulders’ is used often to indicate warfare with material weapons, without relying upon divine astras. The term is not restricted to just physical prowess.

Shalya killed Uttara and chased away the army. After that, Arjuna and Abhimanyu faced Bhishma and Bhurishravas, who were chasing away the army by making use of great astras.

Bhishma moved ahead of the always-valorous Abhimanyu and started chasing away the Panchalas, even as Arjuna watched him.

Dharmaraja noticed the great heroics of Bhishma, and also the soft approach of Arjuna towards him, and withdrew the army in anger.

During the night, Yudhisthira became very worried and berated Arjuna. Sri Krishna and the others consoled him. He again left for battle. Note: He left for the battleground on the second morning.

units.sanskrit:
एवं भीष्मो दशाहानि सेनापत्यं चकार ह।
कृत्वा तु पाण्डवैर्युद्धं तत् कर्तुमकृतोपमम् ॥ २५/३३॥
कर्णोऽर्धरथ इत्युक्त्वा तावद् युद्धात् प्रयापितः।
यावत् त्वं योत्स्यसे तावन्न योत्स्यामीति निर्गते ॥ २५/३४॥
कर्णेऽयुतरथानां च नित्यशो वधमाहवे।
प्रतिजज्ञेऽकरोत् तच्च पुनश्‍चास्त्रविदां वरः ॥ २५/३५॥
सुसमर्थावपि वधे तस्य भीमधनञ्जयौ।
स्नेहेन यन्त्रितौ तस्य गौरवाच्चान्ववर्तताम् ॥ २५/३६॥
