बभूवुस्तत्र युद्धानि चित्राणि सुबहूनि च।
तान्यम्बरे विमानस्था ब्रह्मरुद्रपुरःसराः ॥ २५/३७॥
अपश्यन् देवताः सर्वा गन्धर्वाप्सरसोऽसुराः।

धृष्टद्युम्नो महेष्वासः प्रतिव्यूह्यापगासुतम् ॥ २५/३८॥
चक्रे युद्धानि सुबहून्यजेयः शत्रुभी रणे।

तत्रोद्दधार कृष्णोऽपि फल्गुनं मृदुयोधिनम् ॥ २५/३९॥
दृष्ट्वा चक्रं तथोद्यम्य बाहुं भीष्माय जग्मिवान्।
तेन स्तुतो गृहीतश्‍च फल्गुनेन प्रणम्य च ॥ २५/४०॥
units.english:
In this way, Bhishma commandeered the army for ten days and fought against the Pandavas. What he did was impossible for the others to emulate.

Having been classified as an ardha-ratha by Bhishma, Karna had not participated in the war. After Karna departed saying “I shall not participate in the war until you are doing so” Bhishma made a vow that he would kill ten thousand chariot-warriors every day. That best amongst the knowers of astras did fulfill his vow too.

Although Bhima and Arjuna were capable of killing Bhishma, they stopped (themselves) out of love for him. Out of respect for him, they acted favourably towards him (in the war).

Many thrilling battles took place there. Seated in their planes, Brahma, Rudra and the other Devatas, all the Gandharvas, Apsaras and Asuras viewed them from the skies.

Dhrishtadyumna, the best amongst archers, prepared vyuhas countering those prepared by Bhishma. Being undefeated against his enemies, he fought many battles. Thereafter, noticing Arjuna fighting softly, Sri Krishna picked up the Chakra in his hand and proceeded towards Bhishma. Note: This was on the third day of the war.

Bhishma chanted praises of Sri Krishna. Arjuna stopped him and bowed to him and fervently requested. Sri Krishna then climbed the chariot and blew his conch.

units.sanskrit:
प्रार्थितो रथमारूढः पुनः शङ्खमपूरयत्।

ततो भीष्मोऽर्जुनश्‍चैव शस्त्रास्त्रैरभ्यवर्षताम् ॥ २५/४१॥
अयत्नेन जितश्‍चैव फल्गुनेनापगासुतः।
अयुतानि बहून्याजौ रथानां निजघान च ॥ २५/४२॥
जिताः सेनापहारं च चक्रुर्भीष्ममुखास्ततः।

कदाचिदग्रगो भीमो भीष्मद्रोणौ विसारथी ॥ २५/४३॥
कृत्वा विद्राव्य तानश्‍वान् भित्त्वा व्यूहं विवेश ह।
पुनः संस्थापितरथौ विजित्यायत्नतो बली ॥ २५/४४॥
यतमानौ महेष्वासौ धार्तराष्ट्रान् जघान ह।
पञ्चविंशद्धतास्तत्र धार्तराष्ट्रा महाबलाः ॥ २५/४५॥
भगदत्तद्रौणिकृपशल्यदुर्योधनादयः।
सर्वे जिता द्राविताश्‍च सेना च बहुला हता ॥ २५/४६॥
विरथो व्यायुधश्‍चैव दृढवेधविमूर्च्छितः।
कृतो दुर्योधनः सर्वराज्ञां भीमेन पश्यताम् ॥ २५/४७॥
ततोऽपहारं सैन्यस्य जिताश्‍चक्रुश्‍च कौरवाः।
दुर्योधनो निशायां च ययौ यत्र नदीसुतः ॥ २५/४८॥
units.english:
Later, Bhishma and Arjuna showered each other with many weapons and astras. Then, Arjuna defeated Bhishma without any significant effort.

In the battle, Arjuna killed many including ten thousand chariot-warriors. Bhishma and the others, having been defeated, withdrew their armies and left.

Once, Bhimasena led the battle from the front and rendered Bhishma and Drona chariot-less. Driving away their horses, he pierced their vyuha and rushed in. Note: This was on the fourth day of the war.

Even after Bhishma and Drona, the great archers, fixed their chariots and came back again and tried howsoever hard, Bhima easily defeated them again. He slayed the Kauravas. Surprise!

Then, twenty-five powerful Kauravas were slain by Bhima. Bhagadatta, Ashwathama, Krupa, Shalya, Duryodhana and the others lost and fled from there. A large portion of the army was destroyed. Duryodhana, rendered chariot-less and weapon-less, was injured a lot and became deeply unconscious. Bhima did all this even as all the Kings kept watching. Later, driven by fear, the Kauravas withdrew their army.

At night, Duryodhana went to Bhishma’s place. He was bleeding profusely due to injuries caused by Bhima’s arrows. He bowed to Bhishma and asked him – “Why are we consistently losing? And why are the Pandavas winning and celebrating every day?”

units.sanskrit:
पीडितो भीमबाणैश्‍च क्षरद्गात्रो ननाम तम्।
उवाच हेतुना केन वयं जीयाम सर्वदा ॥ २५/४९॥
पाण्डवाश्‍च जयं नित्यं लब्ध्वा हर्षमवाप्नुवन्।
तमाह भीष्मस्तेऽजेया देवास्ते धरणीं गताः ॥ २५/५०॥
विशेषतः केशवेन पालितास्तत्प्रियाः सदा।
मानसोत्तरशैले हि पुरा ब्रह्मपुरःसराः ॥ २५/५१॥
स्थिता देवास्तदाऽपश्यद् ब्रह्मैको हरिमम्बरे।
स्तुत्वा सम्पूज्य भूमेः स भारावतारणाय तम् ॥ २५/५२॥
प्रार्थयामास तेनोक्तं देवानामवदद् विभुः।
अयं नारायणो देवः पूर्णानन्तगुणार्णवः ॥ २५/५३॥
आज्ञापयति वः सर्वान् प्रादुर्भावाय भूतले।
स्वयं च देवकीपुत्रो भविष्यति जगत्पतिः ॥ २५/५४॥
एवं तेन समादिष्टा धर्मवाय्वादयोऽखिलाः।
अभवन् पाण्डवाद्यास्ते सेन्द्राः सहमरुद्गणाः ॥ २५/५५॥
स च नारायणो देवो देवकीनन्दनोऽभवत्।
तेनैते पालिताः पार्था अजेया देवसर्गिणः।
तस्मात् तैः सन्धिमन्विच्छ यदीच्छस्यपराभवम् ॥ २५/५६॥
units.english:
Bhishma told him – “They are invincible Devatas who have come down to Earth. They are especially protected by Sri Krishna. They are always dear to him”.

“Earlier, in the Manasottara mountain, Brahma and the other Devatas had gathered. Then, only Brahma was able to see Sri Hari”.

“Brahma worshipped Sri Hari a lot, chanted his praises, and requested him to reduce Earth’s burden (eliminate evil). He then narrated to the Devatas what he heard from Sri Hari”.

“He is Deva Narayana. He, the one who is complete, eternal and an ocean of auspiciousness, has ordered all of you to take Avatara on Earth. The lord of the world will himself appear as the son of Devaki”.

“In this way, with Brahma ordering them, Yama, Vayu and the other Devatas, getting together with Indra and the Maruts, took Avatara as Pandavas and the rest”.

“Deva Sri Narayana has made his appearance as the son of Devaki. Being protected by him, the Pandavas are the invincible personifications of Devatas. If you do not desire defeat, garner a truce with them”.

units.sanskrit:
इत्युक्तो डम्भबुद्ध्यैव नत्वा विष्णुं ततो ययौ।
प्रातर्निर्यातयामास सेनां युद्धाय दुर्मतिः ॥ २५/५७॥
दिव्यौषधेन भीष्मस्य भूत्वा च निरुजस्ततः।
भीष्ममग्रे निधायैव ययौ युद्धाय दंशितः ॥ २५/५८॥
तत्रासीद् युद्धमतुलं भीमभीष्मानुयायिनाम्।
पाण्डवानां कुरूणां च शूराणामनुवर्तिनाम् ॥ २५/५९॥
धृष्टद्युम्नस्तत्र भीमानुयायी दुर्योधनस्यावरजैः प्रयुद्ध्यन्।
सम्मोहनास्त्रेण विमोहयित्वा विकर्णपूर्वानहनच्च सेनाम् ॥ २५/६०॥
ततो द्रोणस्तान् समुत्थाप्य सर्वान् विज्ञानास्त्रेणासदत् पार्षतं च।
तं भीमसेनः सूतहीनं विधाय व्यद्रावयच्छत्रुगणाञ्छरौघैः ॥ २५/६१॥
अथासदत् कृतवर्मा रथेन धृष्टद्युम्नं सोऽभ्ययात् तावुभौ च।
ववर्षतुः शरवर्षैरथोग्रैस्तत्राकरोद् विरथं द्रौपदिस्तम् ॥ २५/६२॥
तस्मिन् जिते रथवीरे स्वयं तं दुर्योधनः पार्षतमाससाद।
तं भीमसेनो विरथायुधं च कृत्वा बाणेनाहनज्जत्रुदेशे ॥ २५/६३॥
विमूर्च्छितं तं रुधिरौघमुच्चैर्वमन्तमाशु स्वरथे निधाय।
कृपो ययौ मारुतिर्धार्तराष्ट्रीं व्यद्रावयत् पृतनां बाणपूगैः ॥ २५/६४॥
units.english:
When Bhishma spoke thus, the cunning minded Duryodhana faked a show of worship to Sri Hari and left. The next day (however) the evil minded one got his army ready for war.

Due to the effect of the divine medicine prescribed by Bhishma, Duryodhana had ridden himself of all pain. Putting on his kavacha and other armaments, he left for war, keeping Bhishma in front.

On that day, a big battle took place between the brave followers of Bhima who never withdrew from battle and the Kauravas who were following Bhishma.

Dhrishtadyumna followed Bhima and fought the brothers of Duryodhana. Using the sammohanastra, he rendered Vikarna and the others unconscious and proceeded to destroy their army.

Drona then brought all of them back to consciousness by using the vijananastra and raced (to fight) against Dhrishtadyumna. Bhimasena caused Drona to end up without a charioteer and chased away the enemies by showering them with arrows.

Later Krutavarma came to face Dhrishtadyumna on his chariot. Both of them showered a terrible reign of arrows against each other. Dhrishtadyumna rendered Krutavarma chariot-less.

When that great chariot-warrior Krutavarma was defeated thus, Duryodhana went against Dhrishtadyumna. Bhima then caused Duryodhana to lose his chariot and all weapons. With one arrow he hit Duryodhana with great force, aiming at his neck.

Krupa carried away the blood spilling and deeply unconscious Duryodhana from the battlefield lifting him on to his chariot. Bhimasena started chasing away the Kaurava army through a flood of arrows.

units.sanskrit:
अथेन्द्रसूनुः केशवप्रेरितेन रथेन शत्रून् विधमञ्छरौघैः।
रथान् रणे पञ्चविंशत्सहस्रान् निनाय वैवस्वतसादनाय ॥ २५/६५॥
तमन्वयाद् युयुधानः सुधन्वा विद्रावयन् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सेनाम्।
तमभ्ययात् सौमदत्तिस्तयोश्‍च सुयुद्धमासीदतिभैरवास्त्रम् ॥ २५/६६॥
पुत्रान् दशास्याशु निहत्य वीरः स सात्यकेः सौमदत्तिः सकाशे।
समर्दयामास शरीरदारणैः शरैरुभौ तौ विरथौ च चक्रतुः ॥ २५/६७॥
अथासिपाणिं युयुधानमाशु महासिहस्तेन च सौमदत्तिना।
आसादितं वीक्ष्य रथं स्वकीयमारोपयामास सुतोऽनिलस्य ॥ २५/६८॥
सुयोधनः सौमदत्तिं स्वकीयरथे व्यवस्थाप्य च भीमसेनात्।

अपाद्रवद् वासविर्भीष्ममाजौ समाससादाशु महेन्द्रकल्पः ॥ २५/६९॥
उभौ च तावस्त्रविदां प्रबर्हौ शरैर्महाशीविषसन्निकाशैः।
ततक्षतुर्नाकसदां समक्षं महाबलौ संयति जातदर्पौ ॥ २५/७०॥
स्वबाहुवीर्येण जितः स भीष्मः किरीटिना लोकमहारथेन।
सेनामपाहृत्य ययौ निशायामासादितायामथ पाण्डवाश्‍च ॥ २५/७१॥
ततः परेद्युः पुनरेव भीमभीष्मौ पुरस्कृत्य समीयतुस्ते।
सेने तदा सारथिहीनमाशु भीष्मं कृत्वा मारुतिरभ्यगात् परान्।
निपातितास्तेन रथेभवाजिनः प्रदुद्रुवुश्‍चावशिष्टाः समस्ताः ॥ २५/७२॥
units.english:
After that, riding on the chariot being driven by Sri Krishna, Arjuna caused chaos amongst the enemies with a shower of arrows and drove twenty-five thousand chariot-warriors to the abode of Yama.

Satyaki, that excellent archer, followed Arjuna even as he chased away the Kaurava army. Bhurishravas went ahead and challenged him. A terrible battle, involving great astras, took place between the two of them.

The brave Bhurishravas killed and felled ten of Satyaki’s children right in front of him. He hurt Satyaki too with arrows that almost tore his body apart. The two of them destroyed each others chariot.

Then, seeing Bhurishravas confront the sword-wielding Satyaki with a great sword of his own, Bhimasena got Satyaki to climb his chariot.

Duryodhana boarded Bhurishravas on to his chariot and fled afar from Bhimasena. Arjuna, the one who is equal to Mahendra, faced Bhishma in battle.

Even as Devatas looked on, Bhishma and Arjuna, both being extremely strong warriors, full of pride and best amongst knowers of astras, hurt each other by hurling arrows that were like the poison of great serpents.

Arjuna, that great chariot-warrior on Earth, defeated Bhishma with his prowess. Bhishma withdrew his army. Since it was getting dark, the Pandavas too withdrew their army.

units.sanskrit:
दुर्योधनाद्येषु पराजितेषु भीष्मद्रोणद्रौणिपुरःसरेषु।
महागजस्थो भगदत्त आगादायन् बाणं भीमसेनेऽमुचच्च ॥ २५/७३॥
तेनातिविद्धे भीमसेनेऽस्य पुत्र उद्यच्छमानं पितरं निवार्य।
घटोत्कचोऽभ्यद्रवदाशु वीरः स्वमायया हस्तिचतुष्टयस्थः ॥ २५/७४॥
स वैष्णवास्त्रं भगदत्तसंस्थं विज्ञाय विष्णोर्वरतो विशेषतः।
अमोघमन्यत्र हरेर्मरुत्सुतः पुत्रे याते न स्वयमभ्यधावत् ॥ २५/७५॥
अनुग्रहादभ्यधिकादवध्यं जानन्नपि स्वं वासुदेवस्य नित्यम्।
तद्भक्तिवैशेष्यत एव तस्य सत्यं वाक्यं कर्तुमरिं नचागात् ॥ २५/७६॥
यदा स्वपुत्रेण जितो भवेत् स किम्वात्मनेत्येव तदा प्रवेत्तुम्।
स विस्मृतास्त्रस्तु यदा भवेत तदा भीमो भगदत्तं प्रयाति ॥ २५/७७॥
ऋते भीमं वाऽर्जुनं नास्त्रमेष प्रमुञ्चतीत्येव हि वेद भीमः।

चतुर्गजात्मोपरिगात्मकश्‍च घटोत्कचः सुप्रतीकं च तं च ॥ २५/७८॥
नानाप्रकारैर्वितुदंश्‍चकार सन्दिग्धजीवौ जगतः समक्षम्।
गजार्तनादं तु निशम्य भीष्ममुखाः समापेतुरमुं च दृष्ट्वा ॥ २५/७९॥
महाकायं भीमममुष्य पृष्ठगोपं च वाय्वात्मजमत्रसन् भृशम्।
ते भीतभीताः पृतनापहारं कृत्वाऽपजग्मुः शिबिराय शीघ्रम् ॥ २५/८०॥
units.english:
The next day, both the armies resumed battle with Bhima and Bhishma leading them from the front. Bhimasena immediately caused Bhishma to lose his charioteer and rushed towards the enemies.

Duryodhana, Bhishma, Drona, Ashwathama and the others fled the battleground even as Bhimasena destroyed chariots, elephants and horses. The rest of them started fleeing, losing their sense of direction.

Then, Bhagadatta climbed a big elephant and arrived. He started hurling arrows at Bhimasena. When many arrows started falling on Bhima Ghatotkacha, the son of Bhima, stopped his rushing father and, with his maya, sat on four different elephants in four different forms, and faced Bhagadatta.

Bhagadatta possessed a Vaishnava astra which, due to Sri Hari’s boon, was insurmountable for anyone apart from Sri Vishnu himself. Knowing this, Bhimasena did not continue after his son Ghatotkacha went after him (Bhagadatta).

“When he is defeated by my son, has it got to be said separately that he would be defeated by me?” – in order to convey such an impression Bhima did not face him. Whenever Bhagadatta would forget that weapon, Bhima would face him. He very well knew that Bhagadatta would not use that Vaishnavastra against anyone apart from himself or Arjuna.

Seated on four elephants in four forms, Ghatotkacha hurt Bhagadatta and his elephant Supratika with various hits and made it appear, in front of everyone, as if their survival itself was in doubt.

Bhishma and the others heard the pain-filled cry of that elephant and rushed there. Seeing Ghatotkacha in that huge form, and Bhima standing guard behind him, they became very frightened. Bhishma and the others, being very afraid, withdrew their armies and went back towards their camps.

units.sanskrit:
दिने परे चैव पुनः समेताः परस्परं पाण्डवकौरवास्ते।
तत्रासदन्नागसुतासमुद्भवः पार्थात्मजः शाकुनेयान् षडेकः ॥ २५/८१॥
तैः प्रासहस्तैः क्षतकायोऽतिरूढकोपः स खड्गेन चकर्त तेषाम्।
शिरांसि वीरो बलवानिरावान् भयं दधद् धार्तराष्ट्रेषु चोग्रम् ॥ २५/८२॥
दृष्ट्वा तमुग्रं धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रो दिदेश रक्षोऽलम्बुसनामधेयम्।
जह्यार्जुनिं क्षिप्रमिति स्म तच्च समासदन्नागसुतातनूजम् ॥ २५/८३॥
तयोरभूद् युद्धमतीव दारुणं मायायुजोर्वीर्यवतोर्महाद्भुतम्।
ससादिनोऽश्‍वान् स तु राक्षसोऽसृजत् ते पार्थपुत्रस्य च सादिनोऽहनन् ॥ २५/८४॥
ततस्त्वनन्ताकृतिमाप्तमार्जुनिं सुपर्णरूपोऽहनदाशु राक्षसः।

हतं निशम्यार्जुनिमुग्रपौरुषो ननाद कोपेन वृकोदरात्मजः ॥ २५/८५॥
चचाल भूर्नानदतोऽस्य रावतः ससागरागेन्द्रनगा भृशं तदा।
अलम्बुसस्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य मारुतेः सुतं बलाढ्यं भयतः पराद्रवत् ॥ २५/८६॥
पराद्रवत् धार्तराष्ट्रस्य सेनाः सर्वास्तमाराथ सुयोधनो नृपः।
स भीमपुत्रस्य जघान मन्त्रिणो महाबलांश्‍चतुरोऽन्यांस्तथैव ॥ २५/८७॥
हतावशेषेषु च विद्रवत्सु घटोत्कचोऽभ्याहनदाशु तं नृपम्।
स पीड्यमानो युधि तेन रक्षसा प्रवेशयामास शरं घटोत्कचे ॥ २५/८८॥
units.english:
The next day, Pandavas and the Kauravas faced each other once again. Iravanta, born to Arjuna in the Naga-kanya (Uloopi), faced six sons of Shakuni all by himself.

When they hurt him with a weapon called Prasa held in their hands, the brave Iravan became very angry and cut off their heads with a sword. This caused a great fear to engulf the Kauravas.

Seeing the terrible Iravan, Duryodhana said – “Kill this son of Arjuna quickly” and sent a Rakshasa by name Alambusa. He took on the son of the Naga.

An amazing and terrible war took place between then, in which both of them used maya. Alambusa used maya and created horses and horsemen which killed the cavalry of Iravan. Then, even as Iravan took on the form of a snake, the Rakshasa took on the form of a Garuda and quickly killed him.

Hearing the news of the death of Arjuna’s son, the son of Bhima (Ghatotkacha) roared out of anger. His roar then caused oceans, trees, hills and the ground to quake.

Seeing the powerful son of Bhima, Alambusa fled the battlefield out of fear. The army of Duryodhana too started running away. Then, Duryodhana faced Ghatotkacha.

Duryodhana killed the powerful ministers and other assistants of the son of Bhima. When those remaining alive started to flee, Ghatotkacha immediately started hitting Duryodhana using a lot of strength.

units.sanskrit:
दृढाहतस्तेन तदा बलीयसा घटोत्कचः प्रव्यथितेन्द्रियो भृशम्।
तस्थौ कथञ्चिद् भुवि पात्यमानः पुनः शरानप्यसृजत् सुयोधने ॥ २५/८९॥
चिरं प्रयुद्धौ नृपराक्षसाधिपौ परस्पराजेयतनू रणाजिरे।

द्रोणादयो वीक्ष्य रिरक्षिषन्तः सुयोधनं प्रापुरमित्रसाहाः ॥ २५/९०॥
स द्रोणशल्यौ गुरुपुत्रगौतमौ भूरिश्रवःकृतवर्मादिकांश्‍च।
ववर्ष बाणैर्गगनं समाश्रितो घटोत्कचः स्थूलतमैः सुवेगैः ॥ २५/९१॥
तमेकमग्र्यै रथिभिः परिष्कृतं निरीक्ष्य भीमोऽभ्यगमत् समस्तान्।
द्रोणोऽत्र भीमप्रहितैः शरोत्तमैः सुपीडितः प्राप्तमूर्च्छः पपात ॥ २५/९२॥
द्रौणिं कृपाद्यान् ससुयोधनांश्‍च चकार भीमो विरथान् क्षणेन।
निवार्यमाणांस्तु वृकोदरेण घटोत्कचस्तान् प्रववर्ष सायकैः ॥ २५/९३॥
तेनाम्बरस्थेन तरुप्रमाणैरभ्यर्दिताः कुरवः सायकौघैः।
भूमौ च भीमेन शरौघपीडिताः पेतुर्नेदुः प्राद्रवंश्‍चातिभीताः ॥ २५/९४॥
सर्वांश्‍च ताञ्छिबिरं प्रापयित्वा विना भीष्मं कौरवान् भीमसेनः।
घटोत्कचश्‍चानदतां महास्वनौ नादेन लोकानभिपूरयन्तौ ॥ २५/९५॥
दुर्योधनोऽथ स्वजनैः समेतः पुनः प्रायाद् रणभूणिं स भीष्मम्।
जयोपायं भैमसेनेरपृच्छत् स्वस्यैव स प्राह न तं व्रजेति ॥ २५/९६॥
units.english:
Duryodhana, troubled in that manner, pierced Ghatotkacha’s body with an arrow. When he was hit in that manner by the powerful one, Ghatotkacha’s senses took a beating. He gathered himself somehow even as he was about to fall down. Then, he once again started releasing arrows against Duryodhana.

The King of men and the King of Rakshasas fought against each other for a long time. Neither of them could win against the other. Noticing this, Drona and the others, capable of facing enemies, rushed there in order to protect Duryodhana.

Ghatotkacha, standing in the skies, showered huge arrows at great speed against Drona, Shalya, Ashwathama, Krupacharya, Bhurishravas, Krutavarma and the rest.

Seeing him being alone and attacked by great warriors, Bhimasena came there to face all of them. Drona, being hit by the arrows of Bhima and suffering great pain, fell unconscious.

In an instant, Bhima rendered Ashwathama, Krupa and others and Duryodhana and the rest to lose their chariots. As Bhima stopped those warriors, Ghatotkacha (once again) started showering arrows upon them.

The Kauravas , while being tormented by the shower of tree-sized arrows from Ghatotkacha in the sky, were also pained by the arrows of Bhima on the ground. Falling down, they let out cries due to pain. Being very afraid, they ran away in all directions.

Chasing away all the Kauravas, apart from Bhishma, into their camps, Bhimasena and Ghatotkacha roared with their great voices that filled the whole world.

Later, Duryodhana got together with his people and went to the battlefield again. Approaching Bhishma, he asked him how he could win against Ghatotkacha. Bhishma told him – “Do not go against him”.

units.sanskrit:
प्राग्ज्योतिषं चैव घटोत्कचाय सम्प्रेषयामास सुरापगासुतः।
स प्राप्य हैडिम्बमयोधयद् बली स चार्दयामास सकुञ्जरं तम् ॥ २५/९७॥
तेनार्दितः प्राहिणोच्छूलमस्मै वियत्यवप्लुत्य तदा घटोत्कचः।
प्रगृह्य शूलं प्रबभञ्ज जानुमारोप्य देवा जहृषुस्तदीक्ष्य ॥ २५/९८॥
तदा स तस्यैव पदानुगान् नृपो जघान तं मारुतिरभ्ययाद् रणे।
स प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय वीरो गजं तमस्तम्भयदाशु सायकैः ॥ २५/९९॥
संस्तम्भिते बाणवरैस्तु नागे भीमस्याश्‍वान् सायकैरार्दयत् सः।
सोऽभ्यर्दिताश्‍वोऽथ गदां प्रगृह्य हन्तुं नृपं तं सगजं समासदत् ॥ २५/१००॥
स हन्तुकामेन रुषाऽभिपन्नो भीमेन राजा पुरतः पृष्ठतश्‍च।
कृष्णेनास्त्रं वैष्णवं तद् गृहीतुं सहार्जुनेनापययौ स भीतः ॥ २५/१०१॥
तस्मिन् गते भीमसेनार्जुनाभ्यां विद्राविते राजसङ्घे समस्ते।
भीष्मः सेनामपहृत्यापयातो दुर्योधनस्तं निशि चोपजग्मिवान् ॥ २५/१०२॥
संश्रावितः क्रूरवचः स तेन चक्रे प्रतिज्ञां मृत्युभयं विहाय।
शक्त्या हनिष्यामि परानिति स्म चक्रे च तत् कर्म तथा परेद्युः ॥ २५/१०३॥
तं शक्तितो जुगुपुर्धार्तराष्ट्रास्तेनार्दिताश्‍चेदिपाञ्चालमत्स्याः।
पराद्रवन् भीष्मबाणोरुभीताः सिंहार्दिताः क्षुद्रमृगा इवार्ताः ॥ २५/१०४॥
units.english:
Bhishma sent the King of Pragjyotisha (Bhagadatta) against Ghatotkacha. The powerful Bhagadatta approached the Rakshasa and started to battle him. The son of Hidimbaa caused trouble to him and his elephant.

Bhagadatta, tormented by Ghatotkacha, hurled a spear at him, who leapt into the sky, held the spear and broke it after placing it on his knees. The Devatas felt great joy seeing this.

Bhagadatta then started killing the assistants of the son of Bhima, seeing which Bhima went to battle against him. Bhagadatta rushed his elephant against him. Bhima immediately stopped that elephant with his arrows.

When that elephant was stunned due to those excellent arrows, Bhagadatta troubled Bhima’s horses with arrows. Seeing this, Bhimasena, wanting to kill him along with his elephant, rushed towards him, having picked up his mace.

Noticing Bhima angrily rushing towards him in order to kill, and Arjuna and Sri Krishna approaching from the back in order to snatch the Vaishnava astra, the scared Bhagadatta fled from there.

When Bhagadatta fled in that matter, and when all the groups of Kings were chased away by Bhima and Arjuna, Bhishma withdrew the army and left. That night, Duryodhana came to Bhishma.

When Duryodhana spoke cruel words, Bhishma gave him his assurance to forsake the fear of death and kill enemies, deploying his complete strength. The next day, he did the same too.

units.sanskrit:
संस्थाप्य तान् भीष्ममभिप्रयान्तमलम्बुसोऽवारयत् पार्थसूनुम्।
विजित्य तं केशवभागिनेयो भीष्मं ययौ धार्तराष्ट्रोऽमुमार ॥ २५/१०५॥
तद् युद्धमासीन्नृपपार्थपुत्रयोर्विचित्रमत्यद्भुतमुग्ररूपम्।
समं चिरं तत्र धनुश्‍चकर्त ध्वजं च राजा सहसाऽभिमन्योः ॥ २५/१०६॥
अथैनमुग्रैश्‍च शरैर्ववर्ष सूतं च तस्याशु जघान वीरः।

तदाऽसदद् भीमसेनो नृपं तं जघान चाश्‍वान् धृतराष्ट्रजस्य ॥ २५/१०७॥
द्रोणो द्रौणिर्भगदत्तः कृपश्‍च सचित्रसेना अभ्ययुर्भीमसेनम्।
सर्वांश्‍च तान् विमुखीकृत्य भीमः स चित्रसेनाय गदां समाददे ॥ २५/१०८॥
तामुद्यतां वीक्ष्य पराद्रवंस्ते स चित्रसेनश्‍च रथादवप्लुतः।
सञ्चूर्णितो गदया तद्रथश्‍च तज्जीवनेनोद्धृषिताश्‍च कौरवाः ॥ २५/१०९॥
भीष्मस्तु पाञ्चालकरूशचेदिष्वहन् सहस्त्राणि चतुर्दशोग्रः।
रथप्रबर्हानतितिग्मतेजा विद्रावयामास परानवीनिव ॥ २५/११०॥
विद्राव्य सर्वामपि पाण्डुसेनां विश्राव्य लोकेषु च कीर्तिमात्मनः।
सेनामपाहृत्य ययौ निशागमे संस्तूयमानो धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रैः ॥ २५/१११॥
द्रोणो विराटस्य पुरो निहत्य शङ्खं सुतं तस्य विजित्य तं च।
विद्राव्य सेनामपि पाण्डवानां ययौ नदीजेन सहैव हृष्टः ॥ २५/११२॥
units.english:
The Kauravas protected Bhishma as much as they could. The Kings of Chedi, Panchala and Matsya countries, tormented by Bhishma, fled from the field. Being very scared of Bhishma’s arrows, they became saddened like stray deer troubled by a lion.

When the son of Arjuna (Abhimanyu) went against Bhishma after stopping those Kings from fleeing, the Rakshasa Alambusa came in his way. Abhimanyu won against him and rushed towards Bhishma. Then, Duryodhana faced him.

A special, most-amazing and terrible duel took place between him and the son of Partha, which went on equally (i.e. both faring equally) for a long time. Later, Duryodhana suddenly cut off and felled the bow and mast of Abhimanyu.

Later Duryodhana rained a shower of arrows on Abhimanyu and also killed his charioteer. Bhima then faced Duryodhana and killed his horses. Drona, Ashwathama, Bhagadatta, Krupa and Chitrasena surrounded Bhimasena. After making all of them fall back, Bhima then picked up a mace for Chitrasena.

Seeing him pick up the mace in that manner, all of them fled from there. Chitrasena jumped on to the ground even as his chariot was blown to pieces by Bhima’s mace. Seeing Chitrasena (still) alive, all the Kauravas became happy.

Bhishma, possessing the most intense radiance, killed fourteen thousand great chariot warriors belonging to the Kings of Panchala, Karusha and Chedi. Just as a wolf scatters sheep, he chased away the enemies.

Chasing away the army of the Pandavas, spreading his fame all over the world, Bhishma withdrew his army as night befell and returned to his camp, being praised by the Kauravas (all along).

Drona slew Virata’s son Shankha right in front of him. He defeated Virata too. Chasing away the Pandava army, he joyfully joined Bhishma and returned.

units.sanskrit:
भीमार्जुनावपि शत्रून् निहत्य विद्राव्य सर्वांश्‍च युधि प्रवीरान्।
युधिष्ठिरेणापहृते स्वसैन्ये भीतेन भीष्माच्छिबिरं प्रजग्मतुः ॥ २५/११३॥
युधिष्ठिरो भीष्मपराक्रमेण भीतो भीष्मं स्ववधोपायमेव।
प्रष्टुं ययौ निशि कृष्णोऽनुजाश्‍च तस्यान्वयुस्तं स पितामहो यत् ॥ २५/१२४॥
भीमार्जुनौ शक्नुवन्तावपि स्म नर्तेऽनुज्ञां हन्तुमिमं समैच्छताम्।
पूज्यो यतो भीष्म उदारकर्मा कृष्णोऽप्यायात् तेन हि पाण्डवार्थे ॥ २५/११५॥
प्राप्यानुज्ञां भीष्मतस्ते वधाय शिखण्डिनं तद्वचसाऽग्रयायिनम्।
कृत्वा परेद्युर्युधये विनिर्गता भीष्मं पुरस्कृत्य तथा परेऽपि ॥ २५/११६॥
शिखण्डिनो रक्षकः फल्गुनोऽभूद् भीष्मस्य दुःशासन आस चाग्रे।
अन्ये च सर्वे जुगुपुर्भीष्ममेव न्यवारयन् भीमसेनादयस्तान् ॥ २५/११७॥
भीष्माय यान्तं युयुधानमाजौ न्यवारयद् राक्षसोऽलम्बुसोऽथ।
तं वज्रकल्पैरतुदद् वृष्णिवीरः शरैः स मायामसृजत् तदोग्राम् ॥ २५/११८॥
अस्त्रेण मायामपनुद्य वीरो व्यद्रावयद् राक्षसं सात्यकिस्तम्।
तस्मिन् गते युयुधानो रथेन ययौ भीष्मं पार्थमन्वेव धन्वी ॥ २५/११९॥
द्रोणो द्रौणिर्धार्तराष्ट्रश्‍च राजा भूरिश्रवा भगदत्तः कृपश्‍च।
शल्यो बाह्लीकः कृतवर्मा सुशर्मा सर्वाश्‍च सेना वारिता वायुजेन ॥ २५/१२०॥
units.english:
Bhima and Arjuna too killed the enemies and chased away many brave warriors. As Dharmaraja withdrew the army due to Bhishma’s fear, they too returned to the camps.

Being scared of Bhishma’s valour, Dharmaraja went to him at night, seeking to know from Bhishma himself the means to kill him. Sri Krishna and his brothers too followed him as Bhishma was their grandfather.

Although Bhima and Arjuna were most capable of killing Bhishma, they did not desire to do so without his permission. The reason for this was the fact that Bhishma was most worship-worthy by virtue of having practiced the path of excellent Karma always. For the sake of Pandavas, Sri Krishna too went there.

Having obtained his consent for killing, the Pandavas got ready for battle and left, placing Shikandi in front as per his (Bhishma’s) words. The Kauravas too started for battle with Bhishma in front.

Arjuna proceeded as Shikandi’s protector. Dushasana stood in front of Bhishma. All the others too (on the Kaurava side) started protecting Bhishma. Bhimasena and the others moved to stop them.

The Rakshasa Alambusa interrupted Satyaki who was going against Bhishma. The Yadava hero hurt him with arrows that were hard as diamonds. He (Alambusa) then created a terrible maya.

Using an astra, the brave Satyaki destroyed his maya and chased him afar. After he ran away, Satyaki followed Arjuna in his chariot, holding a bow, and proceeded towards Bhishma.

The son of Vayu (Bhima) stopped Drona, Ashwathama, Duryodhana, Bhurishravas, Bhagadatta, Krupa, Shalya, Bahlika, Krutavarma, Susharma and the entire army.

units.sanskrit:
स तान् मुहुर्विरथीकृत्य वीरः प्राग्ज्योतिषं सगजं द्रावयित्वा।
न्यवारयत् फल्गुनं योद्धुकामं पार्थश्‍च देवव्रतमाससाद ॥ २५/१२१॥
युधिष्ठिरं भीष्ममभिप्रयान्तं माद्रीसुताभ्यां सहितं नृवीरम्।
न्यवारयच्छकुनिः सादिनां च युतोऽयुतेनैव वराश्‍वगेन ॥ २५/१२२॥
तान् सादिनोऽश्‍वांश्‍च निहत्य सर्वान् विजित्य तं शकुनिं पाण्डवास्ते।
प्रापुर्भीष्मं द्रौपदेयाश्‍च सर्वे तथा विराटद्रुपदौ कुन्तिभोजः ॥ २५/१२३॥
धृष्टद्युम्नं भीष्ममभिप्रयान्तं न्यवारयत् सैन्धवस्तं स बाणैः।
हताश्‍वसूतं सगणं द्रावयित्वा समासदद् भीष्ममेवाशु वीरः ॥ २५/१२४॥
गुप्तोऽथ पार्थेन रणे शिखण्डी भीष्मं समासाद्य शरैरताडयत्।
भीष्मः स्त्रीत्वं तस्य जानन् न तस्मै मुमोच बाणान् स तु तं तुतोद ॥ २५/१२५॥
शिखण्डिनं वारयामास बाणैर्दुर्मर्षणोऽमर्षणविह्वलेक्षणः।
नात्येतुमेनमशकच्छिखण्डी दुःशासनः पार्थमवारयत् तदा ॥ २५/१२६॥
स लोकवीरोऽपि दुरात्मनाऽमुना रुद्धोऽशकन्नैनमतीत्य यातुम्।
भीष्मं पार्थः सायकाश्‍चास्य तस्मिन् ससज्जिरे पर्वतेष्वप्यसक्ताः ॥ २५/१२७॥
अमर्षयुक्तौ चिरमेव वीरावयुद्ध्यतामर्जुनधार्तराष्ट्रौ।
समं तदासीन्महदद्भुतं च दिवौकसां पश्यतां भूभृतां च ॥ २५/१२८॥
units.english:
The brave Bhima repeatedly rendered all of them chariot-less. He hurt Bhagadatta, who was trying to stop Arjuna, and chased him away along with his elephant. Arjuna then started nearing Bhishma.

Shakuni, along with a cavalry of ten thousand excellent men, stopped Dharmaraja who was proceeding towards Bhishma along with Nakula and Sahadeva.

The three of them completely destroyed the cavalry and the horses, defeated Shakuni and reached Bhishma. The sons of Draupadi, as well as Virata, Drupada and Kuntibhoja arrived there.

When Dhrishtadyumna tried to go against Bhishma, Jayadratha stopped him with his arrows. Dhrishtadyumna killed his horses and charioteer and chased him away along with his army. The brave one then quickly approached Bhishma.

Shikandi, protected by Arjuna, faced Bhishma in battle and started hurting him with his arrows. Knowing him to be a woman, Bhishma did not hurl arrows back at him. Shikandi though kept hurting Bhishma repeatedly.

Durmarshana tried to stop Shikandi with his arrows. He kept rolling his eyes out of anger. Shikandi could not cross him and move forward. Dushasana then stopped Arjuna.

Arjuna, although one of the great heroes of the world, was not able to move past Dushasana when he stopped him and reach Bhishma. His arrows, which were capable of piercing mountains, were not able to go past Dushasana.

The brave Arjuna and Dushasana were enraged and fought with each other for a long time. Even as Devatas and the Kings watched, their battle went on amazingly, and on equal terms.

units.sanskrit:
तदा विराटद्रुपदौ कुन्तिभोजं कृष्णासुतान् केकयांश्‍चेकितानम्।
भूरिश्रवाः सोमदत्तो विकर्णः सकेकया वारयामासुरुच्चैः ॥ २५/१२९॥
जित्वैव तांस्तेऽभिययुश्‍च भीष्मं तदाऽर्जुनोऽतीत्य दुःशासनं च।
भीष्मं शरैरार्च्छदरिप्रमाथिभिः शिखण्डिनं धार्तराष्ट्राद् विमुच्य ॥ २५/१३०॥
स तैः समस्तैर्बहुभिः शस्त्रपूगैः भृशं मर्मस्वर्दितश्‍चापमुक्तैः।
शरैः समस्तान् विरथांश्‍चकार शैनैयपाञ्चालयुधिष्ठिराद्यान् ॥ २५/१३१॥
स चेदिपाञ्चालकरूशमुख्यान् रथोत्तमान् पञ्चविंशत्सहस्रान्।
सम्प्रेषयामास यमाय बाणैर्युगान्तकालाग्निरिव प्रवृद्धः ॥ २५/१३२॥
निरीक्ष्य तं सूर्यमिवातपन्तं सञ्चोदितो वासुदेवेन पार्थः।
चिच्छेद तत्कार्मुकं लोकवीरो रणेऽर्धचन्द्रेण स चान्यदाददे ॥ २५/१३३॥
चिच्छेद तच्चैवमष्टौ धनूंषि शक्तिं च चर्मासिवरं पराणि च।
धनूंषि दत्तानि नृभिर्नृपस्य सर्वाणि चिच्छेद स पाकशासनिः ॥ २५/१३४॥
ततः शरैः सूर्यकरप्रकाशैर्विव्याध सर्वे च युधिष्ठिराद्याः।
तैरर्दितो न्यपतद् भूतले स प्राणान् दधारापि तथोत्तरायणात् ॥ २५/१३५॥
निपातितेऽस्मिन् मारुतिर्द्रोणमुख्यान् विद्राव्य तत्रागमदाशु तेऽपि।
तदायुधानि प्रणिधाय वीराः पार्थाः परे चैनमुपासदन् स्म ॥ २५/१३६॥
units.english:
Then Bhuri, Shala, Somadatta, Vikarna and the Kekayas used their strength and stopped Virata, Drupada, Kuntibhoja, Upapandavas, Kekayas and Chekitana. Note: A faction of the Kekayas (one of the states) fought on the side of the Kauravas.

They defeated all of them and moved towards Bhishma. Arjuna then got past Dushasana and, after releasing Shikandi from Durmarshana, started hurting Bhishma with arrows that could destroy enemies.

Bhishma, being hit by a large number of weapons, was hurt very badly in vital parts of his body. Later, with arrows enjoined with the bow, he rendered Satyaki, Dhrishtadyumna, Dharmaraja and the others chariot-less.

Bhishma shone like the fire at the time of Pralaya and sent twenty five thousand chariot-warriors belonging to the Chedi, Panchala, Karusha and other countries to the abode of Yama.

Noticing Bhishma shining like the Sun in the battlefield, Arjuna, the hero of the world, being motivated by Sri Krishna, cut off his bow with a crescent shaped arrow. Bhishma immediately picked up another bow.

Arjuna cut that bow too. In this way, he cut off eight bows, a Shakti-ayudha, a shield and a sword. The son of Indra cut off other bows that were given (to Bhishma) by the assistants of Duryodhana.

Later Dharmaraja and the others started hitting him with arrows that there shining like the rays of the Sun. Being tormented by those arrows, Bhishma fell down on the ground. He then held his life till (the arrival of) Uttarayana.

When Bhishma fell down, Bhimasena chased away Drona and the others and arrived there. They too kept their weapons on the ground and gathered (around Bhishma). The Pandavas, Kauravas and all the other warriors came together at that place.

units.sanskrit:
प्रणम्य तं तद्वचनात् समीयुस्तस्मिन् दिने शिबिराण्येव सर्वे।
परे दिने सर्व एवोपतस्थुर्भीष्मं यदूनां पतिना सहैव ॥ २५/१३७॥
स पूर्वदिवसे पार्थदत्तबाणोपबर्हणः।
तदाऽपि तृट्परीतात्मा योग्यं पेयमयाचत ॥ २५/१३८॥
धार्तराष्ट्रैरविज्ञातं तदभिज्ञाय वासविः।
वारुणास्त्रेण भित्त्वा स भूमिं वारि सुगन्धि च ॥ २५/१३९॥
ऊर्ध्वधारमदादास्ये तर्पितोऽनेन सोऽवदत्।
यादृश्यस्त्रज्ञता पार्थे दृष्टाऽत्र कुरुनन्दनाः ॥ २५/१४०॥
यादृग् बाह्वोर्बलं भीमे संयुगेषु पुनःपुनः।
यादृशं चैव माहात्म्यमनन्तमजरं हरेः ॥ २५/१४१॥
विज्ञातं सर्वलोकस्य सभायां दृष्टमेव च।
उपारमत तद् युद्धं सुखिनः सन्तु भूमिपाः ॥ २५/१४२॥
यथोचितं विभक्तां च भुङ्ग्ध्वं भूपाः सदा भुवम्।
इत्युक्तः स ययौ तूष्णीं धार्तराष्ट्रः स्वकं गृहम् ॥ २५/१४३॥
व्यासदत्तोरुविज्ञानात् सञ्जयादखिलं पिता।
श्रुत्वा तदा पर्यतप्यत् पाण्डवाः कृष्णदेवताः।
मुमुदुः शिबिरं प्राप्य सर्वे कृष्णानुमोदिताः ॥ २५/१४४॥
॥ इति श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्यविरचिते श्रीमन्महाभारततात्पर्यनिर्णये भीष्मपातो नाम पञ्चविंशोऽध्यायः॥
units.english:
Having bowed to Bhishma, all of them went back to their camps as per his words. The next day, all of them came to Bhishma. Sri Krishna, the lord of the Yadavas, too came there.

Bhishma, who had gotten a pillow made from arrows through Arjuna the previous day, was troubled by thirst and asked for water from an appropriate source.

Arjuna, knowing that which the Kauravas were unaware of, released the Varunastra and pierced the ground to create a fountain of perfumed water and made it fall on Bhishma’s mouth. Being satisfied with it, Bhishma then spoke.

“O Kauravas! You have witnessed the knowledge of weapons that Arjuna possesses. You are witness to the strength of Bhima in battle again and again. You also know the unfathomable and endless greatness of Sri Krishna. In the Sabha, you have witnessed it in front of all”.

“Therefore, stop this war. Let the Kings live peacefully. Divide the Kingdom appropriately and enjoy it” – when Bhishma said thus, Duryodhana silently returned home.

Dhritharashtra felt great sorrow after getting to know everything from Sanjaya, who possessed divine vision granted by Sri Vyasa. The Pandavas, knowing Sri Krishna to be the Supreme Being, got back to their camps and experienced great joy as per Sri Krishna’s orders. Srimadanandatirtha Bhagavatpada ||

units.sanskrit:
ॐ॥ अथाखिलानां पृथिवीपतीनामाचार्यमग्र्यंं रथिनां सुविद्यम्।
रामस्य विश्‍वाधिपतेः सुशिष्यं चक्रे चमूपं धृतराष्ट्रपुत्रः ॥ २६/१॥
कर्णोऽपि भीष्मानुमतो धनुष्मान् युद्धोद्यतोऽभूत् तदसत्कृतः पुरा।
तस्मिन् स्थितेऽनात्तधनुस्तदैव रथं समास्थाय गुरुं समन्वयात् ॥ २६/२॥
द्रोणो वृतो धार्तराष्ट्रेण धर्मसुतग्रहे तेन कृते प्रतिश्रवे।
ज्ञात्वा यत्ताः पाण्डवास्तं समीयुर्युद्धाय तत्राभवदुग्रयुद्धम् ॥ २६/३॥
पतत्रिभिस्तत्र दुधाव शात्रवान् द्रोणो धनुर्मण्डलमन्त्रनिःसृतैः।
तमाससादाशु वृकोदरो नदंस्तमासदन् द्रौणिकृपौ च मद्रराट् ॥ २६/४॥
स तान् विधूयाभ्यपतद् रणेऽग्रणीर्द्रोणं तमन्वार्जुनिरभ्ययात् परान्।
ववार तं मद्रपतिस्तयोरभूद् रणो महांस्तत्र गदां समाददे ॥ २६/५॥
शल्योऽथ भीमोऽभिययौ गदाधरस्तमेतयोरत्र बभूव सङ्गरः।
उभावजेयौ गदिनामनुत्तमावतुल्यवीर्यौ प्रवरौ बलीयसाम् ॥ २६/६॥
विचेरतुश्‍चित्रतमं प्रपश्यतां मनोहरं तावभिनर्दमानौ।
गदाप्रपातायितवज्रगात्रौ ददर्श लोकोऽखिल एव तौ रणे ॥ २६/७॥
गदाभिघातेन वृकोदरस्य विचेतनः प्रापतदत्र मद्रराट्।
भीमोऽपि कोपात् प्रचलत्पदः क्षितौ निधाय जानुं सहसोत्थितः क्षणात् ॥ २६/८॥
units.english:
After Bhishma, Duryodhana appointed Drona, who was the teacher of weapons for all Kings, the best amongst chariot-warriors, an excellent scholar and the best student of the lord of the world Sri Parashurama, as the commander of the army.

Karna too, having not held the bow till Bhishma was around having been insulted by him, got ready for battle after taking Bhishma’s permission. He climbed the chariot and followed Drona. Duryodhana asked Drona to capture Yudhishthira and hand him over. He gave his word agreeing to do so. The Pandavas got to know of this and came ready to battle. A terrible war took place between them.

Using a bow that was pulled together as a circle, Drona released arrows powered by mantras and caused distraught amongst the enemies. Immediately Vrikodara let out a leonine roar and faced him. Ashwathama, Krupa and Shalya came to battle him (Bhima).

Bhimasena, the foremost in battle, pushed all of them back and faced Drona. Following him, Abhimanyu too faced the enemies. King Shalya stopped him. Shalya picked up a mace. A great battle took place between the two of them. Bhima faced him holding a mace. A (wonderful) battle took place between them. Both of them hadn’t tasted defeat and were excellent in using the mace. Both of them were very powerful. They were the best amongst the strongest.

The two of them fought, causing amazement and surprise to those watching them. The whole world saw their battle, in which their diamond like strong bodies bore the marks of the maces, caused when they hit each other.

Due to Bhima’s hit with the mace, King Shalya fell unconscious. Out of anger, Vrikodara moved his legs and rested on his knees. He then immediately got up. Note: Bhima’s blows caused Shalya to fall unconscious while Shalya’s attack resulted in Bhima resting on his knees for a moment.

units.sanskrit:
विचेतनं पतितं मद्रराजं विलोक्य भीमं च तमाह्वयन्तम्।
रथं समारोप्य जनस्य पश्यतः पुरश्‍च भीमस्य कृपोऽपजग्मिवान् ॥ २६/९॥
विजित्य मद्राधिपमोजसाऽरिहा नदन् रथं प्राप्य निजं स मारुतिः।
व्यद्रावयद् बाणगणैः परेषामनीकिनीं द्रोणसमक्षमेव ॥ २६/१०॥
विद्रावयत्याशु कुरून् वृकोदरे विधूय सौभद्रमुखान् ससात्यकीन्।
द्रोणोऽभिपेदे नृपतिं गृहीतुं तमाससादाशु धनञ्जयो रथी ॥ २६/११॥
स वासुदेवप्रयते रथे स्थितः शरैः शरीरान्तकरैः समन्ततः।
निहत्य नागाश्‍वरथान् प्रवर्तयन्नदृश्यताश्‍वेव च शोणितापगाः ॥ २६/१२॥
निहन्यमानासु किरीटिना चमूष्वारक्षिते धर्मसुते तथाऽऽपदः।
चमूं च भीमार्जुनबाणभग्नां द्रोणोऽपहृत्यापययौ निशागमे ॥ २६/१३॥
स धार्तराष्ट्रेण युधिष्ठिराग्रहात् संश्रावितः क्रूरवचो निशायाम्।
जगाद दूरं समराद् विनीयतां पार्थस्ततो धर्मसुतं ग्रहीष्ये ॥ २६/१४॥
ततः सुशर्मा सहितो महारथैः संशप्तकैर्दूरतरं प्रणेतुम्।
युद्धाय भीमानुजमाशु कॢप्तो दुर्योधनेनोमिति सोऽप्यवादीत् ॥ २६/१५॥
समाह्वयामासुरथार्जुनं ते प्रातर्हुताशस्य दिशं रणाय।

अयोधयत् तान् स च तत्र गत्वा भीमो गजानीकमथात्र चावधीत् ॥ २६/१६॥
units.english:
Even as the people around were watching Shalya falling unconscious and Bhima inviting him for battle, Krupa got Shalya inside his chariot and drove away. Note: In the moola Mahabharata, Sri Vyasa says it was Krutavarma who carried Shalya away.

Maruti (Bhima), having defeated the King of Madra, let out a lion-like roar and returned to his chariot. Releasing a shower of arrows, he started hurting and chasing away the army of the enemies, right in front of Drona.

When Vrikodara chased away the Kauravas quickly, Drona defeated Abhimanyu, Satyaki and the others and rushed towards Yudhishthira in order to capture him. Arjuna, being seated in his chariot, faced him.

Arjuna, being in the chariot controlled by Sri Krishna, appeared to the world as the one causing the flow of the river of blood due to the destruction of elephants, horses and chariots using body-damaging, sharp arrows.

When Dharmaraja became safe and relieved from danger as the army (of the Kauravas) was destroyed greatly by Arjuna, Drona withdrew his army that was being destroyed by Bhima and Arjuna as nightfall came about, and returned.

At night, the son of Dhritharashtra condemned Drona with cruel words for having failed to capture Yudhisthira. Drona said – “Draw Arjuna away from the battlefield. I shall then capture the son of Dharma”.

Susharma, along with the Samshaptakas including great many warriors, was then appointed by Duryodhana to draw Arjuna away afar from the battlefield. He said “Yes”.

All of them invited Arjuna to the north-eastern side (of Kurukshetra) for battle. Arjuna went there and started fighting them. Over here, Bhima started destroying the elephant-army.

units.sanskrit:
निहन्यमानेषु गजेषु सर्वशो विद्राव्यमाणेष्वखिलेषु राजसु।
प्राग्ज्योतिषो धार्तराष्ट्रार्थितस्तं समागमत् सुप्रतीकेन धन्वी ॥ २६/१७॥
विभीषिताः सुप्रतीकेन भीमहया न तस्थुस्तदनु स्म सात्यकिः।
सौभद्रमुख्याश्‍च गजं तमभ्ययुश्‍चिक्षेप तेषां स रथानथाम्बरे ॥ २६/१८॥
शैनेयपूर्वेषु रथोज्झितेषु भूमाववप्लुत्य कथञ्चिदेव।
स्थितेषु भीमे च विभीषिताश्‍वान् संयम्य युद्ध्यत्यपि कृष्ण ऐक्षत् ॥ २६/१९॥
सङ्क्लेशितो वैष्णवास्त्रं विमुञ्चेत् प्राग्ज्योतिषो भीमसेने ततोऽहम्।
याम्यर्जुनेनैव तदस्त्रमात्मनः स्वीकर्तुमन्येन वरादधार्यम् ॥ २६/२०॥
इति स्म सञ्चिन्त्य सहार्जुनेन तत्राययावथ पार्थं त्रिगर्ताः।
न्यवरायंस्त्वाष्ट्रमस्त्रं स तेषु व्यवासृजन्मोहनायाशु वीरः ॥ २६/२१॥
तदस्त्रवीर्येण विमोहितास्ते परस्परं कृष्णपार्थाविति स्म।
जघ्नुस्तदा वासविस्तान् विसृज्य प्राग्ज्योतिषं हन्तुमिहाभ्यगाद् द्रुतम् ॥ २६/२२॥
विसृज्य भीमं स च पार्थमेव ययौ गजस्कन्धगतो गजं तम्।
सञ्चोदयामास रथाय तस्य चक्रेऽपसव्यं हरिरेनमाशु ॥ २६/२३॥
मनोजवेनैव रथे परेण सम्भ्राम्यमाणे नतु तं गजः सः।
प्राप्तुं शशाकाथ शरैः सुतीक्ष्णैरभ्यर्दयामास नृपं स वासविः ॥ २६/२४॥
units.english:
When Bhima started to kill elephants from all directions, due to which (many) Kings started running away after defeat, Bhagadatta, being requested by Duryodhana, rushed there along with (his elephant) Suprateeka, wielding a bow.

Bhima’s horses, being scared by that elephant, could not stand there. Later, Satyaki, Abhimanyu and the others faced that elephant. It picked them up along with their chariots and threw them into the sky.

Satyaki and the others, rendered chariot-less, jumped to the ground with great difficulty and stood up. Bhima brought the horses under control and got ready to battle. Sri Krishna noticed this.

“Bhagadatta, getting into trouble, may invoke the Vaishnavastra against Bhima. Therefore, I shall go there with Arjuna and receive that astra which cannot be borne by others due to the boon”. Note: The Vaishnavastra, due to Sri Vishnu’s boon, could not be withstood by anyone else.

Thinking thus, Sri Krishna proceeded there with Arjuna. Then, the Trigartas stopped Arjuna from going. The brave Arjuna released the Sammohanastra against them.

Due to the effect of that astra, the Trigartas became disillusioned and started hitting each other confusing each other to be Sri Krishna and Arjuna. Then, Arjuna quickly proceeded towards Bhagadatta in order to kill him.

Bhagadatta quit the battle with Bhima and faced Arjuna, being seated on the elephant. He moved his elephant towards Arjuna’s chariot. Sri Krishna drove the chariot speedily around the elephant in the counter-clockwise direction.

Since Sri Krishna was driving that chariot in a circle at the speed of mind, the elephant could not catch it. Arjuna tormented Bhagadatta with extremely sharp arrows.

units.sanskrit:
अस्त्रैश्‍च शस्त्रैः सुचिरं नृवीरावयुद्ध्यतां तौ बलिनां प्रबर्हौ।
अथो चकर्तास्य धनुः स पार्थः स वैष्णवास्त्रं च तदाऽङ्कुशेऽकरोत् ॥ २६/२५॥
तस्मिन्नस्त्रे तेन तदा प्रमुक्ते दधार तद् वासुदेवोऽमितौजाः।
तदंसदेेशेऽस्य तु वैजयन्ती बभूव मालाऽखिललोकभर्तुः ॥ २६/२६॥
दृष्ट्वैव तद् धारितमच्युतेन पार्थः किमर्थं विधृतं त्वयेति।
ऊचे तमाहाशु जगन्निवासो मयाऽखिलं धार्यते सर्वदैव ॥ २६/२७॥
न मादृशोऽन्योऽस्ति कुतः परो मत् सोऽहं चतुर्धा जगतो हिताय।
स्थितोऽस्मि मोक्षप्रलयस्थितीनां सृष्टेश्‍च कर्ता क्रमशः स्वमूर्तिभिः।
स वासुदेवादिचतुःस्वरूपः स्थितोऽनिरुद्धो हृदि चाखिलस्य ॥ २६/२८॥
स एव च क्रोडतनुः पुराऽहं भूमिप्रियार्थं नरकाय चादाम्।
अस्त्रं मदीयं वरमस्य चादामवध्यतां यावदस्त्रं ससूनोः ॥ २६/२९॥
अस्त्रस्य चान्यो नतु कश्‍चिदस्ति योऽवध्य एतस्य कुतश्‍च मत्तः।
इति स्म तेनैव मया धृतं तदस्त्रं तदेनं जहि चास्त्रहीनम् ॥ २६/३०॥
इत्युक्तमाकर्ण्य स केशवेन सम्मन्त्र्य बाणं हृदये मुमोच।
प्राग्ज्योतिषस्यापरमुत्तमं शरं गजेन्द्रकुम्भस्थल आश्‍वमज्जयत् ॥ २६/३१॥
उभौ च तौ पेततुरद्रिसन्निभौ महेन्द्रवज्राभिहताविवाशु।
निहत्य तौ वासविरुग्रपौरुषो मुमोद साधु स्वजनाभिपूजितः ॥ २६/३२॥
units.english:
Arjuna and Bhagadatta, the two great warriors and best amongst the powerful, fought against each other with weapons and astras for a long time. Then, Arjuna cut off Bhagadatta’s bow. Bhagadatta invoked the Vaishnavastra in the (elephant’s) hook. Note: The astra could be invoked on any object due to the power of the mantra. Bhagadatta did so on the hook used to control his elephant Suprateeka.

When Bhagadatta released that Vaishnavastra, Sri Krishna, the one with limitless valour, bore it. That astra adorned the shoulders of Sri Krishna, the one who bears all the worlds, in the form of a Vaijayanti mala. Note: The astra became a garland of Vaijayanti flowers and adorned Sri Krishna’s shoulders.

Seeing that (astra) being borne by Sri Krishna, Arjuna asked him – “Why did you take it upon yourself?”. Sri Krishna, the bearer of all the worlds, said – “Is it not me who bears everything at all times?”

“There is none equal to me. How then can anyone be superior to me? I take four forms for the welfare of the world. Through them, I perform liberation, dissolution, maintenance and creation. Possessing those four forms viz Vasudeva and the rest, I reside in the hearts of everyone in the form of Aniruddha”.

“The four-formed me had earlier, in my form as Varaha, given this astra to Narakasura in order to please Bhudevi. I had also granted him and his son invincibility and freedom from death till the possession of the astra”

“Apart from me, there is no one else who can escape death from this weapon. Therefore, I received this astra. Now that he is without the astra, you slay him”.

Hearing those words of Sri Krishna, Arjuna discussed with him and released an arrow aimed at the chest of King of Pragjyotisha. He shot another arrow that hit the top of the forehead of that elephant.

Bhagadatta and his elephant, both being mountain like, fell down as if hit by the Vajrayudha of Mahendra. Arjuna, of terrible prowess, killed both of them and rejoiced greatly, being worshipped by his people.

units.sanskrit:
अथाचलं वृषभं चैव हत्वा कनीयसौ शकुनेस्तं च बाणैः।
विव्याध मायामसृजत् स तां च विज्ञानास्त्रेणाशु नाशाय चक्रे ॥ २६/३३॥
स नष्टमायः प्राद्रवत् पापकर्मा ततः पार्थः शरपूगैश्‍चमूं ताम्।
विद्रावयामास तदा गुरोः सुतो माहिष्मतीपतिमाजौ जघान ॥ २६/३४॥
तदा भीमस्तस्य निहत्य वाहान् व्यद्रावयद् धार्तराष्ट्रीं चमूं च।
भीमार्जुनाभ्यां हन्यमानां चमूं तां दृष्ट्वा द्रोणः क्षिप्रमपाजहार ॥ २६/३५॥
प्राग्ज्योतिषे निहतेऽथाग्रहाच्च युधिष्ठिरस्यातिविषण्णरूपः।
दुर्योधनोऽश्रावयद् दीनवाक्यान्यत्र द्रोणं सोऽपि नृपं जगाद ॥ २६/३६॥
पार्थे गते श्‍वो नृपतिं ग्रहीष्ये निहन्मि वा तत्सदृशं तदीयम्।
इति प्रतिज्ञां स विधाय भूयः प्रातर्ययौ युद्धमाकाङ्क्षमाणः ॥ २६/३७॥
पद्मव्यूहं व्यूह्य परैरभेद्यं वराद् विष्णोस्तस्य मन्त्रं हि जप्त्वा।
पार्थाश्‍च तं प्रापुरृतेऽर्जुनेन संशप्तकैर्युयुधे सोऽपि वीरः ॥ २६/३८॥
पार्था व्यूहं च तं प्राप्य नाशकन् भेत्तुमुद्यताः।
जानंश्‍च प्रतिभायोगात् काम्यं नैवाजपन्मनुम् ॥ २६/३९॥
भीमो युधिष्ठिरस्तत्र तज्ज्ञं सौभद्रमब्रवीत्।
भिन्धि व्यूहमिमं तात वयं त्वामनुयामहे ॥ २६/४०॥
units.english:
Then, Arjuna killed Achala and Vrushaka, two brothers of Shakuni, using arrows. He caused pain to Shakuni as well with his arrows. Shakuni then created a maya. Arjuna released the vijnanastra and destroyed that maya.

That evil-doer Shakuni ran away from there when his maya was destroyed. Later Arjuna showered that army (of Shakuni) with arrows and chased them away. Ashwathama then killed Neela, the King of Mahishmati, in battle.

Bhima destroyed the horses of Ashwathama and started to scatter the Kaurava army. Seeing his army being destroyed by Bhima and Arjuna, Drona quickly withdrew his army (for the day). Note: The war on the twelfth day came to an end thus.

Because of Bhagadatta’s killing and because Yudhishthira was not captured, Duryodhana became extremely downcast and went to Drona and chastised him with cruel words. Drona then told him.

“Tomorrow, when Arjuna goes afar, I shall capture Yudhishthira or kill another brave warrior equal to him” – undertaking an oath thus, Drona left, desiring battle on the next day.

Drona constructed a padma-vyuha that was impenetrable by enemies due to Sri Vishnu’s boon and started fighting. Apart from Arjuna, the other Pandavas faced Drona. Arjuna engaged in battle with the Samshaptakas.

Even though the Pandavas came near the vyuha and tried, they could not break it. Bhima, although he naturally knew the mantra that would allow it to be broken, did not chant the same as it was a kamya-karma. Note: To break the padma-vyuha one had to chant a mantra. Chanting of mantras for material pursuits is forbidden for anyone following the shuddha-bhagavata-dharma. Bhima therefore did not chant the mantra.

Dharmaraja then spoke to Abhimanyu, who knew how to break that vyuha, and said – “Son! You penetrate this vyuha. We shall follow you”.

units.sanskrit:
स एवमुक्तो रथिनां प्रबर्हो विवेश भित्त्वा द्विषतां चमूं ताम्।
अन्वेव तं वायुसुतादयश्‍च विविक्षवः सैन्धवेनैव रुद्धाः ॥ २६/४१॥
वरेण रुद्रस्य निरुद्ध्यमानो जयद्रथेनात्र वृकोदरस्तु।
विष्णोरभीष्टं वधमार्जुनेस्तदा विज्ञाय शक्तोऽपि नचात्यवर्तत ॥ २६/४२॥
जयद्रथस्थेन वृषध्वजेन प्रयुद्ध्यमानेषु वृकोदरादिषु।
प्रविश्य वीरः स धनञ्जयात्मजो विलोडयामास परोरुसेनाम् ॥ २६/४३॥
स द्रोणदुर्योधनकर्णशल्यद्रौण्यग्रणीभिः कृतवर्मयुक्तैः।
रुद्धश्‍चचारारिबलेष्वभीतः शिरांसि कृन्तंस्तदनुव्रतानाम् ॥ २६/४४॥
स लक्षणं राजसुतं प्रसह्य पितुः समीपेऽनयदाशु मृत्यवे।
बृहद्बलं चोत्तमवीर्यकर्मा वरं रथानामयुतं च पत्रिभिः ॥ २६/४५॥
द्रोणादयस्तं हरिकोपभीताः प्रत्यक्षतो हन्तुमशक्नुवन्तः।
सम्मन्त्र्य कर्णं पुरतो निधाय चक्रुर्विचापाश्‍वरथं क्षणेन ॥ २६/४६॥
कर्णो धनुस्तस्य कृपश्‍च सारथिं द्रोणो हयानाशु विधूय सायकैः।
सचर्मखड्गं रथचक्रमस्य प्रणुद्य हस्तस्थितमेव चक्रुः ॥ २६/४७॥
भीतेषु कृष्णादथ तद्वधाय तेष्वाससादाशु गदायुधं गदी।
दौःशासनिस्तौ युगपच्च मम्रतुर्गदाभिघातेन मिथोऽतिपौरुषौ ॥ २६/४८॥
units.english:
Abhimanyu, the best amongst chariot-warriors, upon Yudhisthira’s instructions, cut through the vyuha and entered the enemy’s army. Although Bhimasena and the rest of them tried to enter behind him, the King of Sindhu (Jayadratha) stopped all of them.

When Jayadratha stopped him due to Rudra’s boon, although he was capable, Bhimasena did not override the boon knowing Sri Krishna’s decision that the son of Arjuna must be killed.

Even as Bhimasena and the others were fighting Shiva who was inside of Jayadratha, the brave Abhimanyu entered the vyuha and caused great tumult amongst that huge army of the enemy.

Even though he was being stopped by Drona, Duryodhana, Karna, Shalya, Ashwathama, Krutavarma and other great warriors, Abhimanyu moved around fearlessly amidst the enemy army and kept chopping off the heads of their followers.

Abhimanyu held Lakshana, the son of Duryodhana, by force and killed him right in front of his father. He killed Bruhadbala (too). Possessing excellent strength and initiative, Abhimanyu also killed ten thousand great chariot-warriors with his arrows.

Drona and the others, out of fear of Sri Krishna’s anger, failed to defeat Abhimanyu by facing him directly in battle. They discussed amongst themselves and, keeping Karna in front, quickly destroyed his bow, horses and chariot. Note: None of the warriors tried to kill him in a face to face battle, fearing Sri Krishna’s wrath.

Using arrows, Karna destroyed Abhimanyu’s bow while Krupa killed his charioteer and Drona quickly slew his horses. Destroying the sword, shield and the wheel of the chariot that were in his hands, they made him stand empty handed.

Fearing Sri Krishna, when all of them hesitated to kill him, the son of Dushasana held a mace and faced Abhimanyu, who too was holding a mace. The two brave warriors died at the same time due to each other’s blows.

units.sanskrit:
तस्मिन् हते शत्रुरवं निशम्य हर्षोद्भवं मारुतिरुग्रविक्रमः।
विजित्य सर्वानपि सैन्धवादीन् युधिष्ठिरस्यानुमते न्यषीदत् ॥ २६/४९॥
व्यासस्तदा तानमितात्मवैभवो युधिष्ठिरादीन् ग्लपितानबोधयत्।
विजित्य संशप्तकपूगमुग्रो निशागमे वासविराप साच्युतः ॥ २६/५०॥
निशम्य पुत्रस्य वधं भृशार्तः प्रतिश्रवं सोऽथ चकार वीरः।
जयद्रथस्यैव वधे निशायां स्वप्नेऽनयत् तं गिरिशान्तिकं हरिः ॥ २६/५१॥
स्वयमेवाखिलजगद्रक्षाद्यमितशक्तिमान्।
अप्यच्युतो गुरुद्वारा प्रसादकृदहं त्विति ॥ २६/५२॥
ज्ञापयन् फल्गुनस्यास्त्रगुरुं गिरिशमञ्जसा।
प्रापयित्वैनमेवैतत्प्रसादादस्त्रमुल्बणम्।
चक्रे तदर्थमेवास्य चक्रे रक्षां तदात्मिकाम् ॥ २६/५३॥
सान्त्वयित्वा सुभद्रां च गत्वोपप्लाव्यमच्युतः।
योजयित्वा रथं प्रातः सार्जुनो युद्धमभ्ययात् ॥ २६/५४॥
श्रुत्वा प्रतिज्ञां पुरुहूतसूनोर्दुर्योधनेनार्थितः सिन्धुराजम्।
त्राताऽस्म्यहं सर्वथेति प्रतिज्ञां कृत्वा द्रोणो व्यूहमभेद्यमातनोत् ॥ २६/५५॥
स दिव्यमग्र्यं शकटाब्जचक्रं कृत्वा स्वयं व्यूहमुखे व्यवस्थितः।

पृष्ठे कर्णद्रौणिकृपैः सशल्यैर्जयद्रथं गुप्तमधात् परैश्‍च ॥ २६/५६॥
units.english:
Hearing the noise of the enemies’ celebrating upon Abhimanyu’s death, Bhimasena, possessing terrible valour, defeated Jayadratha and the others and went towards Yudhishthira.

Then, Sri Vyasa, possessing unfathomable inherent greatness, consoled Dharmaraja and the others who were in sorrow. Having defeated the Samshaptakas, the great fighter Arjuna arrived there at night along with Sri Krishna.

Hearing the news of his son’s killing, the brave Arjuna became very sorrowful and undertook an oath to kill Jayadratha. That night, Sri Krishna took him to Shiva.

Although Sri Krishna himself performs all activities of the world including protection and possesses unlimited strength, in order to show (the world) that he provides his grace only through one’s Guru, he took Arjuna to his astra-guru Shiva in a nice manner and, through his blessings, got him a very potent weapon. He also got him special protection from Shiva.

Sri Krishna went to Upaplavya, consoled Subadhra and, in the morning, tied the chariot and went to war along with Arjuna.

Drona, having heard about the oath of Arjuna and having been requested by Duryodhana, himself took an oath declaring that he would protect Jayadratha at all cost and put together an impenetrable vyuha.

Drona prepared a divine and excellent Shakatabja-chakra vyuha and himself stood at its gate. He placed Jayadratha at the back, under the protection of Karna, Ashwathama, Krupa, Shalya and others. Note: The shakatabja-chakra was a combination of three vyuhas – shakata, padma and chakra vyuhas. The outer vyuha was shakata or chariot-shaped. Inside it was the padma vyuha in the shape of a lotus. The inner most vyuha was a chakra-vyuha shaped like a disc.

units.sanskrit:
अथार्जुनो दिव्यरथोपरिस्थितः सुरक्षितः केशवेनाव्ययेन।
विजित्य दुर्मर्षणमग्रतोऽभ्ययाद् द्रोणं सुधन्वा गुरुमुग्रपौरुषः ॥ २६/५७॥
प्रदक्षिणीकृत्य तमाश्‍वगात् ततः कालात्ययं त्वेव विशङ्कमानः।
रथं मनोवेगमथानयद्धरिर्यथा शराः पेतुरमुष्य पृष्ठतः ॥ २६/५८॥
विजित्य हार्दिक्यमथाप्रयत्नतः स इन्द्रसूनुः प्रविवेश तद् बलम्।
विलोडयामास च सायकोत्तमैर्यथा गजेन्द्रो नलिनीं बलोद्धतः ॥ २६/५९॥
स उच्चकाशेऽतिरथो रथोत्तमे सवासुदेवो हरिणा यथेन्द्रः।
चकर्त चोग्रो द्विषतां शिरांसि शरैः शरीरान्तकरैः समन्ततः ॥ २६/६०॥
दृढायुमच्युतायुं च हत्वा विन्दानुविन्दकौ।
शराभ्यां प्रेषयामास यमाय विजयो युधि ॥ २६/६१॥
सुदक्षिणं च काम्बोजं निहत्याम्बष्ठमेव च।
श्रुतायुधं नदीजातं वरुणादाससाद ह ॥ २६/६२॥
यस्यादाद् वरुणो दिव्याममोघां महतीं गदाम्।
स तु तेन शरैस्तीक्ष्णैरर्पितो विरथं क्षणात् ॥ २६/६३॥
चकार पार्थस्य रथमारुह्यारिधराय ताम्।
गदां चिक्षेप सा तस्य वारुणेः शिर एव तु ॥ २६/६४॥
units.english:
After that, the fiery warrior and excellent archer Arjuna, protected by the eternal Sri Krishna, proceeded for war. He defeated Durmarshana at first and went to battle against Guru Drona.

Suspecting that he was running out of time, Arjuna bowed to Drona, circumambulated him and moved ahead. Sri Krishna drove the chariot at the speed of mind, such that Arjuna’s arrows were falling behind the chariot. Note: The speed at which Sri Krishna was driving the chariot was such that the arrows which Arjuna would release would fall behind the chariot by the time they hit the ground.

Arjuna defeated Krutavarma effortlessly and entered that army. Just as a powerful elephant disturbs a tranquil lake full of lotuses, Arjuna caused turmoil in the enemy army.

Arjuna, the atiratha, appeared radiant in that chariot with Sri Vasudeva just like Devendra together with Upendra. The terror of enemies, through his arrows that caused damage to bodies, cut off the heads of the enemies in all directions.

With two arrows, Arjuna killed Dhrudayu and Achyutayu and with two more arrows he sent Vinda and Anuvinda to the abode of Yama. Note: Vinda-Anuvinda, killed by Arjuna on this day, were the Kings of Avanti. Duryodhana also had two brothers named Vinda-Anuvinda. Similarly, there were two Kings of Kekaya named Vinda-Anuvinda.

Arjuna killed the Kamboja King Sudakshina and Ambashta. He then faced Shrutayudha, who was born to Varuna from a river. Varuna had given him a divine and faultless big mace.

When he released sharp weapons against Arjuna, he was instantly rendered chariot-less by Partha. Climbing Arjuna’s chariot, he smashed the mace against Sri Krishna, the wielder of the Chakra. That mace then hit Shrutayudha’s head itself. His head split into a hundred pieces and he fell down on the ground.

units.sanskrit:
बिभेद शतधा शीर्णमस्तिष्कः सोऽपतद् भुवि।
अयुद्ध्यन्तं स्वगदया यदि ताडयति स्वयम् ॥ २६/६५॥
तया विशीर्णमस्तिष्को भविष्यसि न संशयः।
अमोघा चान्यथा सेयं गदा तव भविष्यति ॥ २६/६६॥
इत्यब्रवीत् तं वरुणः पुरा तेन स केशवे।
अयुद्ध्यति गदाक्षेपात् तया शीर्णशिरा अभूत् ॥ २६/६७॥
हतेषु वीरेषु निजेषु सङ्घशो विद्रावितेष्वालुलिते च सैन्ये।
दुर्योधनो द्रोणमुपेत्य दीनमुवाच हा पार्थ उपेक्षितस्त्वया ॥ २६/६८॥
इतीरितेऽभेद्यममुष्य वर्म बद्ध्वा महामन्त्रबलात् स विप्रः।
जगाद येनैव बलेन पार्थैर्विरुद्ध्यसे तेन हि याहि फल्गुनम् ॥ २६/६९॥
इतीरितो धार्तराष्ट्रः स चापमादाय सौवर्णरथोपरिस्थितः।
जगाम पार्थं तमवारयच्च शरैरनेकैरनलप्रकाशैः ॥ २६/७०॥
विव्याध पार्थोऽपि तमुग्रवेगैः शरैर्न ते तस्य च वर्मभेदनम्।
चक्रुस्ततो वासविर्दिव्यमस्त्रं तद्वर्मभेदाय समाददे रुषा ॥ २६/७१॥
सन्धीयमानं तु गुरोः सुतस्तच्चिच्छेद पार्थोऽथ सुयोधनाश्‍वान्।
हत्वा तलेऽविद्ध्यदथैनमुग्रैर्द्रौणिः शरैः पार्थमवारयद् युधि ॥ २६/७२॥
units.english:
“If you use the mace against a person who is not fighting then you shall die, without fail, due to your own head being quashed by the weapon. Otherwise, this mace shall never go in vain”.

Varuna had earlier informed Shrutayudha thus. Since he used the mace against Sri Krishna, who was not fighting in the war, his own head was burst by the mace.

When his warriors were getting killed in hordes, and when his disturbed army started fleeing afar in groups, Duryodhana came to Drona and, in a miserable state, said – “O! You have neglected (the prowess) of Partha”.

When Duryodhana said thus, Drona made him wear a kavacha that was impenetrable due to the power of great mantras. He told him – “Fight Arjuna with the same strength that you fight the rest of the Pandavas with. Go”.

When Drona said this, Duryodhana picked up his bow and went against Arjuna, riding a golden chariot. Using arrows that were shining like fire, he stopped Arjuna.

Arjuna too fired many terrible and speedy arrows at Duryodhana. They however did not pierce the kavacha. Burning with anger, Arjuna then picked up a divine astra in order to pierce that kavacha.

Even as Arjuna was placing that divine arrow in the bow, Ashwathama, the guru-putra, broke it. Arjuna then killed the horses of Duryodhana and hurt him in his forearms. Ashwathama stopped Arjuna in battle using sharp arrows.

units.sanskrit:
स द्रौणिकर्णप्रमुखैर्धनञ्जयो युयोध ते चैनमवारयञ्छरैः।
बभूव युद्धं तदतुल्यमद्भुतं जयद्रथार्थेऽद्भुतवीर्यकर्मणाम् ॥ २६/७३॥
पार्थे प्रविष्टे कुरुसैन्यमध्यं द्रोणोऽविशत् पाण्डवसैन्यमाशु।
स तद्रथानीकमुदग्रवेगैः शरैर्विधूय न्यहनच्च वीरान् ॥ २६/७४॥
स वीरवर्यः स्थविरोऽपि यूनां युवेव मध्ये प्रचचार धन्विनाम्।
प्रपातयद् वीरशिरांसि बाणैर्युधिष्ठिरं चासददुग्रवीर्यः ॥ २६/७५॥
नृपग्रहेच्छुं तमवेत्य सत्यजिन्न्यवारयद् द्रौपदिराशु वीर्यवान्।
निवारितस्तेन शिरः शरेण चकर्त पाञ्चालसुतस्य विप्रः ॥ २६/७६॥
निहत्य तं वीरतमं रणोत्कटं युधिष्ठिरं बाणगणैः समार्दयत्।
स्वशक्तितस्तेन विधाय सङ्गरं निरायुधो व्यश्‍वरथः कृतः क्षणात् ॥ २६/७७॥
स ऊर्ध्वबाहुर्भुवि संस्थितोऽपि गृहीतुमाजौ गुरुणाऽभिपन्नः।
माद्रीसुतस्यावरजस्य यानमारुह्य वेगादपजग्मिवांस्ततः ॥ २६/७८॥
द्रोणं ततः शैशुपालिः सपुत्रो जारासन्धिः काशिराजः सशैब्यः।
समासदन् कैकयाश्‍चैव पञ्च समर्दयन् बाणगणैश्‍च सर्वशः ॥ २६/७९॥
स तान् क्रमेणैव निकृत्तकन्धाराञ्छरोत्तमैस्तत्र विधाय विप्रः।
निनाय लोकं परमर्कमण्डलं व्रजन्ति निर्भिद्य यमूर्ध्वरेतसः ॥ २६/८०॥
units.english:
Arjuna fought in battle against Ashwathama, Karna and the others. They stopped him with their arrows. For the sake of Jayadratha, a surreal and amazing battle took place between these warriors whose actions were full of extra ordinary prowess!

When Arjuna entered the midst of the Kaurava army, Drona quickly waded through the Pandava army. Chasing away the chariots of the Pandava side with speedy arrows, he killed (many) warriors.

Drona, the best amongst the brave, although aged, moved around the wielders of the bow appearing younger than the youngsters! Causing the heads of the terrible and valorous fighters to fall on the ground with his arrows, he approached Yudhishthira.

Satyajit, the son of Drupada, realizing the intentions of Drona to capture Dharmaraja, immediately stopped him. When he did thus, Drona beheaded him with an arrow.

That most brave Drona, having killed the smart warrior Satyajit, troubled Yudhishthira with a shower of arrows. Although Dharmaraja fought to the best of his ability, Drona quickly rendered him weaponless and destroyed his horses and chariot.

When he stood on the ground, with his hands lifted upwards, Drona rushed towards him to capture him. Dharmaraja then climbed the chariot of Sahadeva and speedily departed from that place.

Later Dhrishtaketu, the son of Shishupala, his sons, Sahadeva the son of Jarasandha, the King of Kashi, Shaibya and five Kekayas opposed Drona from all directions. Through their shower of arrows, they started hurting him.

Drona then beheaded them one by one with excellent arrows and sent them to the lokas that are reached traveling through the surya-mandala by those practicing naishtika brahmacharya.

units.sanskrit:
विधूयमाने गुरुणोरुसैन्ये पृथासुतानां पृतनाः परेषाम्।
प्रायो रणे मारुतसूनुनैव हतप्रवीरा मृदिताः पराद्रवन् ॥ २६/८१॥
अलम्बुसो नाम तदैव राक्षसः समासदन्मारुतिमुग्रपौरुषम्।
स पीडितस्तेन शरैः सुतेजनैः क्षणाददृश्यत्वमवाप मायया ॥ २६/८२॥
सोऽदृश्यरूपोऽनुचरानपीडयद् भीमस्य तद् वीक्ष्य चुकोप मारुतिः।
अस्त्रज्ञतामात्मनि केशवाज्ञया सन्दर्शयन्नागतधर्मसङ्कटः ॥ २६/८३॥
त्वाष्ट्रास्त्रमादत्त स काम्यकर्महीनोऽपि भीमस्तत उत्थिताः शराः।
ते बाणवर्यास्तददृश्यवेधिनो रक्षो विदार्याविविशुर्धरातलम् ॥ २६/८४॥
तद्धन्यमानं प्रविहाय भीममपाद्रवद् दूरतरं सुभीतम्।
ततस्तु भीमो द्विषतां वरूथिनीं विद्रावयामास शरैः सुमुक्तैः ॥ २६/८५॥
तदैव कृष्णातनयाः समेता जघ्नुः शलं संयति सौमदत्तिम्।

अलम्बुसं प्राप तदा घटोत्कचः परस्परं तौ रथिनावयुद्ध्यताम् ॥ २६/८६॥
घटोत्कचस्तं विरथं विधाय खस्थं ख एवाभियुयोध संस्थितः।
ततस्तु तं भीमसुतो निगृह्य निपात्य भूमौ प्रददौ प्रहारम् ॥ २६/८७॥
पदा शिरस्येव स पिष्टमस्तको ममार मध्ये पृथिवीपतीनाम्।

तस्मिन् हते भैमसेनिः कुरूणां व्यद्रावयद् रथवृन्दं समन्तात् ॥ २६/८८॥
units.english:
When Drona was destroying the great army of the Pandavas, Bhimasena was slaying the Kaurava army. The warriors who survived started running away after being hurt by his blows.

At that time, a Rakshasa named Alambusa came to face the great hero Maruti. When Bhimasena hurt him badly with fiery arrows, he became invisible using his maya.

Staying invisible, that Rakshasa started troubling the assistants of Bhima. Seeing this, Bhima became furious. As per Sri Hari’s orders, he picked up the Tvashtra-astra to demonstrate his competence (with astras). Although he would never undertake a kamya-karma, he did so due to dharma-sankata. Later, numerous arrows started to emerge from that astra. Those arrows hit the invisible Rakshasa and then entered the Earth by piercing it. Notes: Alambusa was the older brother of Bakasura. Kamya-karma is any work that is pursued for material or worldly benefits. Dharma-sankata is a difficult situation where a kamya-karma may have to be undertaken to continue following the path of Dharma.

When Bhima hit him in this manner, Alambusa left him and ran afar. Later, Bhima, through arrows that were excellently executed, hurt and chased away the enemy soldiers.

After that, all the sons of Draupadi got together and killed Somdatta’s son Shala in battle. Ghatotkacha then faced Alambusa. Both of them climbed their chariots and engaged in a duel.

Ghatotkacha rendered Alambusa chariot-less and, when the latter jumped into the sky, fought him there itself. The son of Bhima then caught him and threw him down to the ground. He smashed his head with his feet. The Rakshasa fell down dead amidst Kings when his head got crushed into pieces. After his death, Ghatotkacha chased away the battalion of Kaurava chariot-warriors from all directions.

units.sanskrit:
तदाऽऽसदत् कृतवर्मा रथेन सेनां पाण्डूनां शरवर्षं प्रमुञ्चन्।
ददौ वरं तस्य हि पूर्वमच्युतः प्रीतः स्तुत्या सर्वजयं मुहूर्ते ॥ २६/८९॥
स तेन पाञ्चालगणान् विजिग्ये यमौ च भीमस्य पुरोऽथ तं च।
विव्याध बाणेन स वासुदेववरं विजानन् न तदा समभ्ययात् ॥ २६/९०॥
विनैव वृष्णीन् विजये वरो यदमुष्य तेनास्य हयान् स सात्यकिः।
निहत्य बाणैरतुदत् स यानमन्यत् समास्थाय ततोऽपजग्मिवान् ॥ २६/९१॥
तदा हरिः पाञ्चजन्यं सुघोषमापूरयामास जयेऽभियुद्ध्यति।
कर्णादिभिर्द्रौणिमुखै रिपूणां बलप्रहाणाय परः परेभ्यः ॥ २६/९२॥
स पाञ्चजन्योऽच्युतवक्त्रवायुना भृशं सुपूर्णोदरनिःसृतध्वनिः।
जगद् विरिञ्चेशसुरेन्द्रपूर्वकं प्रकम्पयामास युगात्यये यथा ॥ २६/९३॥
गाण्डीवघोषे च तदाऽभिभूते युधिष्ठिरो भीतभीतस्तदैत्य।
शैनेयमूचे परसैन्यमग्ने पार्थे स्वयं युद्ध्यति केशवः स्म ॥ २६/९४॥
न श्रूयते गाण्डिवस्याद्य घोषः संश्रूयते पाञ्चजन्यस्य रावः।
तद् याहि जानीहि तमद्य पार्थं यदि स्म जीवत्यसहाय एषः ॥ २६/९५॥
इतीरितः सात्यकिरत्र विप्रान् सम्पूज्य वित्तैः परमाशिषश्‍च।
जयाय तेभ्यः प्रतिगृह्य सेनामुखं ययौ भीमसेनानुयातः ॥ २६/९६॥
units.english:
Krutavarma then faced the Pandava army, showering them with arrows. Earlier, Sri Krishna had granted him a boon to win against everyone for a duration of one muhurtha, after Krutavarma had chanted and prayed to him.

Due to that boon, Krutavarma won against the Panchala warriors. Right in front of Bhima, he won against Nakula and Sahadeva. He hurt Bhima too with his arrows. Knowing Sri Krishna’s boon to be working at that time, Bhima did not go against him.

Since Sri Krishna had granted him the boon of victory against all except the Yadavas, Satyaki killed his horses and hurt him with his arrows. He climbed another chariot and departed from there.

When Arjuna was engaged in battle with Karna, Ashwathama and the others, Sri Krishna, the Supreme one, blew the Panchajanya conch whose sound was unparalleled, in order to reduce the strength of the enemies.

When the Panchajanya conch filled its kernel with the air that emanated from Sri Krishna’s mouth, it let out a loud sound that shook Brahma, Shiva, Devendra and the entire world, just as at the time of Pralaya.

When Dharmaraja could not hear the sounds of the Gandiva, he became worried and approached Satyaki and said – “Satyaki! It appears Sri Krishna may be fighting himself as Arjuna may have gotten caught amidst the enemy army”.

“The sound of the Gandiva is not being heard now. The sound of the Panchajanya is being heard clearly. Therefore, go to Arjuna. Check if the helpless one is alive”.

When Dharmaraja said thus, Satyaki worshipped Brahmanas there with gifts and obtained their excellent blessings for victory and proceeded to the entrance of the vyuha under the protection of Bhimasena.

units.sanskrit:
भीमस्तु सेनामुखमाशु भित्त्वा प्रावेशयद् युयुधानं चमूं ताम्।
स युद्ध्यमानो गुरुणाऽभ्युपेक्षितः सूतं निहत्य द्रावयामास चाश्‍वान् ॥ २६/९७॥
बलं विवृद्धं च तदाऽस्य सात्यकेर्विप्राशीर्भिः कृष्णवरादपि स्म।
बलस्य वृद्धिर्हि पुराऽस्य दत्ता कृष्णेन तुष्टेन दिने हि तस्मिन् ॥ २६/९८॥
तदा विवृद्धोरुबलात् स सात्यकिः संस्थाप्य भीमं प्रययौ रथेन।
तं बाणवर्षैः पृतनां समन्तान्निघ्नन्तमाजौ हृदिकात्मजोऽभ्ययात् ॥ २६/९९॥
तयोरभूद् युद्धमतीव दारुणं तत्राकरोत् तं विरथं स सात्यकिः।
विजित्य तं सात्यकिरुग्रधन्वा ययावतीत्यैव शिरांसि यूनाम् ॥ २६/१००॥
कृन्तन् शरैस्तं जलसन्ध आगमद् रणे गजस्कन्धगतोऽभियोद्धुम्।
निवारयन्तं तमसह्यविक्रमं निहत्य बाणैः समरे स सात्यकिः ॥ २६/१०१॥
विलोडयामास बलं कुरूणां निघ्नन् गजस्यन्दनवाजिपत्तिनः।
स पार्वतेयांश्‍च शिलाप्रवर्षिणो निहत्य विद्राव्य च सर्वसैनिकान् ॥ २६/१०२॥
समासदत् केशवफल्गुनौ च बली तमाराथ च यूपकेतुः।

तयोरभूद् युद्धमतीव घोरं चिरं विचित्रं च महद् विभीषम् ॥ २६/१०३॥
परस्परं तौ तुरगान् निहत्य निपात्य सूतौ धनुषी निकृत्य।
समीयतुश्‍चर्मवरासिधारिणौ विचित्रमार्गानपि दर्शयन्तौ ॥ २६/१०४॥
units.english:
Bhimasena quickly pierced the vyuha and got Satyaki inside that army. Satyaki fought against Drona, who neglected him (did not engage forcefully). Satyaki killed the charioteer of Drona and chased away his horses.

Then, due to the blessings of the Brahmanas and due to the boon of Sri Krishna, Satyaki’s strength increased immensely. A pleased Krishna had granted him a boon that his strength would increase for a duration of one day.

After that, due to that immense increase in strength, Satyaki stopped Bhima at the entrance of the formation itself and proceeded further. As he started to destroy the army from all sides with showers of arrows, Krutavarma, the son of Hridika, took him on.

A terrible fight took place between them and Satyaki rendered Krutavarma chariot-less. The great archer Satyaki won against him and proceeded further, beheading youngsters along the way.

At that moment, Jalasandha came there to fight, being seated on an elephant. Satyaki killed that great fighter and difficult-to-face warrior Jalasandha when he came to stop him.

Satyaki killed the Kaurava army, including elephants, chariots, horses and foot-soldiers and caused a great turmoil. He also killed a battalion of tribal warriors who were hurling rocks at him, and chased away all the soldiers.

Satyaki came near Arjuna and Sri Krishna. Immediately, King Yupadhwaja came to battle against him. A terrible, intriguing, fiery and great battle took place between them for a long time. Note: Yupadhwaja was another name for King Bhurishravas, the son of Somdatta and the grandson of Bahlika. He was very well known for having performed a great many Yajnas. Hence he was known as Yupadhwaja.

The two of them killed each others’ horses and charioteers and destroyed their bows. Later, wielding swords and shields in their hands, they started fighting each other, showing a variety of battle moves.

units.sanskrit:
स सौमदत्तिर्भुवि सात्यकिं रणे निपात्य केशेषु च सम्प्रगृह्य।
पदाऽस्य वक्षस्यधिरुह्य खड्गमुदग्रहीदाशु शिरोऽपहर्तुम् ॥ २६/१०५॥
तद् वासुदेवस्तु निरीक्ष्य विश्‍वतश्‍चक्षुर्जगादाशु धनञ्जयं रणे।
त्रायस्व शैनेयमिति स्म सोऽपि भल्लेन चिच्छेद भुजं परस्य ॥ २६/१०६॥
स तेन चोत्कृत्तसखड्गबाहुर्विनिन्द्य पार्थं निषसाद भूमौ।
प्रायोपविष्टः शरसंस्तरे हरिं ध्यायन् विनिन्दन्नसुरप्रवेशात् ॥ २६/१०७॥
गतेऽसुरावेश उतातिभक्त्या ध्यायत्यमुष्मिन् गरुडध्वजं तम्।
शैनेय उत्थाय निवार्यमाणः कृष्णार्जुनाद्यैरहरच्छिरोऽस्य ॥ २६/१०८॥
तदा स्वकीयं रथमेतदर्थं कॢप्तं ददौ सात्यकये ससूतम्।
कृष्णोऽथ पार्थस्य हयास्तृषाऽर्दितास्तदाऽसृजद् वारुणास्त्रं स पार्थः ॥ २६/१०९॥
तेनैव तीर्थं परमं चकार तथाऽश्‍वशालामपि बाणरूपाम्।
ततो विमुच्यात्र हयानपाययद्धरिस्तदा वासविरार्दयत् परान् ॥ २६/११०॥
युयोज कृष्णस्तुरगान् रथे पुनर्गतश्रमानुद्धृतसायकान् प्रभुः।
प्रचोदिते तेन रथे स्थितः पुनस्तथैव बीभत्सुररीनयोधयत् ॥ २६/१११॥
शिनिप्रवीरे तु गते युधिष्ठिरः पुनश्‍च चिन्ताकुलितो बभूव ह।
जगाद भीमं च न गाण्डिवध्वनिः संश्रूयते पाञ्चजन्यस्य रावः ॥ २६/११२॥
units.english:
The son of Somdatta felled Satyaki to the ground. Holding his hair in one hand, he placed his leg on Satyaki’s chest and quickly lifted his sword to behead him.

Sri Vasudeva, the one whose eyes could see everything, noticed this and immediately told Dhananjaya – “Protect Satyaki in battle”. Arjuna then cut off the the arm of Bhurishravas with a bhalla. Note: Arjuna and Sri Krishna were at a distance of three yojanas from Satyaki and Bhurishravas. Bhalla was a special kind of arrow – a missile like weapon.

When his arm holding the sword was cut off, Bhurishravas sat down, condemning Arjuna. He sat on a mat of arrows, intending to give up his life. He was meditating on Sri Hari. Due to the Avesha of Asuras, he also engaged in condemnation of Sri Krishna.

As the Avesha of the Asuras waned off, he started meditating on Sri Garudadhwaja with great devotion. The grandson of Shini (Satyaki) then got up and, in spite of being stopped by Arjuna and the others, cut off the head of Bhurishravas.

Sri Krishna then gave Satyaki a chariot, prepared especially for him, along with a charioteer. By that time, the horses of Arjuna had gotten tired due to thirst. Arjuna then exercised the Varunastra.

With the astra itself, Arjuna created a water fall. Using arrows, he also created a stable for the horses. Sri Krishna then untied the horses and made them drink water. Arjuna meanwhile kept tormenting the enemies.

Sri Krishna, the lord of all, plucked out arrows stuck in the horses and relieved them of their stress. He then tied them back to the chariot and started driving it. Arjuna climbed on to the chariot and continued fighting with the enemies like before.

After Satyaki’s departure, Dharmaraja again became tense due to worry, and said to Bhima – “The sound of the Gandiva cannot be heard while only the sound of the Panchajanya is being heard loudly”.

units.sanskrit:
मया नियुक्तश्‍च गतः स सात्यकिर्भारं च तस्याधिकमेव मन्ये।
तत् पाहि पार्थं युयुधानमेव त्वं भीम गत्वा यदि जीवतस्तौ ॥ २६/११३॥
इतीरितः प्राह वृकोदरस्तं न रक्षितं वासुदेवेन पार्थम्।
ब्रह्मेशानावपि जेतुं समर्थौ किं द्रौणिकर्णादिधनुर्भृतोऽत्र ॥ २६/११४॥
अतो भयं नास्ति धनञ्जयस्य न सात्यकेश्‍चैव हरेः प्रसादात्।
रक्ष्यस्त्वमेवात्र मतो मयाऽद्य द्रोणो ह्ययं यतते त्वां ग्रहीतुम् ॥ २६/११५॥
इतीरितः प्राह युधिष्ठिरस्तं न जीवमाने युधि मां घटोत्कचे।
धृष्टद्युम्ने चास्त्रविदां वरिष्ठे द्रोणो वशं नेतुमिह प्रभुः क्वचित् ॥ २६/११६॥
यदि प्रियं कर्तुमिहेच्छसि त्वं मम प्रयाह्याशु च पार्थसात्यकी।
रक्षस्व सञ्ज्ञामपि सिंहनादात् कुरुष्व मे पार्थशैनेयदृष्टौ ॥ २६/११७॥
तथा हते चैव जयद्रथे मे कुरुष्व सञ्ज्ञामपि तेन चोक्तः।
भीमस्तु हैडिम्बममुष्य रक्षणे व्यधाच्च सेनापतिमेव सम्यक् ॥ २६/११८॥
स चाह सेनापतिरत्र भीमं प्रयाहि तौ यत्र च केशवार्जुनौ।
न जीवमाने मयि धर्षितुं क्षमो द्रोणो नृपं मृत्युरहं च तस्य ॥ २६/११९॥
इति ब्रुवाणंं प्रणिधाय भीमः पुनःपुनस्तं नृपतिं गदाधरः।
ययौ परानीकमधिज्यधन्वा निरन्तरं प्रवमन् बाणपूगान् ॥ २६/१२०॥
units.english:
“As per my direction, Satyaki left. However, it appears to me that the task was overbearing for him. Therefore O Bhima! You proceed now and protect Arjuna and Yuyudhana, in case they are alive”.

When Dharmaraja spoke thus, Bhimasena replied – “Being protected by Sri Krishna, even Brahma, Rudra and the others cannot win against Arjuna. How then can Ashwathama, Karna and the other archers win?”

“Due to Sri Hari’s grace, neither Dhananjaya nor Satyaki have anything to fear. My belief is that it is you who needs protection now. Drona is trying to capture you, isn’t he?”

When Bhima replied in this manner, Yudhishthira said – “As long as Ghatotkacha and Dhrishtadyumna, the best amongst bowmen, are still alive, Drona can never be successful in capturing me”.

“If you desire to do what is pleasing to me, proceed immediately towards Arjuna and Satyaki. Protect them and let out a leonine roar as soon as you see them and inform me”.

“Similarly, let me know after Jayadratha has been slain” – when Yudhishthira said thus, Bhima appointed the son of Hidimbaa and the commander of the Pandava army for his proper protection. Note: The son of Hidimbaa was Ghatotkacha. Dhrishtadyumna was the commander of the Pandava army.

Dhrishtadyumna, the Senadhipati, said to Bhima – “You proceed towards Sri Krishna and Arjuna. As long as I am alive, Drona cannot be successful in capturing Dharmaraja. Ain’t I verily Drona’s death?”

When Dhrishtadyumna assured him thus, Bhima handed over Yudhishthira under his protection and proceeded against the enemy army, holding a mace, having strung a bow, and relentlessly showering clusters of arrows.

units.sanskrit:
न्यवारयत् तं शरवर्षधारो द्रोणो वचश्‍चेदमुवाच भीमम्।
शिष्यस्नेहाद् वासविः सात्यकिश्‍च मया प्रमुक्तौ भृशमानतौ मयि ॥ २६/१२१॥
स्वीया प्रतिज्ञाऽपि हि सैन्धवस्य गुप्तौ मया पार्थकृते विसृष्टा।
दास्ये न ते मार्गमहं कथञ्चित् पश्यास्त्रवीर्यं मम दिव्यमद्भुतम् ॥ २६/१२२॥
इत्युक्तवाक्यः स गदां समाददे चिक्षेप तां द्रोणरथाय भीमः।
उवाच चाहं पितृवन्मानये त्वां सदा मृदुस्त्वां प्रति नान्यथा क्वचित् ॥ २६/१२३॥
अमार्दवे पश्य च यादृशं बलं ममेति तस्याशु विचूर्णितो रथः।
गदाभिघातेन वृकोदरस्य ससूतवाजिध्वजयन्त्रकूबरः ॥ २६/१२४॥
द्रोणो गदामापततीं निरीक्ष्य त्ववप्लुतो लाघवतो धरातले।
तदैव दुर्योधनयापितं रथं परं समास्थाय शरान् ववर्ष ह ॥ २६/१२५॥
शरैस्तदीयैः परमास्त्रमन्त्रितैः प्रवृष्यमाणो जगदीरणात्मजः।
शिरो निधायाशु पुरो वृषो यथा तमभ्ययादेव रथादवप्लुतः ॥ २६/१२६॥
मनोजवादेव तमाप्य भीमो रथं गृहीत्वाऽम्बर आक्षिपत् क्षणात्।
शक्तोऽप्यहं त्वां न निहन्मि गौरवादित्येव सुज्ञापयितुं तदस्य ॥ २६/१२७॥
सवाजिसूतः सरथः क्षितौ पतन् विचूर्णितोऽस्माद् गुरुरप्यवप्लुतः।
तदा विशोकोऽस्य रथं समानयत् तमारुहद् भीम उदारविक्रमः ॥ २६/१२८॥
units.english:
Drona blocked Bhima through a rain of arrows and said to him – “Out of affection for my students, I let Arjuna and Satyaki go inside. They were very humble towards me”.

“I gave up the vow undertaken for protecting Saindhava for the sake of Arjuna. However, I cannot provide you a way under any circumstance. Witness my divine and extraordinary capability with astras”.

As soon as he said thus, Bhima picked up a mace. Throwing it at Drona’s chariot, he said – “I respect you like a father. I shall always treat you with softness. I can never go tough against you”.

“Witness now what my strength is if I go tough” – saying thus he threw his mace. Immediately, Drona’s chariot, along with the charioteer, horses, flag, wheels and axle was crushed to pieces due to the blow from Bhima’s mace.

Noticing the mace hurtling towards him, Drona quickly jumped to the ground. He climbed another chariot that Duryodhana sent then, and started showering Bhima with arrows.

When Drona started discharging arrows that were powered by great astras, Bhima, the main source of action for the world and the son of Vayu, jumped from his chariot and started rushing towards him like an ox, leaning his head forward. Note: Bhima was the Avatara of Mukhyaprana, the Devata who is the reason for all activity in the world, conducted as per the wishes of Sri Hari.

Bhima approached Drona at the speed of mind and instantly picked up his chariot and threw it into the sky. Through this, he gave him the message that he was not killing him out of respect.

That chariot came crashing to the ground and was blown to pieces along with the horses and charioteer. Drona once again escaped by jumping to the ground. By that time, Vishoka brought Bhima’s chariot there. The extraordinary warrior Bhima climbed the same.

units.sanskrit:
द्रोणोऽपि दुर्योधनदत्तमन्यं रथं समास्थाय युधिष्ठिरं ययौ।
गृहीतुकामं नृपतिं प्रयान्तं न्यवारयत् संयति वाहिनीपतिः ॥ २६/१२९॥
विद्रावितां द्रोणशरैः स्वसेनां संस्थाप्य भूयो द्रुपदात्मजः शरैः।
द्रोणं निवार्यैव चमूं परेषां विद्रावयामास च तस्य पश्यतः ॥ २६/१३०॥
तयोरभूद् युद्धमतीव रौद्रं जयैषिणोः पाण्डवधार्तराष्ट्रयोः।
अत्यद्भुतं सन्ततबाणवर्षमनारतं सुचिरं निर्विशेषम् ॥ २६/१३१॥
ततः प्रायाद् भीमसेनोऽमितौजा मृद्गञ्छरैः कौरवराजसेनाम्।
विन्दानुविन्दप्रमुखा धार्तराष्ट्रास्तमासेदुर्द्वादश वीरमुख्याः ॥ २६/१३२॥
विद्धः शरैस्तैर्बहुभिर्वृकोदरः शिरांसि तेषां युगपच्चकर्त।
हतेषु तेषु प्रवरेषु धन्विनां सत्यव्रतः पुरुमित्रो जयश्‍च ॥ २६/१३३॥
वृन्दारकः पौरवश्‍चेत्यमात्याः समासेदुर्धार्तराष्ट्रस्य भीमम्।
स तैः पृषत्कैरवकीर्यमाणः सितान् विपाठान् युगपत् समाददे ॥ २६/१३४॥
जहार तैरेव शिरांसि तेषां हतेषु तेष्वेव परे प्रदुद्रुवुः।

स सिंहवत् क्षुद्रमृगान् समन्ततो विद्राव्य शत्रून् हृदिकात्मजं रणे ॥ २६/१३५॥
अभ्यागमत् तेन निवारितः शरैः क्षणेन चक्रे विरथाश्‍वसूतम्।
स गाढविद्धस्तु वृकोदरेण रणं विसृज्यापययौ क्षणेन ॥ २६/१३६॥
units.english:
Drona ascended another chariot given by Duryodhana and proceeded against Yudhishthira. Dhrishtadyumna, the commander of the Pandavas, stopped Drona in battle when he desired to capture Dharmaraja.

Stopping his own army that was running away from Drona’s arrows, Dhrishtadyumna halted Drona with arrows of his own and, even as Drona kept watching, chased away the opponent’s soldiers.

Desiring the victory of the Pandavas and Kauravas respectively, a most special, amazing and terrifying battle, that involved a relentless shower of arrows, took place between Dhrishtadyumna and Drona for a long time.

Later Bhimasena, the one with unlimited valour, moved further slaying Duryodhana’s army with his arrows. Twelve Kauravas, including the great warriors Vinda and Anuvinda, faced him.

Even as they hurled many arrows at him, Bhimasena cut off their heads simultaneously. When those great archers were killed, five ministers of Duryodhana named Satyavrata, Purumitra, Jaya, Brundaraka and Paurava rushed against Bhimasena. As they started showering arrows against him, Bhima picked up many sharp arrows together.
