“How can sorrow ever touch those who have attained Aparoksha of Parabrahman, who are always engaged in pure and noble deeds, who believe in Sri Vishnu, who have given up their bodies through excellent Yoga and who are best amongst the Devatas?”

“All of these are great Devatas. In order to please Sri Hari who wished to perform Bhu-bhara- harana, they engaged their mind in him, offered all their work to him and returned happily with him to attain Swarga”.

units.sanskrit:
न ते नृपाद्यापि हि मानुषो गतो भावस्ततो द्वेष्टि सुयोधनादीन्।
निमज्ज्य तद् विष्णुपदोदकेऽत्र विसृज्य देहं भज देवभावम् ॥ ३२/११३॥
सुयोधनाद्या यदिमे सुपापा आरब्धपुण्यक्षयमाप्य नित्ये।
निःशेषसौख्योज्झितनित्यदुःखेऽवशाः पतिष्यन्त्यपुनर्निवृत्ताः ॥ ३२/११४॥
देवांशजा ये तु समस्तशस्ते स्वमूलरूपं समवाप्य काले।
स्वतारतम्यानुसृतां विमुक्तिं प्राप्स्यन्ति नात्रापि विचार्यमस्ति ॥ ३२/११५॥
इत्युक्त आश्‍वेव निमज्य गङ्गां धर्मात्मजस्तत्र विसृज्य देहम्।
सद्यो बभौ दैवमवाप्य कायं विसृष्टरोषादिसमस्तदोषः ॥ ३२/११६॥
स तु प्रपश्यन् स्वजनं समस्तं स्वमूलरूपातिसमीपसंस्थम्।
ददर्श भीमं च मरुत्समीपे मध्ये ज्वलन्तं मरुतां गणस्य ॥ ३२/११७॥
ददर्श कृष्णामपि तत्समीपे श्रिया ज्वलन्तीं समतीत्य चान्याः।

स्प्रष्टुं च संस्कारवशादियेष निषिध्य तं प्राह सुराधिराजः ॥ ३२/११८॥
एषा हि साक्षाज्जगतां प्रियस्य प्राणात्मनो जीववरेश्‍वरस्य।
प्राणप्रिया श्रीरिति नाम यस्याः शमात्मकेऽस्मिन् रमते सदैका ॥ ३२/११९॥
युष्मच्चतुर्देहगतस्य वायोर्वायुप्रिया भीमतनोस्तथैव।
भोगाय सृष्टा पुरुषोत्तमेन युष्मत्प्रियार्थं भवतां च दारैः ॥ ३२/१२०॥
units.english:
“O King! You are not yet relieved of your human nature. Therefore you are still hating Duryodhana and the others. Take bath in this river Ganga which is the water from the sacred feet of Sri Vishnu, give up your (human) body and attain your divinity”. Note: The reference here is to the river Ganga that flows in Swarga and not to the one that flows on Earth.

“After their prarabdha-punya gets exhausted, Duryodhana and the others, who are great sinners, will fall into eternal Naraka where there is not even a trace of happiness and where eternal sorrow is prevalent. They will remain there under Sri Vishnu’s control and will never return”.

“All those who possess Amshas of Devatas in them return to their original form and, during the time of Pralaya, attain Mukti that is in accordance with their nature and position in the hierarchy (of Jeevas). There is no doubt about this”.

When the Devatas spoke thus, Dharmaraja took bath in river Ganga and gave up his physical body. He immediately attained a divine form and lost all his doshas such as anger and the other vices.

Dharmaraja saw all his relatives being seated close to their original forms. He saw a resplendent Bhima seated amidst the Maruts, next to Vayu.

Next to Bhima, Dharmaraja saw Draupadi, outshining everyone else with her radiance. By force of habit he desired to touch her. Devendra stopped him and said.

“This Bharati is most dear to Sri Vayu, who is the darling of the world, the chief Prana and the best amongst Jeevas. Since she finds joy always in Prana, who is the very essence of bliss, she is known as Sri”.

“She had been created by Sri Hari, the best amongst all Purushas, for the joy of Vayu who had entered the bodies of you four and for the joy of Bhima who was Vayu himself. For your happiness, she had gotten together with your wives”.

units.sanskrit:
प्रीतिस्ततो ह्यभ्यधिका बभूव भीमस्य चास्यास्तदनु स्म पार्थे।
ततो भवत्स्वेव यथाक्रमेण गुणानुसारेण समीरणस्य ॥ ३२/१२१॥
इयं हि सा शुद्धतनुः प्रजाता शच्यादियोगापगताग्र्यदेहा।
यूयं च सर्वे मरुतो विशेषसंयोगहीनाः स्वशरीरसंस्थाः ॥ ३२/१२२॥
स्पर्शेऽपि नास्याः पवमानपत्न्याः सुपूतताऽलं भवतामिदानीम्।
नचोत्तरत्रापि भवेत् कथञ्चिद् दिवौकसां मानुषदेहिनो यथा ॥ ३२/१२३॥
इतीरितं तं प्रतिसन्निवृत्तं विनाशयन् मानुषवासनां स्वयम्।
समाश्लिषच्छुद्धतनुः स्तनोत्थो धर्मो हरेः सोऽभवदाशु तत्समः ॥ ३२/१२४॥
ततस्तु पार्था अखिलाः स्वमूलरूपैः सहैवाविविशुर्मुदाऽन्विताः।
स्वीयानि सद्मानि ततोऽप्यनूनभोगाः सदारा न्यवसंश्‍च तत्र ॥ ३२/१२५॥
तत्रापि कृष्णेन समागमोऽभूत् पुरेव तेषामपि तत्पराणाम्।
चिक्रीड एभिः सहितस्तथैव कृष्णोऽपि तद्वत् सरथोऽर्जुनेन ॥ ३२/१२६॥
अन्ये तु देवांशभवाः समस्ताः स्वमूलरूपैक्यमवापुराशु।

कर्मक्षयादेव सुरेतरास्तु पुण्यक्षयं प्राप्य भुवि प्रजाताः ॥ ३२/१२७॥
चतुःसहस्रं त्रिशतोत्तरं ते संवत्सराणामनुभूय दिव्यान्।
भोगान् नरत्वेऽपि सदेश्‍वरोऽहमसज्जगच्चेति धियाऽऽप्नुवंस्तमः ॥ ३२/१२८॥
units.english:
“Therefore she was most affectionate towards Bhima. After that she possessed affection towards Arjuna and then towards all of you, depending upon the extent of Sri Vayu’s Avesha in all of you”.

“Now, Draupadi is present here in her pristine form of Bharati, without the presence of Shachi or the others. Similarly, all of you too are here in your original forms without the special presence of Vayu”.

“Therefore you do not possess the required purity to touch her since she is the consort of Vayu. Neither will you attain such purity in the future, just like how those possessing human bodies can never qualify to touch Devatas”.

When Indra spoke thus, Dharmaraja immediately moved back. In order to rid him of the remaining human traces, Yama, who was born from the right breast of Sri Hari, gave him a deep hug. Immediately he came equal to Yamadharma. Note: Due to that hug, Yudhisthira and Yama became one and the same in essence and capabilities.

After that, all the Pandavas entered their own lokas with great joy, along with their original forms. They resided there with their wives amidst material comforts that never fell short.

The Pandavas, being devotees of Sri Krishna, obtained his company there too! Sri Krishna too, just as earlier, remained there with Arjuna and the chariot.

The others too who were born with the Amsha of Devatas exhausted their Karma and merged with their moolaroopas. The Asuras exhausted their punyas and were born again on Earth.

Enjoying divine pleasures in Swarga for four thousand three hundred years they attained Tamas after claiming that they were God themselves and that the world was an illusion.

units.sanskrit:
दुःखेऽपि तेषामिह तारतम्यं कलेः परं दुःखमिहाखिलाच्च।
यथा विरिञ्चस्य सुखं परं स्यान्मुक्तौ हरिद्वेषकृतो विशेषः ॥ ३२/१२९॥
केचित् पिशाचासुरराक्षसत्वमवाप्य विष्णोरपि तत्पराणाम्।
द्वेषात् तमोऽन्धं त्वरया समाप्नुयुर्देवाः स्वकाले निजयोग्यमुक्तिम् ॥ ३२/१३०॥
चतुःसहस्रे त्रिशतोत्तरे गते संवत्सराणां तु कलौ पृथिव्याम्।
जातः पुनर्विप्रतनुः स भीमो दैत्यैर्निगूढं हरितत्त्वमाह।
तदैव कृष्णाऽपि भुवि प्रजाता प्रीत्यै हरेरन्धतमस्यपातयत् ॥ ३२/१३१॥
महासुरान् विष्णुपरार्जुनाद्या कृते प्रजाता हरितोषणाय।
पुनश्‍च ते स्थानमवाप्य सर्वे स्वीयं परान्ते तु विमुक्तिमाप्नुयुः ॥ ३२/१३२॥
वायुत्वमाप्तः स हनूमदंशो ब्राह्मं पदं प्राप्य वृकोदरश्‍च।
वागीश्‍वरीत्वं गतयैव कृष्णया सहैव मुक्तिं गमिताऽखिलोत्तमाम् ॥ ३२/१३३॥
भुवि द्युलोके च विरिञ्चतायां मुक्तौ च ताभ्यामधिकं समस्तात्।
सन्तोष्यते पूर्णगुणो रमेशः सदैव नित्योर्जिततद्रतिभ्याम् ॥ ३२/१३४॥
“भूषन् न योऽधि बभ्रूषु नम्नते”
“बळित्था तद् वपुषे धायि दर्शतम्”।
“तां सु ते कीर्तिं मघवन् महित्वा”
इत्यादिसूक्तानि च तत्प्रमाणम् ॥ ३२/१३५॥
अन्यानि वाक्यानि च वैदिकानि सपञ्चरात्रोक्तिपुराणकानि।
पृष्टश्‍च भीष्मोऽत्र युधिष्ठिरेण तन्मोक्षधर्मेष्वपि किञ्चिदाह ॥ ३२/१३६॥
units.english:
They too have a hierarchy measured by sorrow. Kali attains more sorrow than anyone else. Just as Brahma attains the maximum bliss in Mukti. Measured by their hatred for Sri Hari, such variation exists. Note: Just as those who attain Moksha attain a graded level of bliss commensurate with their innate nature, those Tamasic Jeevas who attain Andhantamas too have a gradation in terms of the sorrow they experience. The difference in sorrow experienced is commensurate with the hatred they possess towards Sri Hari. This is again equivalent to the grade that exists amongst Mukta Jeevas based on their devotion to Sri Hari. Kali hates Sri Vishnu the most. Hence, when he enters eternal Tamas, he experiences the maximum amount of sorrow.

Some were born as Pisachas while others were born as Asuras and Rakshasas. Undertaking hatred towards Sri Vishnu and his devotees, they quickly attained Andhantamas. The Devatas attained suitable Mukti at the appropriate time. Note: Nija-yogya-muktim or suitable mukti here means the appropriate level of bliss in the liberated state.

In the Kali Yuga, after four thousand and three hundred years had passed, Bhima was born again as a Brahmana on Earth and instructed (everyone with the) philosophical truths of Sri Hari which had been subjugated by Daityas.

Draupadi too was born on Earth at the same time and ensured the fall of the great Daityas in Andhantamas in order to please Sri Hari. Arjuna and the other devotees of Sri Vishnu too were born then to please Sri Hari.

Obtaining their positions once again, they will attain appropriate Mukti at the end of Brahma’s cycle. Bhimasena, who was the Avatara of Hanuman, will merge with Vayu and attain the position of Brahma. Draupadi will attain the position of Vageeshwari (Sarasvati). Later, both of them will attain excellent Mukti.

On Earth – in the Dyuloka – in the position of Brahma – and in Mukti – Vayu and Bharati always cause great pleasure to Sri Hari, the lord of Lakshmi and the one with all auspicious attributes, through their eternal and complete devotion that exceeds the devotion of all others.

The Suktas ‘bhushannayodhi babhrushu namnate’, ‘balittha tadvapushe dhayi darshatam’, ‘tam su te keertim maghavanmahitva’ and others are the pramanas in this regard. Note: ‘bhushannayodhi babhrushu namnate’ is Rig Veda 1/140/6. ‘balittha tadvapushe dhayi darshatam’ is Rig Veda 1/141/1-5. ‘tam su te keertim maghavanmahitva’ is Rig Veda 10/54.

Other mantras of the Vedas, the words of the Pancharatra and the Puranas are other evidences in this matter. When asked by Yudhishthira, Bhishma too instructed a little of the same in the Moksha Dharma (Parva).

units.sanskrit:
एवं प्रयातेषु सकेशवेषु स्वानेव लोकान् यदुपाण्डवेषु।
परीक्षिदाद्यास्तु तदन्वयोत्था व्यासानुशिष्टाः पृथिवीमरक्षन् ॥ ३२/१३७॥
तैः क्षेमकान्तैरिह भारतादिशास्त्राणि शृण्वद्भिरशेषविद्भिः।
व्यासप्रसादाच्च कलौ च धर्मो ज्ञानं च सुत्रातमगान्न नाशम् ॥ ३२/१३८॥
संवत्सराणां तु सहस्रके गते प्राप्तेषु विद्यामखिलेषु सत्सु।
दग्धाः पुरा ये त्रिपुरं घ्नतैव रुद्रेण जाताः पृथिवीतले ते ॥ ३२/१३९॥
अदर्शनं सर्वमुनीन्द्रवृन्दैः सहैव सज्ज्ञानमहानिधाने।
व्यासे प्रयातेऽपि सुतत्त्वविद्या तत्सम्प्रदायादपि तैरवाप्ता ॥ ३२/१४०॥
उत्सादितत्वात् तु दुरागमानां तत्सम्प्रदायस्य च नाशितत्वात्।
प्रसारितत्वाच्च सदागमानां पापा अपि ज्ञानमवापुरेतत् ॥ ३२/१४१॥
शुना पुरोडाशमिवावलीढं वेदश्रुतिं वाऽन्त्यजनैरवाप्ताम्।
अनन्तदुःखाप्तिसुयोग्यदैत्यैर्विद्यामवाप्तां तु न सेहिरे सुराः ॥ ३२/१४२॥
नावाग्गतिः क्वापि सुवेदिनां भवेत् प्राप्यं सुखं नित्यमवश्यमेभिः।
प्राप्यं तमोऽन्धं त्वसुरैर्न मुक्तिः कदाचिदप्येतदचिन्तयन् सुराः ॥ ३२/१४३॥
ज्ञानप्रदानाय सतां तदन्यज्ञानप्रणाशाय च विष्णुनैते।
कॢप्तास्ततस्ते सविरिञ्चशर्वा विज्ञापयामासुरुपेत्य विष्णुम् ॥ ३२/१४४॥
units.english:
In this way, after Sri Krishna, the Yadavas and the Pandavas returned to their lokas, Parikshita and the others who were born in their lineages were taught by Sri Vyasa and they then ruled the Earth.

Till Kshemaka, Kings used to listen to Bharata and the other Shastras and knew everything. Due to their special protection and due to the influence of Sri Vyasa, Dharma and knowledge were not destroyed in Kali Yuga.

After a thousand years in the Kali Yuga all the noble men obtained the philosophy of truth. The Tripurasuras, who had been burnt by Rudra in the three cities, were born on Earth. Along with all the great Sages, since Sri Vyasa, the treasure of all knowledge, had become invisible, these Asuras too obtained the knowledge of truth due to the power of their sampradayas.

Since all the bad Agamas had been destroyed, since their sampradayas too had vanished, and since the noble Agamas had proliferated, sinners too obtained the knowledge of truth.

Like a dog consuming Purodasha, like an antyaja listening to the nigamas, Daityas who are qualified for utmost sorrow got access to the knowledge of truth, something the Devatas could not tolerate.

Those who possess true knowledge can never have a bad fate. They would have to get eternal bliss. But the Asuras need to attain Andhantamas and not Mukti. Hence the Devatas pondered.

The Devatas have been appointed by Sri Hari to grant knowledge to the noble and to remove knowledge from the others. Therefore Brahma, Rudra and the others went to Sri Vishnu and requested him.

units.sanskrit:
क्षीरोदधेरुत्तरतीरनिष्ठितैरभिष्टुतः सुष्टुतिभिः पुरुष्टुतः।
प्रदाय तेषामभयं रमापतिः क्षणादभूच्चारुतमाकृतिः शिशुः ॥ ३२/१४५॥
यस्त्रैपुराणां प्रथमोऽत्र जातः शुद्धोदनेत्येव जिनेति चोक्तः।
क्षेत्रे गयाख्येऽस्य शिशुं प्रजातं सम्प्रास्य दूरेऽत्र बभूव विष्णुः ॥ ३२/१४६॥
अजानमानाः स्वशिशुं गतं तं शिशुं हरिं वीक्ष्य निजं स्म मेनिरे।
तेषां तदा वैदिककर्म वीक्ष्य सम्प्राहसत् तद्वपुषैव केशवः ॥ ३२/१४७॥
तं जातमात्रं प्रहसन्तमीक्ष्य सुविस्मितैः पृष्ट उवाच विष्णुः।
बुद्धोऽहमित्येव सुनित्यबोधाज्जगाद चैषामथ बुद्धदर्शनम् ॥ ३२/१४८॥
तथाऽप्यविश्‍वासमेवक्ष्य तेषां सस्मार देवानखिलान् जनार्दनः।
विज्ञाय ते तस्य मनोगतं निजान् प्रचिक्षिपुर्हेतिगणानमुष्मिन् ॥ ३२/१४९॥
स जातमात्रः शिवपूर्वकाणां शूलादिहेतीरखिला निगीर्य।
दैत्यातिमोहाय निजं च चक्रं स्वमुक्तमाश्‍वेव वशी समग्रहीत् ॥ ३२/१५०॥
तदासनत्वेन विधाय तस्मिन् समास्थितं देवगणाः प्रणम्य।
जग्मुः स्वधामानि वचांसि चास्य स्वीचक्रुराश्‍वेव जिनादिदैत्याः ॥ ३२/१५१॥
ते ज्ञानधर्मावपहाय पापा विमोहिता देववरेण सर्वे।
जग्मुस्तमोऽन्धं क्षणिकं समस्तं ज्ञानं न सच्चेति दृढं स्मरन्तः ॥ ३२/१५२॥
units.english:
When they gathered on the northern coast of Ksheera Samudra and prayed to Sri Hari with excellent Stutis, he granted him freedom from fear. Immediately, he took on the form of a beautiful child.

The first amongst the Tripurasuras was born on Earth and was known as Shuddhodana and Jina. Sri Hari threw afar the child that was born to him in Gaya and slept in its position.

Not being aware that their child had been discarded, all of them came under the illusion that Sri Hari in the form of that child was verily their son. Seeing them practice Vedic rites, Sri Hari in the form of the child laughed loudly.

Seeing that child laugh in that way right after birth, they were extremely surprised and when they enquired, Sri Hari said – “I am Buddha”. Being omniscient and complete in all respects, he told them thus and instructed them with the Buddha-darshana.

Noticing that they did not develop belief in him still, Sri Hari in the form of Buddha remembered all the Devatas, wanting them to come to battle with him. Realizing his intention, the Devatas hurled their entire cluster of weapons at him.

Sri Hari, being in the form of that newborn, swallowed Shiva’s Trishula and all the weapons of the others. In order to cause great illusion to Asuras, he quickly held the Chakra released by his own form of Vishnu.

Sri Hari converted that Chakra into a seat and sat on it. The entire group of Devatas bowed to him and returned to their lokas. Jina and the other Daityas immediately accepted his words.

All the sinners became greatly enchanted with Sri Hari, the best amongst the Devatas, and gave up knowledge and Dharma. Firmly believing that everything was momentary and that nothing was real, all of them went to Andhantamas.

units.sanskrit:
नारायणोऽप्याप्य सुरेन्द्रवृन्दं वृत्तं च तेषामखिलं निगद्य।
पृष्टश्‍च तैराह निजं हृदिस्थं बौद्धागमार्थं सृतिबन्धमोचनम् ॥ ३२/१५३॥
क्षणादयः क्षणिकास्तद्विशेषा यतः प्रयान्त्येव निसर्गतोऽखिलाः।
ततः स्थिरत्वेऽपि विशेषसंश्रयादुक्तं क्षणस्थायि मया समस्तम् ॥ ३२/१५४॥
तद्वान् विशेषश्‍च यतो न भिन्नौ सदा स्वनिर्वाहकशक्तियुक्तौ।
अतः क्षणस्थायि समस्तमेतत् स्थिरात्मकं चेति हि नास्ति भेदः ॥ ३२/१५५॥
ज्ञोऽहं सदैकः परमो मयैतत् सदाऽननीयं हि यतोऽस्वतन्त्रम्।
ज्ञानात्मकं विश्‍वमतो मयोक्तं जडस्वरूपं च किमु स्म चेतनम् ॥ ३२/१५६॥
शंशीलकोऽहं यत एव चोच्चः शूनामकस्तद्धि मया निधेयम्।
शून्याभिधं दोषविरुद्धरूपो दोषोज्झितोऽन्यस्त्वखिलादनामा ॥ ३२/१५७॥
एनैव साद्यं त्वसदेव नामतस्त्वभाव एनैव भवेद् यतस्तत्।
इत्यादि बोद्धव्यमिदं समस्तं मयोदितं क्वापि न हेयमस्ति ॥ ३२/१५८॥
इत्यादि देवान् प्रतिबोधयंश्‍च देवैः सहोवास स बुद्धदेवः।
गत्वा स्वधामाप्यपरेण रूपेणास्ते पृथक् चैकतनुर्यथेष्टम् ॥ ३२/१५९॥
ततस्तु बुद्धोदितपक्षसंस्थो जिनोऽपि चक्रे मतमन्यदेव।
बौद्धेन जैनेन मतेन चैव दैत्यांशकाः प्रीतिमगुः समस्ताः ॥ ३२/१६०॥
units.english:
Sri Narayana, in the form of Buddha, went to the Devatas and told them everything that had transpired. Upon their request, he revealed (the true) Buddha shastra that enables one to get rid of the shackles of Samsara.

“The units of time, and their attributes, get over within a short period of time by their very nature. Therefore, although they are eternal, they are considered momentary. Keeping this special attribute in mind, I informed them that everything was momentary”.

“An object and its attributes are inseparable and therefore they possess the ability to self-regulate. Therefore, there is no contradiction in saying that a substance is momentary as well as fixed”.

“Being independent I am Supreme and hence known as ‘jna’. This Universe is always ‘ananeeya’ by me. In other words it is manifest because of me. It is so because it is dependent. Therefore, I have said that this insentient Universe is ‘jnanatmaka’. It is of course self-established that sentient beings are ‘jnanatmaka’ as well”.

“I am verily the personification of extreme bliss. Therefore I am supreme and hence known as ‘shoo’. Since this Universe is controlled at every stage by me in my form as ‘shoo’, the Universe is ‘Shunya’. Since I am the very opposite of defects and do not possess any defects and since I am unique, I am known as ‘a’. Since everything is born from my form as ‘a’, all these are known as ‘abhava’. Since everything gets destroyed, it is known as ‘asat’. In this way, my teachings are to be (correctly) understood. There is nothing unacceptable in all of this”.

Sri Hari, in his form as Buddhadeva, instructed these and other special teachings to the Devatas and resided with them. Through another form, he proceeded to his own loka and stayed there. Thus, being distinct and unique at the same time, he remains at his own will.

After that, Jina established another sect relying on Buddha’s teachings. All those with Asuric nature were greatly pleased with the Bauddha-mata and Jaina-mata.

units.sanskrit:
प्रशान्तविद्येत्यभिधं तथाऽन्यद् बुद्धोक्तशास्त्रं त्रिदशा अवाप्य।
तोषं ययुर्वेदसमस्तसारं यामास्थितानामचिरेण मुक्तिः ॥ ३२/१६१॥
अन्ये मनुष्या अपि भारताद्यं सत्सम्प्रदायं परिगृह्य विष्णुम्।
यजन्त आपुः परमां गतिं तन्न सेहिरे क्रोधवशादिदैत्याः ॥ ३२/१६२॥
शैवं तपस्ते विपुलं विधाय जगद्विमोहोर्जितशक्तिमस्मात्।
प्राप्य प्रजाता भुवि मोहनं च चक्रुः कुतर्कैरभिदां वदन्तः ॥ ३२/१६३॥
तेषां प्रपाताय सतां च मुक्त्यै जन्मास भीमस्य यदुक्तमत्र।

दुर्गा पुनर्विप्रकुलेऽवतीर्णा हनिष्यति व्रातमथासुराणाम् ॥ ३२/१६४॥
ततः कलेरन्तमवाप्य धर्मज्ञानादिकल्याणगुणप्रहीने।
लोके विरिञ्चत्रिपुरघ्नशक्रपूर्वाः पयोब्धिं त्रिदशाः प्रजग्मुः ॥ ३२/१६५॥
नारायणस्तैः स्तुतिपूर्वमर्थितो भवाय लोकस्य स शम्फलाख्ये।
ग्रामे मुनेर्विष्णुयशोऽभिधस्य गृहे बभूवाविरचिन्त्यशक्तिः ॥ ३२/१६६॥
कलेस्तु कात्कारत एष कल्की ज्ञानं कलं कं सुखमेव तद्वान्।
कल्कीति वा तेन समस्तदस्युविनाशनं तेन दिनाद् व्यधायि ॥ ३२/१६७॥
अधर्मवृत्तं विमुखं हरेश्‍च निहत्य निःशेषजनं तुरङ्गी।
संस्थापयामास स धर्मकेतुं ज्ञानं स्वभक्तिं च निजप्रजासु ॥ ३२/१६८॥
units.english:
The Devatas obtained another teaching from Buddha known as the ‘Prashanta Vidya’ and were greatly pleased. That teaching is the very essence of all the Vedas. Those who rely upon it attain Mukti quickly.

On the other hand, many other humans got into the right sampradayas and accepted the teachings of Bharata and other Shastras and attained Mukti by worshipping Sri Vishnu. The Krodhavashas and other Daityas could not tolerate this.

Those Krodhavashas performed a lot of Tapas, pleased Shiva, and obtained great powers from him to cause confusion and were born in this world. Using twisted logic, they started causing a lot of ignorance.

To cause their downfall, and to cause the Mukti of sajjanas, the Avatara of Bhima took place as stated earlier. Durga will be born again in the family of a Brahmana and cause the destruction of all Asuras. Note: Sri Madhwa was born 4300 years after the Mahabharata war. Durga will be born 36,000 years into Kali Yuga.

After the Durga Avatara, at the end of Kali Yuga, when Dharma, Jnana and all other auspicious attributes vanished completely, Brahma, Rudra, Indra and the other Devatas went to Ksheera Sagara. Note: Since Kalki Avatara occurs in every Brahma Kalpa, Sri Madhwa refers to it in the past tense.

When Sri Narayana is prayed upon by the Devatas for the welfare of the world through pious Stutis, he will appear in a village called Shambhala, as a child born to the wife of a Muni called Vishnuyashas.

Since he destroys Kali in this way, he is known as Kalki. ‘Kala’ means knowledge. ‘Ka’ means bliss. Since he possesses knowledge and bliss he is known as Kalki. He shall destroy all the Asuras in a single day.

Destroying all those who are against Sri Hari and are engaged in Adharma, the horse-riding Kalki shall establish a bridge to Dharma and propagate knowledge and devotion to Sri Vishnu amongst his people.

units.sanskrit:
इत्याद्यनन्तानि हरेरुदारकर्माणि रूपाणि च सद्गुणाश्‍च।
नित्यव्यपेताखिलदोषकस्य ब्रह्मेत्यनन्तेति च नाम येन॥ ३२/१६९॥
आनन्दतीर्थाख्यमुनिः सुपूर्णप्रज्ञाभिधो ग्रन्थमिमं चकार।
नारायणेनाभिहितो बदर्यां तस्यैव शिष्यो जगदेकभर्तुः॥ ३२/१७०॥
यस्तत्प्रसादादखिलांश्‍च वेदान् सपञ्चरात्रान् सरहस्यसङ्ग्रहान्।
वेदेतिहासांश्‍च पुराणयुक्तान् यथावदन्या अपि सर्वविद्याः॥ ३२/१७१॥
समस्तशास्त्रार्थविनिर्णयोऽयं विशेषतो भारतवर्त्मचारी।
ग्रन्थः कृतोऽयं जगतां जनित्रं हरिं गुरुं प्रीणयताऽमुनैव॥ ३२/१७२॥
विनिर्णयो नास्त्यमुना विना यद् विप्रस्थितानामिह सर्ववाचाम्।
तद् ब्रह्मसूत्राणि चकार कृष्णो व्याख्या तथैषामयथाकृताऽन्यैः॥ ३२/१७३॥
निगूहितं यत् पुरुषोत्तमत्वं सूत्रोक्तमप्यत्र महासुरेन्द्रैः।
जीवेश्‍वरैक्यं प्रवदद्भिरुग्रैर्व्याख्याय सूत्राणि चकार चाविः॥ ३२/१७४॥
व्यासाज्ञया भाष्यवरं विधाय पृथक्पृथक् चोपनिषत्सुभाष्यम्।
कृत्वाऽखिलान्यं पुरुषोत्तमं च हरिं वदन्तीति समर्थयित्वा॥ ३२/१७५॥
तनुस्तृतीया पवनस्य सेयं सद्भारतार्थप्रतिपादनाय।
ग्रन्थं चकारेममुदीर्णविद्या यस्मिन् रमन्ते हरिपादभक्ताः॥ ३२/१७६॥
“तृतीयमस्य वृषभस्य दोहसे दशप्रमतिं जनयन्त योषणः।
निर्यदीं बुध्नान्महिषस्य वर्पस ईशानासः शवसा क्रन्त सूरयः।
यदीमनु प्रदिवो मध्व आधवे गुहासन्तं मातरिश्‍वा मथायति॥ ३२/१७७॥”
इत्यादिवाक्योक्तमिदं समस्तं
तथा पुराणेषु च पञ्चरात्रे।
अत्रोदिता याश्‍च कथाः समस्ता वेदेतिहासादिविनिर्णयोक्ताः॥ ३२/१७८॥
तस्मादयं ग्रन्थवरोऽखिलानां धर्मादिमोक्षान्तपुमर्थहेतुः।
किञ्चोदितैरस्य गुणैस्ततोऽन्यैर्नारायणः प्रीतिमुपैत्यतोऽलम्॥ ३२/१८०॥
यस्य त्रीण्युदितानि वेदवचने रूपाणि दिव्यान्यलं
बट् तद्दर्शनमित्थमेव निहितं देवस्य भर्गो महत्।
वायो रामवचोनयं प्रथमकं पृक्षो द्वितीयं वपु-
र्मध्वो  यत्तु तृतीयमेतदमुना ग्रन्थः कृतः केशवे॥ ३२/१८१॥
यः सर्वगुणसम्पूर्णः सर्वदोषविवर्जितः।
प्रीयतां प्रीत एवालं विष्णुर्मे परमः सुहृत्॥ ३२/१८२॥
॥ इति श्रीमदानन्दतीर्थभगवत्पादाचार्यविरचिते श्रीमन्महाभारततात्पर्यनिर्णये पाण्डवस्वर्गारोहणं नाम द्वात्रिंशोऽध्यायः॥
॥ समाप्तोऽयं ग्रन्थः॥
units.english:
These and others are the endless activities, forms and noble qualities of Sri Hari. Being free from all defects at all times, he is known as Brahma and Ananta also by virtue of this.

Being ordered by Sri Narayana at Badari, Anandatirtha Muni, possessing the name of Poornaprajna, composed this grantha. He is the student of Sri Vyasa, who alone is the lord of the world. Note: Sri Madhwacharya visited Sri Veda Vyasa twice at Badari. During the first time, he offered the Brahmasutra Bhashya at the feet of Sri Vyasa who then ordered him to compose a Tatparya Nirnaya on the Bharata. Sri Madhwa composed this present work and offered it at Sri Vyasa’s feet during his second Yatra to Badari.

Due to the grace of Sri Hari, he possesses complete knowledge of all the Vedas, Pancharatras, Upanishads, Itihasas, Puranas and all other Shastras.

This work is deterministic of all Shastras. It is especially deterministic of the (Maha)Bharata. He composed this grantha in order to please Sri Hari, the progenitor and Guru of the world.

There is no other decisive commentary on those Shastra vachanas which appear contradictory at the outset. For this very purpose, Sri Vyasa has composed the Brahma Sutras. However, many wrong commentaries have been written on it by others.

The message of Sri Hari’s supremacy that is propagated by the Brahma Sutras was masked by the chief Asuras who started preaching non-difference between Jeeva and Ishwara. Therefore, he has composed Bhashya on it and has explained its purport.

As per the orders of Sri Vyasa, he composed an excellent Bhashya (for the Sutras) and also composed separate Bhashyas for the Upanishads. He justified that all of them (Sutras and Upanishads) propagate the supremacy and uniqueness of Sri Hari.

This grantha was composed by the third Avatara of Pavana (Vayu) in order to propagate the meaning of the excellent Bharata. The best of the scholars, who are devotees of Sri Hari’s feet, will study this and derive great joy.

“truteeyamasya vrushabasya dohase. dashapramatim janayanta yoshanah. niryadeem budhnaanmahishasya varpasa. eeshanasah shavasaa kranta soorayah. yadeemanu pradivo madhwa aadhave. guhaasantam matarishvaa mathaayati” Note: This the Balittha Sukta – Rig Veda 1/141. This Sukta reveals the three Avataras of Vayu – Hanuman, Bhima and Madhwacharya!

Through these and other statements, all these have been established. These have occurred in the Puranas and Pancharatra too. All the tales narrated here incorporate the meanings of the Veda, Itihasa and other granthas.

Therefore this is the King amongst all granthas. This is the instrument for all excellent Dharma and all other Purusharthas including Moksha. What else needs to be said about its other qualities! Sri Narayana shall be pleased with this. Note: The study of Mahabharata Tatparya Nirnaya causes great pleasure to Sriman Narayana.

The original form of Vayu has three divine forms – so say the Vedas. The original form of Vayu is verily that of strength. It is pervaded by knowledge. It resides in the heart of all Jeevas to sustain them. It is worthy of worship in all the worlds. The Avataras also possess similar knowledge and strength. The first form (of Hanuman) is the one that carries the words of Rama. The second form (of Bhima) destroys the army of the enemy (Kauravas). The third form is known by the name of Madhwa and the present work regarding Sri Keshava is composed by this very form.

Sri Vishnu, who is complete with all auspicious attributes, and is free from all defects, is my most dear friend. May he, who is always affectionate towards me, be pleased even more! composed by Srimadanandatirtha Bhagavatpada || || Sri Raghavendra Tirtha Gurvantargata Sri Bharatiramana Mukhyapranantargata Sri Lakshmi Narayana Preeyataam || || Sri Krishnarpanamastu ||

source_english.citation: Hariprasad Nellitheertha 2021, Sriman Madhwacharya's Mahabharata Tatparya Nirnaya: An English Translation (compiled PDF, chapter-wise on anandatirtha.wordpress.com)

notes: Sanskrit from Setutila; file has no verse-level numbering, so units are heading sections (ref = heading path in Devanagari). English: Nellitheertha's verse-numbered translation (text layer of the compiled PDF, cached in raw/mbtn_hariprasad). His numbering drifts from the Sanskrit verse numbers in later chapters (offsets up to about 7), so each chapter is aligned by order (English paragraphs against Sanskrit verses, scored by proper-name overlap, length, a steady offset between the translation's verse numbers and Setutila's, and similarity to a rough machine translation of each Sanskrit verse from Bodhan indic-translate that is used only to align and never stored as text; the cache is raw/mbtn_hariprasad/verse_en.json, built by tools/mbtn_translate.py, and without it the alignment falls back to names and length) and a unit's english is the English paragraphs matched to its verses; a paragraph that spans two units is placed in the first. Chapter 16 is not in the compiled PDF with numbers, so it comes from the separate chapter PDF (mbtn-chapter16.pdf, bullets: verses 1-14 unnumbered, 15-33 numbered); the translation's numbers match the published shloka counts (mahabharatatatparyanirnaya.com/chapterandshlokacount) except in chapters 9 (143 vs 141) and 18 (161 vs 160), where the translation's last verses are real (they match the Sanskrit's closing verses); the last verse of chapter 18 is cut off mid-sentence in the source PDF. Chapter 9 verses 88 on are from B. Gururajah Rao's translation per the translator. Checked by comparing each aligned pair's similarity with its neighbours' (about 110 of about 4,600 pairs were flagged and read against the Sanskrit; nearly all were correct, the ones off by a verse or two are in the closing remarks of chapter 9); all 5177 distinct verses have a machine translation (re-translated singly after a batch call shifted about 65 of them), and the few translations that still fit a neighbour better by names are ignored. Sanskrit verse markers with a closing quote are recognised, giving 5181 verses.
